title: Budgeted Cache Repair for Cross-Context KV-Cache Reuse
authors: Haeyong Kang, Chang D. Yoo
abstract: Cross-context KV-cache reuse predicts a shared segment's keys and values under a new prefix instead of recomputing them, and has been reported to do so without quality loss. We find otherwise, and identify two problems. (1) A hidden cost: on MMLU and GSM8K, reuse costs substantial accuracy. (2) A decision at the wrong unit: no rule for deciding whether to reuse a cache removes that cost. What does help is choosing which parts of the cache to recompute, and the value of choosing well falls as the unit of choice grows: informed selection removes 49.5% of the cache error beyond chance at single rows (one token's keys and values), 10.6% at 64-token chunks, and nothing at the level of whole calls. Budgeted Cache Repair (BCR) acts at the unit where selection still pays. It drafts two tokens from the assembled cache, ranks cache rows by the attention those tokens pay them, and recomputes a fixed budget of rows exactly, in one of three layouts. The cost is paid rather than predicted away, and the draft that fails as a gate succeeds as a selector. BCR restores GSM8K to dense-prefill accuracy while still serving most calls from cache, and its best layout outperforms every reuse baseline's mean in the reference grid. The draft also beats a coin-flip selector at the same budget - a control prior evaluations lack.
zh_title: 用于跨上下文 KV 缓存重用的预算缓存修复
translation: 跨上下文 KV 缓存重用在新的前缀下预测共享段的键值，而不是重新计算它们，并且据报道这样做不会造成质量损失。我们发现了相反的情况，并确定了两个问题。(1) 隐藏成本：在 MMLU 和 GSM8K 上，重用会造成显著的准确性损失。(2) 决策单位错误：没有决定是否重用缓存的规则可以消除这种成本。有帮助的是选择重新计算缓存的哪些部分，并且选择得当的价值随着选择单位的增长而下降：在单行（一个 token 的键值）上，知情选择可以消除超出偶然性 49.5% 的缓存错误；在 64-token 块上，消除 10.6%；在整个调用级别上，则没有任何消除。预算缓存修复（BCR）在选择仍然有效的单位上进行操作。它从已组装的缓存中选取两个 token，根据这些 token 对缓存行的注意力对缓存行进行排名，并以三种布局之一精确地重新计算固定预算的缓存行。成本已支付而不是被预测消除，并且作为门控失败的选取作为选择器成功。BCR 将 GSM8K 恢复到密集预填充准确性，同时仍能通过缓存服务大部分调用，并且其最佳布局在参考网格中优于每个重用基线的平均值。该选取方法在相同预算下也优于随机选择器——这是先前评估所缺乏的对照。
tldr: 现有的跨上下文 KV 缓存重用方法会导致准确性下降。本文提出了预算缓存修复（BCR）方法，通过选择性地重新计算部分缓存行，在保持大部分缓存重用的同时恢复准确性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文揭示了跨上下文 KV 缓存重用中一个被忽视的关键问题——其潜在的准确性成本。通过引入“预算缓存修复”这一创新概念，并细致地分析了不同修复粒度下的效果，论文提供了一个实用的解决方案。其亮点在于将“选择性修复”的思想应用于缓存管理，并通过注意力机制指导修复，这对于提升大型语言模型推理效率和准确性的平衡具有重要意义。同时，实验设计中加入了与随机选择器的对比，增强了结论的说服力。
motivation: 跨上下文 KV 缓存重用在预测共享段的键值时，被认为不会导致质量损失。然而，本文发现这种重用实际上会导致 MMLU 和 GSM8K 上的准确性显著下降，并且现有决定是否重用缓存的规则无法解决这一问题。因此，需要一种方法来修复缓存以消除这种准确性损失。
method: 本文提出了预算缓存修复（BCR）方法。BCR 在选择单元上进行操作，该单元的选择仍然有效（例如单行）。它从已组装的缓存中选取两个 token，根据这些 token 对缓存行的注意力来对缓存行进行排名，并以三种布局之一精确地重新计算固定预算的缓存行。这种方法通过支付计算成本而非预测来修复缓存。
results: BCR 成功将 GSM8K 的准确性恢复到密集预填充水平，同时仍能通过缓存服务大部分调用。其最佳布局在参考网格中优于所有重用基线的平均水平。此外，BCR 的选取方法在相同预算下也优于随机选择。
conclusion: 跨上下文 KV 缓存重用存在隐藏的准确性成本。通过选择性地重新计算缓存的特定部分（即预算缓存修复 BCR），可以在保持缓存重用效率的同时，有效消除准确性损失并恢复到原始性能水平。

title: CORE: COverage CAlibration and Evicted-Mass REdistribution for KV Cache
authors: Shuxin Liu, Qing Liu, Yi Du, Ou Wu
abstract: Long-context decoding is increasingly constrained by key--value (KV) cache memory and bandwidth. Existing fixed-budget compression methods typically separate retention from compensation, while a retention ranking specifies neither discarded attention mass nor the direction of induced output error. We start from an exact factorization: eviction error equals evicted attention mass times the directional gap between the evicted centroid and retained output, highlighting the importance of set-level coverage in retention and mass-preserving memory writing. We introduce CORE COverage Calibration and Evicted-Mass REdistribution for KV Cache, which distills an offline allocation combining query utility and log-determinant coverage into a lightweight cache-aware indexer. At inference, one calibrated distribution drives both channels: its Top-$B$ ordering retains complementary KV states, while its excluded allocation mass and conditional weights parameterize latent-memory writes without a separate write-weight predictor or online log-determinant evaluation. Our analysis provides a four-term pre-compensation error certificate, characterizes non-additive coverage interactions, and establishes mass-independent write stability with hierarchical bounds through recurrent and query-adaptive normalization. Across three backbones, CORE exceeds the strongest RULER baseline by up to 3.78 points at 90\% compression; LongBench and repeated-eviction evaluations further demonstrate strong effectiveness and decoding efficiency.
zh_title: CORE：KV缓存的覆盖率校准和逐出质量重新分配
translation: 长上下文解码日益受到键值（KV）缓存内存和带宽的限制。现有的固定预算压缩方法通常将保留与补偿分开，而保留排名既未指定被丢弃的注意力质量，也未指定引起的输出误差方向。我们从一个精确的分解开始：逐出误差等于被逐出的注意力质量乘以被逐出质心与保留输出之间的方向间隙，这突出了在保留中集合级覆盖的重要性以及质量保持内存写入的重要性。我们引入了CORE（COverage CAlibration and Evicted-Mass REdistribution），用于KV缓存，它将结合查询效用和对数行列式覆盖率的离线分配提炼成一个轻量级的缓存感知索引器。在推理时，一个校准的分布同时驱动两个通道：其Top-B排序保留互补的KV状态，而其排除的分配质量和条件权重参数化潜在内存写入，无需单独的写入权重预测器或在线对数行列式评估。我们的分析提供了四项预补偿误差证明，描述了非加性覆盖交互，并通过循环和查询自适应归一化建立了具有分层边界的质量无关写入稳定性。在三种骨干网络上，CORE在90%压缩率下比最强的RULER基线高出3.78个点；LongBench和重复逐出评估进一步证明了其强大的有效性和解码效率。
tldr: CORE是一种新的KV缓存压缩方法，通过结合查询效用和对数行列式覆盖率来校准分配，并在推理时使用该分配进行状态保留和潜在内存写入，显著提高了长上下文解码的效率和性能。
ai_comments: CORE的创新之处在于其从逐出误差的精确分解入手，并设计了一个统一的校准分布来同时处理KV状态的保留和潜在内存写入，避免了传统方法中保留与补偿分离的弊端。这种方法通过结合查询效用和对数行列式覆盖率，提供了一种更精细和高效的KV缓存管理策略，对于提升长上下文大模型的解码性能具有重要意义。
motivation: 长上下文解码日益受到键值（KV）缓存内存和带宽的限制。现有固定预算的压缩方法通常将保留与补偿分开，且保留排名未能明确被丢弃的注意力质量或引起的输出误差方向。
method: CORE（COverage CAlibration and Evicted-Mass REdistribution）从逐出误差的精确分解开始，引入了一种轻量级的缓存感知索引器。该索引器将离线分配（结合查询效用和对数行列式覆盖率）蒸馏出来。在推理时，一个校准的分布同时驱动两个通道：其Top-B排序保留互补的KV状态，而其排除的分配质量和条件权重参数化潜在内存写入，无需单独的写入权重预测器或在线对数行列式评估。
results: CORE在90%压缩率下，性能比最强的RULER基线高出3.78个点。LongBench和重复逐出评估进一步证明了其强大的有效性和解码效率。分析还提供了四项预补偿误差证明，描述了非加性覆盖交互，并通过循环和查询自适应归一化建立了具有分层边界的质量无关写入稳定性。
conclusion: CORE通过其创新的覆盖率校准和逐出质量重新分配机制，显著提升了长上下文解码中KV缓存的效率和性能，有效解决了内存和带宽限制问题。

title: A Bifurcation-Based Domain Decomposition Method with Neural Operators for Blood Flow Simulation
authors: Yuzhou Zhao, Han Zhang, J. Matias Di Martino, Jean-Michel Morel, Guillermo Sapiro
abstract: Fast and accurate simulation of hemodynamic behavior within vascular networks is essential for numerous clinical applications. However, obtaining high-quality and computationally efficient flow measurements across complex vascular networks remains challenging. To address this, we first decompose the vascular network into a set of bifurcation units and then develop an operator network capable of mapping unit-specific parameters to the local solution fields of each bifurcation unit. By lumping the Windkessel-model outlet parameters and incorporating inlet boundary conditions from the solution of parent units, the flow and pressure fields can be rapidly approximated. Subsequently, operator-network-driven Schwarz waveform relaxation is applied across bifurcation units to correct discontinuities and improve numerical accuracy. On 7-segment and 55-segment arterial tree models, the proposed method achieves $13\times$ to $17\times$ wall-clock speedups over conventional 1D numerical simulation, with relative $L^2$ errors of 1% in both pressure and velocity. The resulting pulse wave velocity biomarkers agree with the conventional reference to within 1--2%, and the same trained operator generalizes to different tree-like 1D vascular network topologies.
zh_title: 一种基于分叉区域分解与神经算子的血流模拟方法
translation: 快速且准确地模拟血管网络内的血流动力学行为对众多临床应用至关重要。然而，在复杂血管网络中获得高质量且计算高效的血流测量仍具挑战。为解决这一问题，我们首先将血管网络分解为一组分叉单元，进而开发了一种能够将单元特定参数映射到各分叉单元局部解场的算子网络。通过集总Windkessel模型出口参数并整合来自父单元解的入口边界条件，可以快速近似流场和压力场。随后，在分叉单元间应用算子网络驱动的Schwarz波形松弛法以修正不连续性并提高数值精度。在7段和55段动脉树模型上，该方法相比传统一维数值模拟实现了13倍至17倍的实际计算加速，且压力和速度的相对L²误差仅为1%。所得脉搏波速度生物标志物与传统参考值的偏差在1%–2%以内，且训练好的同一算子能够泛化至不同的树状一维血管网络拓扑结构。
tldr: 提出结合分叉区域分解、神经算子与Schwarz波形松弛的血流模拟方法，实现13-17倍加速与约1%的高精度。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将计算流体力学中的区域分解（分叉单元）与深度学习中的神经算子相结合，并引入Schwarz波形松弛技术修正边界不连续性。这一框架不仅有效解决了传统1D血管模拟计算耗时的问题，还通过分叉单元模块化设计赋予了模型对不同血管树拓扑的强大泛化能力，对临床实时血流动力学评估具有重要的实用价值。
motivation: 快速且精确的血管网络血流动力学模拟对临床至关重要，但传统的数值模拟方法在面对复杂血管网络时计算成本高昂，难以兼顾高质量与高计算效率。
method: 首先将复杂血管网络分解为多个分叉单元；开发神经算子网络将单元参数映射至局部解场；集总Windkessel出口参数并以父单元解作为入口边界快速求解流动与压力；最后利用算子网络驱动的Schwarz波形松弛法修正单元间的不连续性并提升精度。
results: 在7段和55段动脉树模型上实现了13至17倍的计算加速；压力和速度的相对L2误差保持在1%以内；脉搏波速度误差与参考值相比在1%–2%之间；训练好的神经算子可泛化至不同的树状1D血管网络拓扑。
conclusion: 基于分叉单元分解与神经算子的方法能够在保证数值精度（误差约1%）的前提下显著加速复杂血管网络中的血流动力学模拟，并展现了对未知树状拓扑结构的良好泛化潜力。

title: An Adaptive Heterogeneous Architecture for High-Ratio, High-Throughput Lossless Compression
authors: Zeyu Jia
abstract: Modern lossless data compression enforces an acute dichotomy: industrial streaming codecs (e.g., Zstandard) prioritize throughput (10 to 1000 MiB/s) at the expense of compression density, while context-mixing algorithms achieve superior ratios at unusable serial speeds (0.1 to 1 MiB/s). We present GPX, an adaptive heterogeneous compression architecture for structured data streams. While optimized for high-throughput enterprise and scientific large-block workloads (>= 4 MiB), GPX operates transparently across arbitrary stream lengths down to sub-kilobyte inputs (N >= 256 B). GPX combines a sub-15-microsecond native structural decision probe, GPU-native reversible domain transforms, AVX2 multi-hypothesis sequence optimization, and adaptive entropy boundaries. On the canonical Silesia benchmark (202.12 MiB) under a preregistered 7-repeat Median+IQR protocol (W = 6 workers), GPX Track A produces standard RFC 8878-compliant .zst streams that compress to 56.27 MiB at 235.41 MiB/s with native line-speed decompression (3074.27 MiB/s on unmodified libzstd), establishing non-domination among evaluated RFC 8878-compatible configurations. GPX Track B achieves 54.49 MiB at 259.76 MiB/s (CI [250.7, 287.6]), establishing an empirical Pareto frontier point and dominating Stock Levels 8-14. GPX Track A+B achieves 54.46 MiB at 191.90 MiB/s (CI [177.8, 206.7]), strictly dominating official Stock Zstandard Levels 10-14 under non-overlapping 95% Bootstrap confidence intervals (182.18 KB smaller than Level 14 and 1.15x to 18.70x faster than Levels 10-14). Zero-tuning out-of-sample generalization is confirmed across Canterbury (-0.650%), Calgary (-0.124%), and a 102.45 MB modern compiled binary (-0.246%), while enwik8 (+0.084%) documents the authentic failure mode of splitter over-segmentation. All outputs are 100% SHA-256 bit-exact round-trip verified.
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Under submission to Data Compression Conference (DCC 2027)
zh_title: 一种用于高压缩比、高吞吐量无损压缩的自适应异构架构
translation: 现代无损数据压缩存在一个尖锐的二分法：工业流式编解码器（例如Zstandard）以牺牲压缩密度为代价优先考虑吞吐量（10到1000 MiB/s），而上下文混合算法则以不可用的串行速度（0.1到1 MiB/s）实现卓越的压缩比。我们提出了GPX，一种用于结构化数据流的自适应异构压缩架构。虽然GPX针对高吞吐量的企业和科学大型块工作负载（>= 4 MiB）进行了优化，但它能透明地操作于任意流长度，下至子千字节输入（N >= 256 B）。GPX结合了亚15微秒的原生结构决策探测器、GPU原生可逆域变换、AVX2多假设序列优化和自适应熵边界。在规范的Silesia基准测试（202.12 MiB）中，采用预注册的7次重复Median+IQR协议（W = 6个工作器），GPX Track A生成符合RFC 8878标准的.zst流，压缩到56.27 MiB，吞吐量为235.41 MiB/s，原生线速解压速度为3074.27 MiB/s（在未修改的libzstd上），在评估的RFC 8878兼容配置中建立了非支配地位。GPX Track B实现了54.49 MiB的压缩比和259.76 MiB/s的吞吐量（置信区间[250.7, 287.6]），建立了经验帕累托前沿点并支配了Stock Levels 8-14。GPX Track A+B实现了54.46 MiB的压缩比和191.90 MiB/s的吞吐量（置信区间[177.8, 206.7]），在非重叠的95% Bootstrap置信区间下严格支配了官方Stock Zstandard Levels 10-14（比Level 14小182.18 KB，比Levels 10-14快1.15到18.70倍）。在Canterbury (-0.650%)、Calgary (-0.124%) 和一个102.45 MB的现代编译二进制文件 (-0.246%) 上，零调优的样本外泛化能力得到证实，而enwik8 (+0.084%) 则记录了分割器过度分割的真实失效模式。所有输出均经过100% SHA-256位精确往返验证。
tldr: GPX是一种自适应异构压缩架构，专为结构化数据流设计，旨在解决现有无损压缩技术在压缩比和吞吐量之间的尖锐矛盾，实现了高压缩比和高吞吐量的平衡。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的自适应异构架构GPX，有效地弥合了现有无损压缩技术在压缩比和吞吐量之间的巨大鸿沟。其创新点在于结合了多种硬件加速和算法优化技术（如GPU、AVX2），实现了高性能的同时保持了高压缩比。GPX在大型块数据压缩方面的表现尤为突出，对需要兼顾速度和效率的企业及科学计算领域具有重要意义。论文详细的实验结果和对泛化能力的验证增加了其可信度，但对于不同类型数据（特别是非结构化数据）的普适性及架构的复杂性可能是未来需要进一步探讨的方面。
motivation: 现代无损数据压缩存在一个尖锐的二分法：工业流式编解码器（如Zstandard）以牺牲压缩密度为代价优先考虑吞吐量（10到1000 MiB/s），而上下文混合算法则以不可用的串行速度（0.1到1 MiB/s）实现卓越的压缩比。本文旨在弥合这一差距，提供一种同时实现高压缩比和高吞吐量的解决方案。
method: 本文提出了GPX，一种用于结构化数据流的自适应异构压缩架构。GPX结合了：1. 亚15微秒的原生结构决策探测器；2. GPU原生可逆域变换；3. AVX2多假设序列优化；4. 自适应熵边界。它透明地操作于任意流长度，从子千字节输入（N >= 256 B）到大型块工作负载（>= 4 MiB）。
results: 在Silesia基准测试中，GPX Track A生成符合RFC 8878标准的.zst流，压缩到56.27 MiB，吞吐量为235.41 MiB/s，原生解压速度为3074.27 MiB/s。GPX Track B实现了54.49 MiB的压缩比和259.76 MiB/s的吞吐量，建立了经验帕累托前沿点并超越了Stock Levels 8-14。GPX Track A+B实现了54.46 MiB的压缩比和191.90 MiB/s的吞吐量，严格超越了官方Stock Zstandard Levels 10-14（比Level 14小182.18 KB，比Levels 10-14快1.15到18.70倍）。在Canterbury、Calgary和现代编译二进制文件上的泛化能力得到证实，enwik8则揭示了分割器过度分割的失效模式。所有输出均通过SHA-256位精确往返验证。
conclusion: GPX架构通过结合多种先进技术，成功地在无损数据压缩领域实现了高压缩比和高吞吐量的平衡，超越了现有主流工业级和高压缩比算法，为企业和科学大型块工作负载提供了高效的解决方案。

title: Calibrating the Checksum: An Empirical False-Positive Bound for One-Sided ABFT on bfloat16 GEMM, and What It Fails to Catch
authors: Gautam Khosla
abstract: Algorithm-based fault tolerance detects corrupted matrix multiplications by comparing a checksum of the product against a checksum recomputed from the factors, flagging a fault when the residual exceeds a threshold. The classical threshold is tau = Ku, derived from a dot-product rounding bound that requires Ku <= 0.01. At bfloat16 with contraction length K = 4096, Ku is approximately 32, so the bound does not hold and the threshold is not defined. Prior work therefore evaluated checksum ABFT only at float32. We supply the missing calibration. This paper is a characterization of a detector under an output-level, post-GEMM perturbation model; it is not a characterization of faults in silicon, and no rate reported here estimates fault incidence in deployed hardware. We fit a Generalized Pareto distribution to 7.99e7 clean per-row residuals and extrapolate a threshold at a per-GEMM false-positive rate of 1e-6, obtaining 3.1445e-6, which sits between the two clean sample maxima we observed. The independence assumption behind the per-GEMM conversion is checked empirically rather than asserted, at a variance ratio of 0.985 against a binomial reference. Against this threshold the detector catches 304 of 400 single exponent-bit flips (76%), failing a bar of 90% that was registered before any data was collected, and catches 0 of 600 low-mantissa flips. Detectability is invariant in K across a 16x range even though the clean noise floor falls as K^-0.4999: signal and floor scale together, so bit position governs detectability and contraction length does not. This falsified the mechanism the study was designed around. We report four registered predictions that failed, including that one, and four retractions of our own earlier findings, two of which were caught by pre-publication audit rather than by prediction. Code, data, and timestamped pre-registration documents are released.
comment: 15 pages. Code, data, and pre-registration documents at https://github.com/GautamTalksDev/assay-gpu (tag v0.1.1-paper). Also available at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22054179
zh_title: 校准校验和：针对bfloat16 GEMM单边ABFT的经验假阳性边界及其无法捕获的内容
translation: 算法容错通过将乘积的校验和与从因子重新计算的校验和进行比较来检测损坏的矩阵乘法，当残差超过阈值时标记故障。经典阈值是 $\tau = Ku$，源自点积舍入边界，该边界要求 $Ku \le 0.01$。在收缩长度 $K = 4096$ 的 bfloat16 下，$Ku$ 约为 32，因此该边界不成立，阈值未定义。因此先前的研究仅在 float32 上评估了校验和 ABFT。我们提供了缺失的校准。本文是对输出级、GEMM 后扰动模型下检测器的表征；它不是对硅中故障的表征，此处报告的任何比率都不能估计部署硬件中的故障发生率。我们向 $7.99\times 10^7$ 个干净的每行残差拟合了广义帕累托分布，并外推了每个 GEMM 假阳性率为 $1\times 10^{-6}$ 的阈值，得到 $3.1445\times 10^{-6}$，它位于我们观察到的两个干净样本最大值之间。针对二项式参考，以 $0.985$ 的方差比经验性地检查了每个 GEMM 转换背后的独立性假设，而不是断言。在此阈值下，检测器捕获了 400 个单指数位翻转中的 304 个（76%），未达到在收集任何数据之前注册的 90% 的标准，并且捕获了 0 个（共 600 个）低尾数位翻转。在 16 倍范围内，可检测性在 $K$ 中是不变的，尽管干净的噪声底限随 $K^{-0.4999}$ 下降：信号和底限同步缩放，因此位位置决定了可检测性，而收缩长度则没有。这证伪了该研究围绕其设计机制。我们报告了四个失败的注册预测，包括那个预测，以及我们自己先前发现的四个撤回，其中两个是通过发表前审计而不是预测捕获的。代码、数据和带时间戳的预注册文件已发布。
tldr: 本文为bfloat16矩阵乘法中的ABFT校验和机制提供了经验性的假阳性阈值校准，但发现其对低尾数位翻转检测彻底失效，推翻了多项前置假设。
ai_comments: 本文针对bfloat16低精度矩阵乘法下经典算法容错（ABFT）校验和失效的问题，通过经验分布拟合提供了首个校准方案，并以严谨的预注册实验戳穿了多项直觉假设，展示了硬件容错研究中严格实证检验的重要性。
motivation: 经典ABFT阈值在bfloat16且较大收缩长度（如K=4096）时失效，导致此前该技术仅在float32上被评估，因此需要为bfloat16补全缺失的校准方案并探究其检测效能。
method: 基于输出端后GEMM扰动模型，利用7.99e7个干净的每行残差拟合广义帕累托分布，外推得出在1e-6假阳性率下的阈值，并进行经验性独立性检验与故障注入测试。
results: 外推得出1e-6假阳性率下的阈值为3.1445e-6；该检测器能捕获76%的单指数位翻转，但无法捕获任何低尾数位翻转；检测能力与收缩长度K无关，推翻了原先的设计机制与四项预注册预测。
conclusion: 在bfloat16 GEMM中，通过广义帕累托分布拟合可以校准出有效的ABFT校验和阈值，但该检测器在面对低尾数位翻转时完全失效，且检测能力由位位置而非收缩长度决定，推翻了多项先验假设。

title: Hardware-Native Joint Sparse-Quantization for Trillion-Scale Mixture-of-Experts
authors: Kwanhee Lee, Namhoon Lee, Dan Alistarh
abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures allow frontier language models to scale to trillions of parameters, but their deployment is constrained by massive memory footprints and memory-bandwidth limitations. Although modern accelerators provide Sparse Tensor Cores (SpTCs) that reduce weight storage and increase throughput through low-precision semi-structured sparsity, exploiting them for MoEs remains challenging because of substantial model-quality degradation and the lack of grouped sparse GEMM primitives. We present an end-to-end hardware-software co-design framework that compresses expert weights into hardware-native, low-precision sparse representations and accelerates their execution on SpTCs. Algorithmically, our framework relaxes discrete semi-structured support selection through continuous reparameterization, enabling differentiable joint optimization with quantized weights under a router-weighted reconstruction objective and scalable expert-parallel compression. Systemically, we develop a custom grouped sparse GEMM kernel tailored to low-precision sparse MoE inference on SpTCs. Across MoE models ranging from 30 billion to one trillion parameters, our framework improves state-of-the-art joint sparse-quantization accuracy by up to 4.35 percentage points while preserving 96.09% of the original model's performance. On NVIDIA B200 GPUs, our kernel outperforms the vendor baseline by up to $1.65\times$, increasing serving throughput by $1.18\times$ and reducing end-to-end latency by up to $4.03\times$. These results establish hardware-software co-design as a practical path toward scalable and efficient MoE deployment.
zh_title: 面向万亿规模混合专家模型的硬件原生联合稀疏量化
translation: 混合专家（MoE）架构允许前沿语言模型扩展到万亿参数，但其部署受到巨大内存占用和内存带宽限制的制约。尽管现代加速器提供了稀疏张量核心（SpTCs），通过低精度半结构化稀疏性减少权重存储并提高吞吐量，但由于显着的模型质量下降以及缺乏分组稀疏GEMM原语，在MoE中利用它们仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种端到端的软硬件协同设计框架，将专家权重压缩为硬件原生、低精度的稀疏表示，并加速其在SpTCs上的执行。在算法上，我们的框架通过连续重参数化放松了离散的半结构化支持选择，在路由器加权重建目标和可扩展的专家并行压缩下，实现了与量化权重的可微分联合优化。在系统上，我们开发了一个专为SpTCs上的低精度稀疏MoE推理定制的分组稀疏GEMM内核。在参数量从300亿到1万亿的MoE模型中，我们的框架将最先进的联合稀疏量化准确率提高了高达4.35个百分点，同时保留了原始模型96.09%的性能。在NVIDIA B200 GPU上，我们的内核比厂商基准性能提升高达1.65倍，服务吞吐量提高了1.18倍，端到端延迟降低了高达4.03倍。这些结果确立了软硬件协同设计作为实现可扩展且高效的MoE部署的实用途径。
tldr: 提出一种软硬件协同的联合稀疏量化框架与定制内核，显著提升了万亿级MoE模型在硬件上的推理性能与准确率。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种软硬件协同设计的端到端框架，解决了万亿规模混合专家（MoE）模型在硬件上部署时面临的内存带宽瓶颈和稀疏量化精度下降问题。通过连续重参数化实现可微分的联合优化，并开发了定制的分组稀疏GEMM内核，在NVIDIA B200 GPU上取得了显著的吞吐量提升和延迟降低。
motivation: 尽管混合专家（MoE）架构允许前沿语言模型扩展到万亿参数，但其部署受到巨大内存占用和内存带宽限制的制约；现有的硬件稀疏张量核心（SpTCs）在应用于MoE时会导致模型质量严重下降，且缺乏分组稀疏GEMM原语。
method: 提出了一种端到端软硬件协同设计框架：在算法上，通过连续重参数化放松离散的半结构化支持选择，实现在路由器加权重建目标下的可微分联合优化；在系统上，开发了针对低精度稀疏MoE推理定制的分组稀疏GEMM内核。
results: 在300亿到1万亿参数的MoE模型上，该框架将最先进的联合稀疏量化准确率提升了高达4.35个百分点，同时保留了96.09%的原始模型性能；在NVIDIA B200 GPUs上，定制内核比厂商基准提升了高达1.65倍，服务吞吐量提升了1.18倍，端到端延迟降低了高达4.03倍。
conclusion: 该论文通过软硬件协同设计，实现了万亿级MoE模型的高效、高精度稀疏量化部署，为未来大模型的边缘或加速推理提供了可行的实践路径。

title: Nearest-neighbour baselines for fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra under different assumptions
authors: Ling Min Serena Khoo
abstract: It has recently been shown that nearest-neighbour retrieval provides a strong baseline for molecular fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra, with several variants matching or outperforming current deep learning models (Khoo and Barzilay, 2026; Liu et al., 2026; Gupta et al., 2026). Importantly, "nearest neighbour" encompasses a family of retrieval methods that differ in the information assumed to be available at inference. In this report, we systematically compare several nearest-neighbour variants and show how these differing assumptions affect performance. Our goal is to establish stricter baselines that enable more rigorous benchmarking and better measure progress in this area.
zh_title: 不同假设下基于MS/MS光谱进行指纹预测的最近邻基线方法
translation: 最近的研究表明，最近邻检索为根据MS/MS光谱预测分子指纹提供了一个强有力的基线，其几种变体能够匹配或超越当前的深度学习模型（Khoo和Barzilay，2026年；Liu等人，2026年；Gupta等人，2026年）。重要的是，“最近邻”包含了一系列检索方法，这些方法在假设推断时可用信息方面有所不同。在本报告中，我们系统地比较了几种最近邻变体，并展示了这些不同的假设如何影响性能。我们的目标是建立更严格的基线，以便进行更严格的基准测试，并更好地衡量该领域的进展。
tldr: 本文系统比较了质谱指纹预测中不同最近邻检索基线变体，旨在明确推断假设对性能的影响并建立更严格的基准。
ai_comments: 该论文对质谱指纹预测中最近邻基线方法进行了系统比较，澄清了不同推断假设对性能的影响，对于建立更严格的评估标准具有重要意义。
motivation: 最近邻检索已被证明是根据MS/MS光谱进行分子指纹预测的强大基线，且包含多种变体。然而，这些变体在推断时所依赖的假设信息各不相同，因此需要系统比较以了解这些假设如何影响性能，从而建立更严格的基准。
method: 系统地比较了多种不同的最近邻检索变体，考察了它们在推断时假设不同可用信息情况下的性能表现。
results: 展示了不同的推断假设如何显著影响最近邻变体的性能，为该领域提供了更严格的评估基线。
conclusion: 系统评估了不同推断假设下的最近邻变体，旨在建立更严格的基线，从而促进质谱指纹预测领域的严格基准测试与进展衡量。

title: State-Space Unlearning for Non-Stationary Bias in Land Surface Forecasting
authors: Anidipta Pal
abstract: Operational land surface forecasting systems built on Mamba-family Structured State Space Models absorb non-stationary confounding events (unrecorded irrigation booms, dam-operation shifts, sensor recalibrations) into their state-transition matrices, silently biasing NDVI, LST, and crop phenology predictions long after the physical cause ends. This paper introduces SSU-LSF (State-Space Unlearning for Land Surface Forecasting), the first machine-unlearning framework purpose-built for geoscientific Mamba-based SSMs. We develop EKFac influence functions specialized to the Mamba state matrices via a closed-form matrix-exponential gradient, use spectral-radius-weighted elbow thresholding to localize a temporal confounding footprint $Φ$, and apply Hessian-free projected gradient ascent within a KL-divergence trust region augmented by spatial total-variation (TV) regularization. Proposition 1 establishes that residual confounding is bounded by $\mathcal{O}\big((1-ρ(\bar{A})^{T_c})/((1-ρ(\bar{A}))μ)\big)$, which grows with the window length $T_c$. Across three heterogeneous benchmarks and eleven baselines, SSU-LSF achieves confounding reduction rates of $0.773$ (CropHarvest), $0.821$ (NDVI-LST), and $0.859$ (ERA5), with worst-case clean-domain RMSE degradation of $4.2\%$ on ERA5, converging in 3--5 epochs at $8.4\times$ lower GPU-cost per unlearning request than full retraining. Code: https://github.com/Anidipta/SSU-LSF
zh_title: 陆面预测中非平稳偏差的状态空间遗忘方法
translation: 基于Mamba家族结构化状态空间模型的业务化陆面预测系统，会将非平稳混杂事件（如未记录的灌溉潮、大坝运行变化、传感器重新校准）吸收进其状态转移矩阵中，导致在物理原因结束很久之后，仍对归一化植被指数（NDVI）、地表温度（LST）和作物物候预测产生隐性偏差。本文引入了SSU-LSF（陆面预测的状态空间遗忘方法），这是首个专为地球科学基于Mamba的SSM量身定制的机器学习遗忘框架。我们通过闭式矩阵指数梯度开发了专用于Mamba状态矩阵的EKFac影响函数，使用谱半径加权肘部阈值定位时间混杂足迹 $\Phi$，并在由空间全变分（TV）正则化增强的KL散度信任域内应用无Hessian的投影梯度上升。命题1证明了残余混杂受 $\mathcal{O}\big((1-\rho(\bar{A})^{T_c})/((1-\rho(\bar{A}))\mu)\big)$ 的约束，该值随窗口长度 $T_c$ 的增加而增长。在三个异构基准和十一个基线模型中，SSU-LSF在CropHarvest、NDVI-LST和ERA5上的混杂消除率分别达到了 $0.773$、$0.821$ 和 $0.859$，ERA5上最坏情况下的干净域RMSE退化为 $4.2\%$，在3-5个epoch内收敛，且每次遗忘请求的GPU成本比完全重新训练低 $8.4$ 倍。代码地址：https://github.com/Anidipta/SSU-LSF
tldr: 提出首个针对地学Mamba模型的机器学习遗忘框架（SSU-LSF），能高效、精准地消除陆面预测中的非平稳混杂偏差，且计算成本远低于重新训练。
ai_comments: 本文针对基于Mamba的状态空间模型在陆面预测中由于非平稳混杂事件导致的长期偏差问题，首次提出了地学领域的机器学习遗忘框架SSU-LSF。其创新点在于结合了EKFac影响函数、谱半径加权肘部阈值定位以及Hessian-free投影梯度上升，兼顾了高效性与空间正则化。该研究在计算效率和混杂消除率方面表现优异，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 基于Mamba家族的业务化陆面预测系统会将非平稳混杂事件（如未记录的灌溉潮、大坝运行变化、传感器重新校准）吸收进其状态转移矩阵中，导致物理原因结束后很久仍对NDVI、LST和作物物候预测产生隐性偏差。为此，需要开发专用的机器学习遗忘框架。
method: 开发了专用于Mamba状态矩阵的EKFac影响函数（通过闭式矩阵指数梯度），使用谱半径加权肘部阈值定位时间混杂足迹，并在KL散度信任域内应用Hessian-free投影梯度上升，结合空间全变分（TV）正则化。
results: 在三个异构基准测试和十一个基线模型上，SSU-LSF实现的混杂消除率分别为0.773（CropHarvest）、0.821（NDVI-LST）和0.859（ERA5），ERA5上的最坏情况干净域RMSE退化仅为4.2%，在3-5个epoch内收敛，且每次遗忘请求的GPU成本比完全重新训练低8.4倍。
conclusion: SSU-LSF框架通过高效的状态空间遗忘机制，成功解决了陆面预测中Mamba模型因非平稳混杂事件导致的长期预测偏差问题，在保证干净域性能的同时大幅降低了计算成本。

title: Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling for Diffusion Draft Trees
authors: Marcello Bullo, Yanxiao Liu, Öykü Sıla Güner, Arpan Mukherjee, Deniz Gündüz
abstract: Speculative sampling accelerates diffusion generation by verifying inexpensive draft states in parallel while preserving the target law. Recent tree-based methods allocate the parallel compute budget more effectively than single-chain drafts, as demonstrated by Diffusion Greedy Rejection Sampling (D-GRS). D-GRS generates $K$ conditionally independent candidates per node, and sequentially tests them in their generation order. Yet the sampled candidates admit an informative ranking without additional target-model evaluations. To exploit this, we introduce Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling (RASS), a verification rule for speculative draft trees based on rank-aware list coupling. RASS orders draft candidates along the proposal-target mean displacement and samples a rank with weights optimized to minimize total variation between the selected-proposal and target laws. Finally, the selected candidate is maximally coupled with the target, with residual correction ensuring exact sampling for any choice of rank weights. We evaluate RASS on a Gaussian-mixture target, unconditional pixel-space generation on FFHQ, conditional generation on CIFAR-10, and latent diffusion with Stable Diffusion 3.5 using COCO2014 prompts. Measured by the ratio of standard to speculative sampling's target-model evaluation counts, RASS improves on D-GRS across the evaluated settings, with gains reaching approximately 20% on CIFAR-10 at matched compute budgets.
zh_title: 用于扩散草稿树的排名感知投机采样
translation: 投机采样通过并行验证廉价的草稿状态来加速扩散生成，同时保持目标定律不变。最近的基于树的方法比单链草稿更有效地分配并行计算预算，正如扩散贪婪拒绝采样（D-GRS）所证明的那样。D-GRS每个节点生成$K$个条件独立的候选，并按生成顺序依次测试它们。然而，采样的候选在无需额外目标模型评估的情况下包含了一个信息丰富的排名。为了利用这一点，我们引入了排名感知投机采样（RASS），这是一种基于排名感知列表耦合的投机草稿树验证规则。RASS沿着提议-目标均值位移对草稿候选进行排序，并对采样排名进行加权优化，以最小化所选提议与目标定律之间的总变差。最后，所选候选与目标进行最大耦合，并通过残差校正确保对任意排名权重的精确采样。我们在高斯混合目标、FFHQ上的无条件像素空间生成、CIFAR-10上的条件生成以及使用COCO2014提示词的Stable Diffusion 3.5潜空间扩散上评估了RASS。以标准采样与投机采样目标模型评估次数的比率为衡量标准，RASS在所有评估设置中均优于D-GRS，在匹配计算预算的情况下，在CIFAR-10上的性能提升达到了约20%。
tldr: 提出了一种名为RASS的扩散模型投机采样验证规则，通过利用草稿候选的排名信息来优化计算效率，在保持生成质量的同时显著加速了扩散过程。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的基于排名的投机采样验证规则（RASS），通过对扩散草稿树的候选状态进行排序和加权优化，有效提升了扩散模型生成的加速比，创新点明确且实验评估充分。
motivation: 现有的树状扩散投机采样方法（如D-GRS）在节点处生成多个条件独立候选并按生成顺序测试，但未能充分利用候选状态中蕴含的丰富排名信息，因此需要一种更高效的排名感知验证规则来提升计算预算的分配效率。
method: 引入排序感知列表耦合（rank-aware list coupling）验证规则，沿提议-目标均值位移对草稿候选进行排序，并优化排名权重以最小化总变差，同时通过最大耦合与残差校正确保精确采样。
results: 在高斯混合目标、FFHQ像素空间生成、CIFAR-10条件生成以及Stable Diffusion 3.5潜空间生成等多种实验设置下，RASS相较于D-GRS取得了显著提升，在CIFAR-10上计算预算相同时加速比提升了约20%。
conclusion: RASS通过利用草稿候选状态的自然排名信息并结合最大耦合与残差校正，在保持目标分布不变的同时，显著提升了扩散模型投机采样的效率。

title: Counterfactual Predictions in Scientific Emulators Without Controlled Experiments
authors: Dingling Yao, Kahaan Gandhi, Valentin Duruisseaux, Boris Bonev, Francesco Locatello, Anima Anandkumar
abstract: Many scientific questions require reasoning about what was never observed: What if the conditions, interventions, or history had been different? Models can predict accurately on observed data yet fail on such what-if queries when correlated inputs are varied independently. A common remedy is to add controlled simulation data in which these factors are explicitly disentangled, but this requires access to a simulator, can be computationally expensive, and inherits the simulator's modeling assumptions. We introduce ReRoute, a framework for targeted scientific what-if prediction that combines factual data with partial mechanistic knowledge, without requiring controlled intervention data for adaptation. ReRoute fixes the queried input of a pretrained backbone to a reference value, reintroduces its variation through a known mechanistic pathway, and fine-tunes on the original factual data, while leaving downstream effects to the learned dynamics. We provide a causal identification result for this construction under explicit structural assumptions, with the core argument machine-checked in Lean. After showing that ReRoute achieves highly accurate counterfactual predictions in a controlled advection-diffusion system where exact responses are available, we turn to state-of-the-art climate emulation. On held-out coupled-climate interventions, ReRoute reduces aggregate climate error by 18.2-31.8% under severe CO$_2$ distribution shifts while preserving skill under standard conditions, at a small fraction of the cost of retraining on additional controlled simulations, without even accounting for the substantial expense of generating such data. Finally, on an emulator trained from historical ERA5 reanalysis, where no counterfactual reference exists, ReRoute preserves substantially more of the surface warming implied by the observed boundary conditions under a fixed-CO$_2$ counterfactual.
zh_title: 无需控制实验的科学模拟器反事实预测
translation: 许多科学问题需要推理从未观测到的情况：如果条件、干预措施或历史不同会怎样？模型可以对观测数据进行准确预测，但当相关输入独立变化时，在这些假设查询（what-if queries）上往往会失败。一个常见的补救措施是添加受控模拟数据，在这些数据中明确解耦这些因素，但这需要访问模拟器、计算成本高昂，并且继承了模拟器的建模 assumptions。我们引入了 ReRoute，这是一个用于有针对性的科学假设预测的框架，它将事实数据与部分机理知识相结合，而不需要用于适应的受控干预数据。ReRoute 将预训练主干网络的查询输入固定为参考值，通过已知的机理路径重新引入其变化，并在原始真实数据上进行微调，同时将下游效应留给已学习的动力学。我们在显式结构假设下提供了这种构造的因果识别结果，其核心论点在 Lean 中进行了机器检查。在证明了 ReRoute 在可以获得精确响应的受控平流-扩散系统中实现高度准确的反事实预测之后，我们转向了最先进的气候模拟。在保留的耦合气候干预中，在严重的 $CO_2$ 分布偏移下，ReRoute 将总体气候误差降低了 18.2-31.8%，同时在标准条件下保持了技能，只需花费重新训练附加受控模拟的一小部分成本（甚至没有计入生成此类数据的巨大开销）。最后，在从历史 ERA5 再分析训练的模拟器上（其中不存在反事实参考），在固定 $CO_2$ 的反事实情况下，ReRoute 保留了观测边界条件所暗示的更多的表面变暖。
tldr: 无需控制实验数据，ReRoute 通过结合机理知识与真实数据，提升了科学模拟器在反事实预测（如气候模拟中的 what-if 查询）中的准确性。
ai_comments: 本文提出的 ReRoute 框架巧妙地结合了部分机理知识与真实数据，无需昂贵的控制实验数据即可进行科学模拟器的反事实预测，并在气候模拟等任务中验证了其有效性，具有重要的应用价值。
motivation: 许多科学问题需要进行反事实推理（即假设分析），但现有模型在独立变化相关输入时往往会失效；虽然添加控制模拟数据可以解决该问题，但这需要访问模拟器、计算成本高昂且继承了模拟器的建模假设，因此需要在没有控制干预数据的情况下进行有针对性的科学反事实预测。
method: 引入了 ReRoute 框架，将预训练主干网络的查询输入固定为参考值，通过已知的机理路径重新引入其变化，并在原始真实数据上进行微调，同时保留下游效应的已学动力学。
results: 在受控平流扩散系统中实现了高准确率的反事实预测；在气候模拟中，在严重的 CO$_2$ 分布偏移下将总体气候误差降低了 18.2-31.8%，且成本远低于重新训练控制模拟；在基于历史 ERA5 再分析训练的模拟器上，在固定 CO$_2$ 的反事实情况下保持了更多的表面变暖。
conclusion: ReRoute 框架通过将预训练主干网络与已知机理路径相结合并在原始真实数据上进行微调，能够在无需控制干预数据的情况下实现准确的科学反事实预测。

title: Approximation Property of Dropout Neural Networks: Sobolev Rates and Confidence Bounds
authors: Jia-He Yao
abstract: The universal approximation property of dropout neural networks does not by itself describe the network size required for an accurate random realization. In this work, we study approximation of the unit ball of $W^{n,\infty}([0,1]^d)$ by ReLU networks whose edges are retained independently with probability $p$. The approximation error is measured uniformly over the input domain, and the guarantee holds with probability at least $1-δ$ for a single sampled network. We construct networks of constant depth and size $\widetilde O_{n,d}(p^{-9}\varepsilon^{-\max\{d/n,2\}} \log(1/δ))$. The construction combines bounded local subnetworks, localization on a successful approximation event, and a multiscale Taylor decomposition. Conversely, Sobolev capacity imposes a lower bound on the number of surviving edges, while approximation of a fixed affine function requires an output-layer cost of order $((1-p)/p)\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ)$ at sufficiently high confidence. For fixed $p\in(0,1)$ and $δ<\min\{1/2,1-p\}$, the upper and lower bounds match in the accuracy exponent under a fixed or logarithmic depth budget. When $d\leq2n$, they also match in confidence up to logarithms of accuracy. We extend the lower bounds to $W^{n,r}$ targets with $L^s$ error, and distinguish this extension from the upper bound for $W^{n,\infty}$. The optimal retention dependence and logarithmic factors remain open.
zh_title: Dropout神经网络的逼近性质：Sobolev速率与置信界
translation: Dropout神经网络的通用逼近性质本身并不能描述精确随机 realization 所需的网络规模。在这项工作中，我们研究了由边缘以独立概率 $p$ 保留的ReLU网络对 $W^{n,\infty}([0,1]^d)$ 单位球的逼近。逼近误差在输入域上一致测量，并且该保证对于单个采样网络以至少 $1-\delta$ 的概率成立。我们构造了常数深度且大小为 $\widetilde O_{n,d}(p^{-9}\varepsilon^{-\max\{d/n,2\}} \log(1/δ))$ 的网络。该构造结合了有界局部子网络、成功逼近事件的局部化以及多尺度泰勒展开。相反，Sobolev容量对存活边的数量施加了下界，而在足够高的置信度下，逼近固定仿شن函数需要阶为 $((1-p)/p)\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ)$ 的输出层代价。对于固定的 $p\in(0,1)$ 且 $\delta<\min\{1/2,1-p\}$，在固定或对数深度预算下，上下界在精度指数上相匹配。当 $d\leq2n$ 时，它们在置信度上也能匹配到精度的对数阶。我们将下界扩展到了带有 $L^s$ 误差的 $W^{n,r}$ 目标，并将此扩展与 $W^{n,\infty}$ 的上界区分开来。最佳保留依赖性和对数因子仍然是开放问题。
tldr: 该论文研究了Dropout ReLU神经网络在Sobolev空间中的逼近能力，确定了达到特定精度和置信度所需的网络规模上下界。
ai_comments: 该论文在Dropout神经网络的理论分析方面做出了重要贡献，首次给出了Sobolev空间下Dropout网络逼近误差的显式网络规模上下界，并将概率保证与确定性逼近误差结合起来，兼具理论深度和严谨性。
motivation: 传统的Dropout神经网络泛逼近性质并未说明实现精确随机 realization 所需的网络规模，因此需要研究Dropout ReLU网络在Sobolev空间中逼近性能及置信区间的精确网络规模需求。
method: 利用有界局部子网络、成功逼近事件的局部化以及多尺度泰勒展开构造网络，并通过分析Sobolev容量和固定仿射函数的输出层代价推导下界。
results: 在固定深度和对数深度预算下，给出了常数深度、大小为 $\widetilde O_{n,d}(p^{-9}\varepsilon^{-\max\{d/n,2\}} \log(1/δ))$ 的网络上界构造，并在特定条件下证明了上下界在精度指数上相匹配。
conclusion: 通过构造性证明与下界推导，论文刻画了Dropout ReLU网络在Sobolev单位球逼近中的最优容量需求、网络规模、概率界限及其相互依赖关系。

title: MACTS-EM: Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory
authors: Ahmad Shahi, Mamehgol Yousefi
abstract: Time series forecasting remains a critical challenge across numerous domains. Despite significant advancements, existing approaches struggle with complex phenomena such as regime shifts, cross-domain knowledge transfer, and multimodal data integration. This paper introduces Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory (MACTS-EM), a novel framework where specialised agents collaborate to achieve superior forecasting performance. The MACTS-EM architecture integrates: (1) domain-specialised forecasting agents for pattern recognition, anomaly detection, causal inference, and uncertainty quantification; (2) a meta-cognitive layer for dynamic agent allocation; (3) an emergent memory mechanism enabling cross-domain pattern transfer; (4) multimodal contextual integration; and (5) adversarial robustness components. Evaluation across financial markets, climate patterns, energy consumption, and pandemic propagation demonstrates that MACTS-EM outperforms existing approaches in most scenarios, with 8-12% improvement in forecasting accuracy, 22-27% better zero-shot transfer capability, 16-21% enhanced resilience during regime shifts, and 15-18% faster recovery after distribution shifts. Our findings suggest that collaborative, agentic approaches to time series forecasting represent a promising direction beyond traditional architectures, particularly for complex real-world scenarios requiring multi-resolution temporal understanding and contextual adaptation.
zh_title: MACTS-EM：具有突现记忆的多智能体协作时间序列预测
translation: 时间序列预测仍然是众多领域中的一项严峻挑战。尽管取得了显著进展，但现有方法在应对状态转变、跨域知识迁移和多模态数据集成等复杂现象时仍显力不从心。本文介绍了MACTS-EM（具有突现记忆的多智能体协作时间序列预测），这是一个新颖的框架，通过专业智能体的协作来实现卓越的预测性能。MACTS-EM架构整合了：（1）用于模式识别、异常检测、因果推断和不确定性量化的领域专用预测智能体；（2）用于动态智能体分配的元认知层；（3）实现跨域模式迁移的突现记忆机制；（4）多模态上下文集成；以及（5）对抗鲁棒性组件。在金融市场、气候模式、能源消耗和疫情传播方面的评估表明，MACTS-EM在多数场景下优于现有方法，预测准确率提升了8-12%，零样本迁移能力提升了22-27%，在状态转变期间的韧性增强了16-21%，在分布转变后的恢复速度加快了15-18%。我们的研究结果表明，协作的、基于智能体的时间序列预测方法代表了超越传统架构的有前景的方向，特别适用于需要多分辨率时间理解和上下文适应的复杂真实世界场景。
tldr: 提出了一种名为MACTS-EM的多智能体协作时间序列预测框架，利用突现记忆和专业智能体协作显著提升了预测精度、泛化能力和鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将多智能体协作与突现记忆机制引入时间序列预测领域，通过引入元认知层、跨域模式迁移及对抗鲁棒性组件，显著提升了模型在复杂真实场景下的泛化能力和预测精度，代表了时间序列预测方法的一个重要新方向。
motivation: 现有时间序列预测方法在处理复杂现象（如状态转变、跨域知识迁移和多模态数据集成）时表现不佳，难以满足复杂真实场景的需求。
method: 提出了MACTS-EM架构，集成五个核心部分：1）领域专门化预测智能体；2）用于动态智能体分配的元认知层；3）实现跨域模式迁移的突现记忆机制；4）多模态上下文集成；5）对抗鲁棒性组件。
results: 在金融市场、气候模式、能源消耗和疫情传播等场景的评估中，MACTS-EM在多数情况下超越现有方法：预测准确率提升8-12%，零样本迁移能力提升22-27%，状态转变期间的鲁棒性增强16-21%，分布转变后的恢复速度加快15-18%。
conclusion: 基于协作智能体和突现记忆的多智能体框架（MACTS-EM）在时间序列预测中展现出显著的性能优势，特别适合应对复杂真实世界场景中的多分辨率时间理解和上下文适应。

title: TRACE: A Reproducible Benchmark for Electricity Price Forecasting with Official Operational Text
authors: Xinyi Yi, Moy Yuan, Ioannis Lestas
abstract: Electricity price forecasting (EPF) supports scheduling, bidding, and risk management in electricity markets, yet existing benchmarks focus mainly on numerical inputs, leaving the forecasting value of forecast-time textual context insufficiently evaluated. We introduce TRACE, a reproducible benchmark of 7,300 zone--day instances pairing prices from five zones in a major U.S. market with official operational text available at the forecast cutoff. TRACE reconstructs official operational text at each cutoff, preventing post-cutoff information leakage. We evaluate TRACE for semantic alignment and forecasting value. Semantic assessments align with central movement and both tail risks in ground-truth prices, most consistently for upper-tail price risk. Forecasting value is reflected in a median 7.4\% reduction in upper-tail pinball loss across time-series foundation models. A controlled cross-day text-mismatch ablation reverses the gains, falling below the no-text baseline.
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Time Series (FMTS)
zh_title: TRACE：一个基于官方运营文本的可复现电力价格预测基准
translation: 电力价格预测（EPF）支持电力市场的调度、竞价和风险管理，然而现有的基准主要集中在数值输入上，使得预测时文本上下文的预测价值评估不足。我们引入了TRACE，这是一个包含7,300个区域-天实例的可复现基准，将美国主要市场五个区域的价格与预测截止时可用的官方运营文本进行配对。TRACE在每个截止点重建官方运营文本，防止了截止后的信息泄漏。我们对TRACE的语义对齐和预测价值进行了评估。语义评估与真实价格的中心运动和双尾风险保持一致，对上尾价格风险最为一致。预测价值体现在时间序列基础模型中上尾分位数损失中位数减少了7.4%。受控的跨天文本不匹配消融实验逆转了这些收益，甚至低于无文本基准。
tldr: 论文提出了TRACE基准，通过引入官方运营文本，显著提升了时间序列基础模型对电力价格（特别是上尾风险）的预测能力。
ai_comments: 该论文填补了电力价格预测中缺乏官方运营文本基准的空白，通过构建严格避免数据泄漏的TRACE基准，证明了文本信息在捕捉电价尾部风险方面的巨大价值。创新性强，方法严谨。
motivation: 现有的电力价格预测（EPF）基准主要关注数值输入，忽视了预测时文本上下文的预测价值，且缺乏可复现的、包含官方运营文本的基准。
method: 构建包含7,300个区域-天实例的TRACE基准，严格在预测截止点重建官方运营文本以防止信息泄漏；评估文本的语义对齐能力以及在时间序列基础模型中的预测价值，并进行跨天文本不匹配的控制实验消融。
results: 语义评估表明文本与真实价格的中心趋势及尾部风险（尤其是上尾价格风险）具有良好对齐；在时间序列基础模型中引入TRACE可使上尾分位数损失中位数减少7.4%，而控制实验中的文本不匹配则会消除这些增益甚至低于无文本基准。
conclusion: TRACE基准有效验证了官方运营文本在电力价格预测中的重要价值，特别是对于上尾风险的预测具有显著提升效果，强调了在电力市场预测中纳入文本上下文的必要性。

title: Overcoming Challenges of Interpretive Structural Modeling with Large Language Models
authors: Everett Rush, David J. Icove, Ari Kim, Byung H. Park, Michael A. Langston
abstract: Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM) is a well-known process for multi-criteria decision making. The success of ISM over other methodologies is its ability to model causal relationships, the binary scale of factors, and resulting hierarchical representation. Traditionally, the modeling process is performed by repeated interactions with subject matter experts until consensus is reached. This process is tedious, labor-intense, and most importantly limits the ability of ISM to scale to studies with hundreds of variables. Drawing on existing work of causal graph discovery with large language models (LLM) as imperfect experts, this work explores an integrated LLM-ISM approach for ISM. Pairwise, k-wise, rowwise, and full graph discovery methodologies are compared and evaluated. It is shown that causal graph discovery methods for ISM perform best using rowwise (SHD=160, F1-score=0.77) and full graph methods (SHD=135, F1-score=0.73).
comment: This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections
zh_title: 用大语言模型克服解释结构模型的挑战
translation: 解释结构模型（ISM）是一种用于多准则决策的知名方法。ISM优于其他方法的原因在于其建模因果关系、因素的二元尺度以及由此产生的层次表示的能力。传统上，建模过程是通过与主题专家的反复互动进行的，直到达成共识。这个过程繁琐、劳动力密集，最重要的是限制了ISM扩展到包含数百个变量的研究的能力。借鉴现有使用大语言模型（LLM）作为不完美专家的因果图发现工作，本研究探讨了一种集成的LLM-ISM方法。对成对、k-wise、逐行和全图发现方法进行了比较和评估。结果表明，用于ISM的因果图发现方法在使用逐行方法（SHD=160，F1分数=0.77）和全图方法（SHD=135，F1分数=0.73）时表现最好。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合大语言模型与解释结构模型（ISM）的方法，有效解决了传统ISM无法扩展到大量变量的痛点，其中全图和逐行发现方法效果最好。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型（LLM）引入解释结构模型（ISM）中，解决了传统ISM方法依赖专家耗时耗力且难以扩展到大规模变量的痛点。通过对不同因果图发现方法的系统评估，为自动化、规模化决策建模提供了有力的方法支撑。
motivation: 传统的解释结构模型（ISM）依赖于与领域专家的反复交互来达成共识，该过程繁琐、劳动力密集，且限制了ISM向数百个变量规模扩展的能力，因此需要探索集成大语言模型的新方法来克服这些挑战。
method: 利用大语言模型作为不完美专家，探索并对比了成组（pairwise）、k组（k-wise）、逐行（rowwise）以及全图（full graph）等四种因果图发现方法在ISM中的表现。
results: 实验表明，用于ISM的因果图发现方法在使用逐行方法（SHD=160，F1分数=0.77）和全图方法（SHD=135，F1分数=0.73）时表现最好。
conclusion: 基于大语言模型的因果图发现方法能够有效克服传统解释结构模型（ISM）在面对大规模变量时的扩展瓶颈，其中逐行（rowwise）和全图（full graph）方法表现最优。

title: Parameter-Free Interval-Dynamic Regret under Heavy-Tailed Noise
authors: Vaneet Aggarwal
abstract:
We study online convex optimization with one unbiased stochastic subgradient per round and an unknown finite conditional $p$th noise moment, $1<p\le2$. For every fixed interval $I$ of length $n$ and comparator path with $Λ_I=1+P_I/D$, one learner achieves
  \[ E[Regret_I(u)]\le\min(GDn, C[GD\sqrt{n(Λ_I+\log^2(2T))} +σDn^{1/p}(Λ_I+\log^2(2T))^{(p-1)/p}]). \]
  The learner uses none of $G,σ,p,I,P_I$, and the constant is universal. Interval adaptation adds to comparator complexity, preserving the distinct mean-gradient and noise exponents. The analysis controls calibration in expectation and limits the cost of observation-scale changes. Its general theorem compares to distributions over predictably available experts with relative-entropy dependence on a nonuniform prior. A common prior favors long windows and long restart lengths. With the statistics supplied, the interval cost becomes $1+\log(T/n)$, including the optimal full-horizon static rate. A change-of-measure lower bound identifies the noise power of this logarithm for learners retaining a full-horizon optimal guarantee, under explicit conditions. Static comparisons and deterministic partitions follow from the same decisions.
zh_title: 重尾噪声下无参数的区间动态遗憾
translation: 我们研究了在线凸 optimization 问题，每轮包含一个无偏随机次梯度以及未知的有限条件 $p$ 阶噪声矩，$1<p\le2$。对于长度为 $n$ 的每个固定区间 $I$ 和比较器路径 $Λ_I=1+P_I/D$，某个学习器实现了 [公式给出的遗憾界]。该学习器不使用 $G,\sigma,p,I,P_I$ 中的任何一个，且常数是通用的。区间自适应增加了比较器复杂度，保留了不同的均值梯度和噪声指数。该分析控制了期望中的校准并限制了观测尺度变化的成本。其通用定理将其与具有对非均匀先验的相对熵依赖的可预测可用专家分布进行了比较。一个共同的先验倾向于长窗口和长重启长度。在提供统计数据的情况下，区间成本变为 $1+\log(T/n)$，包括最优的全时段静态速率。在显式条件下，测度变化下界确定了保留全时段最优保证的学习器的该对数项的噪声幂。静态比较和确定性分区遵循相同的决策。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在重尾噪声下无需任何先验参数的在线凸优化算法，实现了自适应区间动态遗憾和全时段最优静态遗憾。
ai_comments: 该论文研究了重尾噪声下的在线凸优化问题，创新性地实现了在不需要任何先验参数（如噪声界、阶数、区间长度等）的情况下，同时达到区间自适应和全时段最优静态遗憾界。该方法对处理实际应用中常见的重尾噪声具有重要理论价值。
motivation: 现有的在线凸优化方法往往依赖于对噪声分布或参数的先验知识，且在重尾噪声和未知区间长度下难以同时实现最优的动态遗憾界，因此需要设计一种完全参数无关且能自适应重尾噪声的算法。
method: 通过控制期望中的校准并限制观测尺度变化的成本，利用关于可预测专家分布的通用定理，结合非均匀先验的相对熵依赖关系来实现。
results: 学习器在不需要知道任何参数（如 $G, \sigma, p, I, P_I$）的情况下，实现了对任意固定区间 $I$ 的动态遗憾界上界，并证明了相应对数项的下界。
conclusion: 论文成功提出了一个参数无关的区间动态遗憾算法，能够适应重尾噪声，并在各种区间长度和变异度下保持最优性能。

title: Feature Freshness Budgets for Real-Time ML Inference Under Stream Lag
authors: Amit Rajula
abstract: Online feature stores decouple feature computation from model serving, materializing features from upstream event streams into a low-latency store that inference reads at request time. This decoupling introduces a freshness gap - the interval between an event occurring at the source and its effect becoming visible in the served feature vector - that is widely documented as a cause of training-serving skew but has no formal treatment as a bounded, cost-quantified quantity. We model the online feature store as a materialized view over an event stream and define a per-feature freshness budget: the difference between the decision window a feature is consumed within and the staleness the serving pipeline imposes on it. We prove two propositions - a per-feature staleness bound, and a closed-form threshold below which a feature can never be served within budget - and validate them in a seeded, reproducible discrete-event simulation and on a real Apache Kafka, Redis, and PostgreSQL pipeline. The predicted collapse threshold reproduces on real infrastructure, with the decision-error transition landing where the closed form predicts. Reconciling simulated and real drop rates surfaces a methodological result of independent interest: the dominant simulation-to-infrastructure gap is not latency but a sampling-phase artifact - a simulation whose request clock and recomputation cadence are phase-locked systematically under-observes staleness. Randomizing that phase reconciles simulation and infrastructure to within 0.018 mean absolute error in per-feature drop rate. Results are scoped to the studied workloads and configurations and are not claims about any specific production feature-store implementation.
comment: Preprint. Under review at The VLDB Journal
zh_title: 流延迟下实时机器学习推理的特征新鲜度预算
translation: 在线特征存储将特征计算与模型服务解耦，将来自上游事件流的特征物化到一个低延迟存储中，供推理在请求时读取。这种解耦引入了一个新鲜度差距——事件发生在源头与其效果在服务的特征向量中可见之间的时间间隔——这被广泛记录为训练-服务偏差的原因，但尚未被作为有界、成本量化的量进行形式化处理。我们将在线特征存储建模为事件流上的物化视图，并定义了每特征新鲜度预算：特征被消耗的决策窗口与服务管道对其施加的陈旧度之间的差值。我们证明了两个命题——每特征陈旧度边界，以及一个特征在其预算内永远无法被服务的闭式阈值——并在种子驱动的、可复现的离散事件模拟以及真实的主机管道（Apache Kafka、Redis和PostgreSQL）上进行了验证。预测的崩溃阈值在真实基础设施上得以复现，决策错误转换落在闭式解预测的位置。调和模拟与真实的丢弃率揭示了一个具有独立兴趣的方法论结果：主要的模拟到基础设施的差距不是延迟，而是采样相位伪影——一个请求时钟和重新计算节奏相位锁定的模拟会系统性地低估陈旧度。将该相位随机化可将模拟与基础设施的每特征丢弃率平均绝对误差调和到0.018以内。结果仅限于所研究的工作负载和配置，并不是对任何特定生产特征存储实现的声明。
tldr: 本文形式化研究了实时机器学习推理中的特征新鲜度预算，通过理论证明和真实系统验证了特征陈旧度边界与崩溃阈值。
ai_comments: 本文首次对在线特征存储中的“新鲜度预算”进行了形式化定义和理论建模，并通过模拟与真实架构（Kafka、Redis、PostgreSQL）的结合验证了理论的正确性，对实时机器学习系统中的数据新鲜度管理具有重要的参考价值。
motivation: 在线特征存储引入了新鲜度差距，导致训练-服务偏差，但目前缺乏对其作为有界、成本量化数量的正式处理。
method: 将在线特征存储建模为事件流上的物化视图，定义了每特征新鲜度预算，证明了两个命题（每特征陈旧度边界和闭式阈值），并通过离散事件模拟以及Apache Kafka、Redis和PostgreSQL真实管道进行验证。
results: 预测的崩溃阈值在真实基础设施中得到了复现；通过随机化请求时钟与重计算节奏的相位，成功将模拟与基础设施的每特征丢弃率平均绝对误差缩小至0.018以内。
conclusion: 本文提出了特征新鲜度预算模型，证明了特征陈旧度边界及崩溃阈值，并在真实基础设施中得到了验证，同时指出了消除模拟与实际基础设施差距的关键方法。

title: MintFlow: Minimal Trajectory Intervention for Constrained Flow Matching
authors: Yesom Park, Kelvin Kan, Qifan Chen, Thomas Flynn, Hayden Schaeffer. Xihaier Luo
abstract: Flow matching models excel at generative modeling, and many downstream applications require their samples to satisfy prescribed constraints, such as observed measurements and physical laws. However, existing constrained samplers often face a trade-off: \textit{enforcing constraints can substantially displace samples from the pretrained data distribution}. To address this trade-off, we introduce \textbf{MintFlow}, a training-free constrained sampling framework that formulates constraint enforcement as a minimal intervention on the pretrained flow trajectory. MintFlow seeks the minimal perturbation of an intermediate flow state such that its subsequent evolution under the pretrained flow field satisfies the target constraint. By minimally perturbing the flow state while keeping the pretrained flow field unchanged, MintFlow enforces the constraint while minimizing unnecessary deviation from the pretrained distribution. An adjoint formulation yields a closed-form expression for this perturbation, eliminating expensive iterative optimization. Furthermore, MintFlow adaptively selects the intervention time to balance the required perturbation magnitude with its amplification by the remaining flow. Across a range of tasks in generative vision and physical system modeling, MintFlow achieves competitive constraint satisfaction while preserving the pretrained generative distribution substantially better than state-of-the-art constrained methods.
zh_title: MintFlow：用于受约束流匹配的最小轨迹干预
translation: 流匹配模型在生成建模方面表现出色，许多下游应用要求其样本满足规定的约束，例如观测测量和物理定律。然而，现有的受约束采样器经常面临一种权衡：强制实施约束会大大改变样本与预训练数据分布的距离。为了解决这一权衡，我们引入了 MintFlow，这是一个无需训练的受约束采样框架，它将约束实施形式化为对预训练流轨迹的最小干预。MintFlow 寻求中间流状态的最小扰动，使其随后在预训练流场下的演化满足目标约束。通过在保持预训练流场不变的情况下对流状态进行最小扰动，MintFlow 在强制实施约束的同时最小化了对预训练分布的不必要偏离。伴随公式产生了该扰动的闭式解，消除了昂贵的迭代优化。此外，MintFlow 自适应地选择干预时间，以平衡所需扰动幅度与剩余流的放大作用。在生成视觉和物理系统建模的一系列任务中，MintFlow 实现了具有竞争力的约束满足度，同时比最先进的约束方法更好地保留了预训练生成分布。
tldr: MintFlow 通过对流匹配的中间状态进行最小且自适应的扰动，实现了无需训练的约束采样，完美平衡了约束满足与分布保持。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的无训练约束采样框架 MintFlow，通过对预训练流轨迹进行最小干预，成功解决了约束满足与保持预训练数据分布之间的固有权衡，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的约束采样器往往面临一个权衡：强制实施约束会严重偏离预训练的数据分布。
method: 提出 MintFlow 框架，通过在中间流状态施加最小扰动，并利用伴随公式推导出扰动的闭式解，同时自适应选择干预时间。
results: 在生成视觉和物理系统建模的各项任务中，MintFlow 在实现具有竞争力的约束满足度的同时，比现有先进约束方法更好地保留了预训练生成分布。
conclusion: MintFlow 是一种高效、无需训练的约束流匹配采样框架，能够在满足约束的同时最大程度地保留预训练模型的数据分布。

title: From Mathematical to Executable Certificates for Machine Unlearning
authors: Ziyu Zhao, Xinyu Wang, Xiaowen Chang, Yixuan He
abstract: Machine unlearning is needed when data must be removed because of deletion requests, outdated records, or data-quality concerns, while retraining from scratch can be costly. Certified machine unlearning methods provide mathematical guarantees, while deployed systems release concrete finite-precision artifacts produced by software. To bridge the gap between mathematical guarantees and practical deployment, we introduce Executable Release Certification (ExecCert), a release-time layer that certifies the candidate artifact considered for release. ExecCert either closes a method's native certificate for the executed candidate or applies Retraining-Reference Release Verification (RRV) to certify fidelity to current retain-set retraining. Sequential deletion makes the latter nontrivial because the exact retain-set reference and the stored numerical state evolve separately. For frozen representations with a mutable ridge head, we develop an incremental realization of RRV that maintains certified evidence across deletion requests rather than reconstructing it at each release. On four published unlearning implementations, ExecCert preserves valid certificates, changes release decisions, tightens conservative bounds, and identifies the retraining-reference fidelity supported by concrete outputs. In sequential-service experiments, RRV eliminates false releases caused by stored-equation verification while closely tracking realized error, and incremental certification remains cheaper than both fresh and maintained verified-factor alternatives once release checks become sufficiently frequent.
zh_title: 从数学证书到可执行证书的机器学习遗忘
translation: 当由于删除请求、过时记录或数据质量问题而必须删除数据时，就需要进行机器学习遗忘，而从头开始重新训练成本高昂。已认证的机器学习遗忘方法提供了数学保证，而部署的系统则发布由软件产生的具体的有限精度构件。为了弥合数学保证与实际部署之间的差距，我们引入了可执行发布认证（ExecCert），这是一个在发布时认证考虑发布的候选构件的层。ExecCert要么关闭方法对执行候选的原生证书，要么应用重新训练参考发布验证（RRV）来认证对当前保留集重新训练的保真度。顺序删除使得后者变得非trivial，因为确切的保留集参考和存储的数字状态是分别演化的。对于具有可变岭头（ridge head）的冻结表示，我们开发了RRV的增量实现，它跨删除请求维护认证证据，而不是在每次发布时重新构建它。在四个已发布的遗忘实现上，ExecCert保留了有效证书、改变了发布决策、收紧了保守界限，并确定了具体输出所支持的重新训练参考保真度。在顺序服务实验中，RRV消除了由存储方程验证引起的错误发布，同时紧密跟踪实现的误差，并且一旦发布检查足够频繁，增量认证就比新鲜的和维护的验证因子替代方案更便宜。
tldr: 提出了一种名为ExecCert的发布时认证层，填补了机器学习遗忘中理论数学保证与实际软件部署之间的空白。
ai_comments: 该论文成功弥合了机器学习遗忘（Machine Unlearning）中理论数学保证与实际软件部署之间的鸿沟，提出了可执行发布认证（ExecCert）层，并在顺序删除场景下实现了高效的增量认证，具有很强的实用价值和创新性。
motivation: 传统的机器学习遗忘方法提供数学保证，而实际部署系统发布的是由软件产生的具体有限精度构件。为了弥合数学保证与实际部署之间的差距，需要一种能够在发布时对候选构件进行认证的机制。
method: 引入了可执行发布认证（ExecCert）层，用于认证待发布的候选构件；使用Retraining-Reference Release Verification (RRV)来认证对当前保留集重新训练的保真度；针对冻结表示和可变岭回归头的情况，开发了RRV的增量实现，以跨删除请求维护认证证据。
results: 在四个已发布的遗忘实现上，ExecCert保持了有效证书、改变了发布决策、收紧了保守界限，并确定了具体输出支持的重新训练参考保真度。在顺序服务实验中，RRV消除了由存储方程验证引起的错误发布，同时增量认证在发布检查足够频繁时比全新和维护的验证因子替代方案更便宜。
conclusion: ExecCert和RRV有效解决了机器学习遗忘中理论保证与实际有限精度软件产物之间的差距，为安全、高效的遗忘系统部署提供了切实可行的解决方案。

title: Maximum Edge Open Packing on AT-Free, Chordal, and Convex Bipartite Graphs
authors: Gautam K. Das, Kamal Santra
abstract: An edge open packing is a set of edges whose endpoints induce a disjoint union of stars. We study the problem of finding a maximum edge open packing in AT-free, chordal, and convex bipartite graphs. For AT-free graphs, we use the oriented star-conflict graph $A_G$, introduced by Das and Santra, for which $ρ_e^o(G)=α(A_G)$, and prove that $A_G$ is AT-free whenever $G$ is AT-free. Consequently, a known maximum independent set algorithm for AT-free graphs yields an $O(n^2+m^4)$-time algorithm for Maximum Edge Open Packing, where $n$ and $m$ denote the numbers of vertices and edges of $G$, respectively. For chordal graphs, we develop an $O(n^4)$-time dynamic programming algorithm over a nice tree decomposition derived from a clique tree, exploiting the structural fact that the endpoint set of an edge open packing intersects every clique in at most two vertices. Finally, for convex bipartite graphs, we obtain an $O(n^4)$-time dynamic programming algorithm based on two boundary indices that separate consecutive star components. This result extends the previously known algorithm for biconvex bipartite graphs and, in particular, provides an improved explicit running-time bound for that class.
zh_title: AT-free图、弦图和凸二分图上的最大边开填充
translation: 边开填充是一组边，其端点导出一个不相交的星图并集。我们研究了在AT-free图、弦图和凸二分图上寻找最大边开填充的问题。对于AT-free图，我们使用了由Das和Santra引入的定向星冲突图 $A_G$（满足 $\rho_e^o(G)=\alpha(A_G)$），并证明了若 $G$ 是AT-free的，则 $A_G$ 也是AT-free的。因此，现有的AT-free图最大独立集算法可导出一个 $O(n^2+m^4)$ 时间的最大边开填充算法，其中 $n$ 和 $m$ 分别表示 $G$ 的顶点数和边数。对于弦图，我们在由团树导出的良好树分解上开发了一个 $O(n^4)$ 时间的动态规划算法，利用了边开填充的端点集与每个团相交至多两个顶点的结构事实。最后，对于凸二分图，我们基于分隔连续星分量的两个边界索引，获得了一个 $O(n^4)$ 时间的动态规划算法。这一结果扩展了先前已知的双凸二分图算法，特别是为该图类提供了一个改进的显式运行时间界。
tldr: 本文针对AT-free图、弦图和凸二分图，设计了求解最大边开填充的高效多项式时间算法。
ai_comments: 该论文在图论和算法设计领域具有重要意义，通过深入挖掘特定图类（AT-free、弦图和凸二分图）的结构性质，成功设计了高效的多项式时间算法来解决最大边开填充（Maximum Edge Open Packing）问题。其创新点在于将边开填充问题与图的结构特征（如定向星冲突图、树分解和边界索引）紧密结合。
motivation: 研究在AT-free图、弦图和凸二分图这三类特殊图上寻找最大边开填充（maximum edge open packing）的问题，以期设计出高效的算法。
method: 针对AT-free图，证明了其定向星冲突图也是AT-free图并利用最大独立集算法；针对弦图，基于团树导出的良好树分解开发了动态规划算法；针对凸二分图，基于分离连续星分量的两个边界索引设计了动态规划算法。
results: 为AT-free图设计了 $O(n^2+m^4)$ 时间的算法，为弦图和凸二分图分别设计了 $O(n^4)$ 时间的动态规划算法，并改进了已知双凸二分图类的显式运行时间界。
conclusion: 论文针对AT-free图、弦图和凸二分图，分别提出了高效的多项式时间算法来求解最大边开填充问题，推进了该领域的图论算法研究。

title: Awomo-SimDataEngine: Agentic Simulation-ReadyWorld Generation
authors: Awomo-PhysicalRSI Team, Danjiao Ma, Enhui Ma, Haohan Liu, Heng Jia, Hui Shan, Jianhua Xu, Jiahuan Zhang, Jiangdi Xu, Kaiwen Guo, Kaicheng Yu, Linwei Zhang, Liyang Jin, Maochun Luo, Pengyao Niu, Shiwen Li, Shuangyu Feng, Tong Zhang, Tianheng Wang, Xin Wang, Xiangru Huang, Yongqiang Huang, Zhaozhi Wang, Zijian Ma
abstract: Generating useful robot-training data requires more than visually plausiblescenes: objects must support interaction, placements must remain physicallyvalid, and tasks must admit repeatable execution. We present\textbf{Awomo-SimDataEngine}, an agentic system that connects asset and scenegeneration to robot demonstration synthesis. Shared asset services providerigid and articulated objects, including structure-grounded part and jointgeneration with ISArt. Scene generation supports two complementary routes:Unravel reconstructs editable scenes from images, while SimForge buildssingle-room and multi-room environments from text. A graph-native harnesscoordinates construction, validation, andbounded repair, routing failures to the responsible module while retainingunaffected scene state. PolicyForge binds validated worlds to tasks and robotembodiments to produce replayable demonstrations. Evaluations cover assetgeometry, scene quality, and downstream policy learning. On MuJoCo-basedLIBERO-Plus, co-training with Isaac Sim demonstrations improves the overallsuccess rate of a World-Action Model (WAM) from $77.17\%$ to $89.43\%$. Goal and spatialsuccess improve by $31.66$ and $6.25$ percentage points, respectively.These results support the utility of the generated data for cross-simulatorpolicy training, with more limited gains on long-horizon tasks.
zh_title: Awomo-SimDataEngine：智能体仿真就绪世界生成系统
translation: 生成有用的机器人训练数据不仅需要视觉上逼真的场景：物体必须支持交互、放置必须保持物理有效性，并且任务必须允许可重复执行。我们提出了 Awomo-SimDataEngine，这是一个将资产和场景生成连接到机器人示范合成的智能体系统。共享资产服务提供刚体和铰链对象，包括通过ISArt进行结构基础的部件和关节生成。场景生成支持两条互补的路线：Unravel从图像中重建可编辑场景，而SimForge从文本构建单房间和多房间环境。图原生框架协调构建、验证和有界修复，将失败路由到负责的模块，同时保留不受影响的场景状态。PolicyForge将验证后的世界绑定到任务和机器人实体，以生成可重放的示范。评估涵盖了资产几何形状、场景质量和下游策略学习。在基于MuJoCo的LIBERO-Plus上，与Isaac Sim示范进行联合训练将世界-动作模型（WAM）的总体成功率从77.17%提高到89.43%。目标成功率和空间成功率分别提高了31.66和6.25个百分点。这些结果支持了生成数据用于跨模拟器策略训练的实用性，但在长视距任务上的收益更为有限。
tldr: 本文介绍了 Awomo-SimDataEngine，一个能够自动生成物理有效且可交互的仿真世界与机器人训练数据的智能体系统，显著提升了机器人策略的训练成功率。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种端到端的智能体仿真世界与数据生成引擎 Awomo-SimDataEngine，创新性地结合了资产生成、场景重建与合成、图原生修复机制以及具身示范合成，并在 MuJoCo 和 Isaac Sim 跨仿真器策略训练中取得了显著的性能提升。
motivation: 生成有用的机器人训练数据不仅需要视觉上合理的场景，还需要物体支持交互、放置保持物理有效性以及任务可重复执行，现有的生成方法缺乏端到端且物理严谨的集成系统。
method: 提出 Awomo-SimDataEngine 智能体系统，利用共享资产服务提供刚体和铰链对象（ISArt），通过 Unravel 从图像重建场景或通过 SimForge 从文本构建环境，借助图原生框架进行协调、验证和修复，并通过 PolicyForge 绑定任务和机器人实体生成可重放的示范。
results: 在 MuJoCo 的 LIBERO-Plus 评估中，结合 Isaac Sim 示范的联合训练使世界-动作模型（WAM）的整体成功率从 77.17% 提升至 89.43%，目标成功率和空间成功率分别提升了 31.66 和 6.25 个百分点。
conclusion: Awomo-SimDataEngine 成功实现了从资产、场景生成到机器人示范合成的全流程自动化，生成的数据显著提升了机器人策略在跨仿真器训练中的成功率。

title: Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses
authors: Jiawei Li
abstract: Agent harnesses make many small, typed decisions per task: which model to call, which tool to use, whether retrieved text is relevant, whether an input carries an injection. System-1 decision models answer such questions in a single forward pass with class probabilities, promising large cost and latency savings over LLM calls. We present a paired evaluation of an open-weight (Laya) and a hosted (Jev) System-1 model on 11 agent decision points built from 18 public sources: 7,283 base cases plus 6,640 robustness variants, with byte-identical inputs, paired tests, and cross-hardware and cross-day reproducibility checks. Jev is significantly more accurate on 9 of 11 decision points (+10.8 to +46.0 pp). Neither model beats chance on zero-shot model routing, and they tie on RAG relevance gating. Laya changes 30% of its answers when the option order is reversed and degrades sharply with many or similar candidates (31% at 50 nearest-neighbour tools, vs. 98% for Jev on items with a unique correct tool). We also audit our own pipeline. Three analysis errors and one design confound distorted headline deployment claims: an omitted pre-screen cost (reported 23.9% saving, actual 4.3%), gate accuracy reported as end-to-end quality (58% vs. 98%), in-sample thresholds (5% target, up to 17% held-out misses), and a "channel effect" on injection false positives that vanishes with channel-native content. Two other suspected confounds did not change the conclusions. All cases, raw outputs and analysis code are available at https://github.com/David-DL-Space/sys1-eval.
zh_title: 快速模型，缓慢证据：大模型代理框架中System-1决策模型的配对与自我审计评估
translation: 代理框架在每个任务中都要做出许多小的、类型化的决策：调用哪个模型、使用哪个工具、检索到的文本是否相关、输入是否带有注入。System-1决策模型通过单次前向传播和类别概率来回答这些问题，有望比LLM调用节省大量的成本和延迟。我们对一个开源模型（Laya）和一个托管模型（Jev）在来自18个公共来源的11个代理决策点上进行了配对评估：7,283个基本案例加上6,640个鲁棒性变体，具有字节相同的输入、配对测试以及跨硬件和跨天的可重复性检查。Jev在11个决策点中的9个上明显更准确（+10.8 到 +46.0 个百分点）。两个模型在零样本模型路由上的表现均没有超过随机概率，并且它们在RAG相关性门控上打成平局。当选项顺序颠倒时，Laya会改变30%的答案，并且随着候选对象数量增多或相似度增加而急剧下降（在50个最近邻工具时为31%，而对于具有唯一正确工具的项目，Jev为98%）。我们还审计了我们自己的流水线。三个分析错误和一个设计混淆扭曲了头条部署声明：遗漏了预筛选成本（报告的23.9%节省，实际为4.3%）、将门控准确率报告为端到端质量（58%对98%）、样本内阈值（5%目标，高达17%的保留未命中），以及对注入误报的“通道效应”，该效应随通道原生内容而消失。另外两个疑似混淆没有改变结论。所有案例、原始输出和分析代码均可在 https://github.com/David-DL-Space/sys1-eval 获取。
tldr: 本文评估并自我审计了用于LLM代理的System-1决策模型，揭示了其性能优劣以及评估流程中常见的偏差与陷阱。
ai_comments: 该论文通过成对和自我审计的方式评估了System-1决策模型在大模型代理中的应用，不仅揭示了开源与托管模型在各项决策点上的性能差异，还反思了评估流程中常见的分析误差和混淆变量，对指导高效、可靠的AI代理系统设计具有重要意义。
motivation: 大模型代理需要做出大量轻量级、类型化的决策，System-1决策模型承诺以单次前向传播提供巨大成本和延迟节省，因此需要对其性能和可靠性进行系统评估和审计。
method: 进行了一项配对评估，测试了一个开源模型（Laya）和一个托管模型（Jev）在11个代理决策点上的表现，使用了包含7,283个基本案例和6,640个鲁棒性变体的测试集，并对评估流水线进行了自我审计。
results: Jev在9个决策点上明显更准确；两个模型在零样本模型 routing上均未超过随机水平；Laya对选项顺序敏感且在候选者增多时性能急剧下降；审计揭示了流水线中的多处分析错误和设计混淆。
conclusion: System-1决策模型在某些代理决策任务中展现出潜力，但零样本模型路由表现不佳，且对选项顺序和候选数量敏感。同时，严谨的自我审计对消除评估偏差至关重要。

title: The AI Risk Observatory: What Can We Learn from AI Disclosures in Annual Reports About Societal Resilience?
authors: Bart Jaworski
abstract: Societal resilience research relies on access to useful and actionable data, which motivates our main research question: Can annual reports, processed at scale with LLMs, provide a useful signal about how companies disclose their response to AI? We test this by applying a reproducible two-stage classification pipeline to 9,821 annual reports from 1,362 UK listed companies (2020-2025, with partial 2026 data). We first validate the method against 474 human-annotated passages, finding high recall and moderate label-level agreement. We then report three empirical patterns: (i) between 2020 and 2025, the share of reports mentioning AI risk rose from 2.8% to 41.2%, while AI adoption disclosure also rose, from 13.8% to 45.2%, and named vendor mentions cluster around a small set of major providers led by Microsoft; (ii) disclosure varies substantially by Critical National Infrastructure sector and market segment: AIM reports disclose AI risk at far lower rates than Main Market reports, and sectors such as Energy and Data Infrastructure lag behind the rest in AI risk disclosure; and (iii) harm disclosures are near-absent (seven reports across the entire corpus). We develop a substantiveness classification to assess the quality of the disclosure and find that most AI risk disclosure is not substantive: in 2025, 41.2% of all reports mention AI as a risk, but only 4.3% contain AI risk disclosure we classify as substantive.
comment: 22 pages (9 main text + appendices), 12 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/84rt/AI-Risk-Observatory (release dataset-v1.1)
zh_title: AI风险观察站：关于社会韧性，我们能从年报中的AI披露学到什么？
translation: 社会韧性研究依赖于获取有用且可操作的数据，这激发了我们的主要研究问题：通过大语言模型大规模处理年报，能否为企业如何披露其对AI的响应提供有用的信号？我们通过对1,362家英国上市公司（2020-2025年，含部分2026年数据）的9,821份年报应用可重复的两阶段分类管道来测试这一点。我们首先针对474个人工标注的段落验证了该方法，发现高召回率和中等水平的标签级一致性。随后我们报告了三个经验模式：(i) 在2020年至2025年间，提及AI风险的报告份额从2.8%上升到41.2%，而AI采用披露也从13.8%上升到45.2%，具名的供应商提及则主要集中在以微软为首的一小群主要提供商周围；(ii) 披露情况因关键国家基础设施部门和市场细分而异：AIM（另类投资市场）报告披露AI风险的比率远低于主板（Main Market）报告，且能源和数据基础设施等部门在AI风险披露方面落后于其他部门；(iii) 危害披露几乎完全缺失（整个语料库中仅有七份报告）。我们开发了一种实质性分类来评估披露质量，发现大多数AI风险披露并不具有实质性：在2025年，所有报告中有41.2%将AI提及为风险，但仅有4.3%包含我们分类为实质性的AI风险披露。
tldr: 通过大语言模型分析数千份企业年报发现，虽然提及AI风险和采用的企业比例急剧上升，但绝大多数披露缺乏实质性内容，且不同行业间存在显著差异。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地利用大语言模型（LLMs）对大规模企业年报进行挖掘，构建了“AI风险观察站”，为研究社会对人工智能的韧性和风险披露提供了新颖的量化视角。研究揭示了企业在AI披露上的“表象繁荣”与“实质匮乏”之间的差距，具有重要的政策与监管启示。
motivation: 社会韧性研究依赖于有用且可操作的数据，本研究旨在探讨通过大语言模型大规模处理企业年报，是否能为评估企业如何披露其对AI的响应提供有用的信号。
method: 应用可重复的两阶段分类管道，结合大语言模型处理了来自1,362家英国上市公司的9,821份年报（2020-2025年及部分2026年数据），并通过474个人工注释段落进行了方法验证，同时开发了实质性分类法来评估披露质量。
results: 2020至2025年间，提及AI风险的年报比例从2.8%升至41.2%，AI采用披露从13.8%升至45.2%；关键国家基础设施行业及不同市场板块的披露存在显著差异；危害披露几乎完全缺失；且虽然2025年有41.2%的报告提及AI风险，但仅有4.3%被分类为实质性披露。
conclusion: 企业年报结合大语言模型可以作为评估社会应对AI韧性的有效信号源。然而，尽管AI相关提及率在急剧上升，但真正具备实质性的AI风险披露仍然极少，且不同行业和市场板块之间存在显著差异。

title: MuLoRA: Spectrally Balanced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
authors: Junkang Liu
abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) provides a parameter-efficient approach to continual learning, but its nominal rank can conceal a loss of effective adaptation capacity. We identify \emph{spectral plasticity collapse}: during sequential adaptation, update energy becomes concentrated in a small subset of singular modes, leaving much of the available low-rank space underutilized. This exposes a limitation of interference avoidance alone: protecting historical representations does not ensure that the remaining adaptation capacity is responsive to new tasks or effectively utilized. To address this problem, we propose \texttt{MuLoRA}, which jointly controls capacity allocation and utilization. First, historical whitening identifies input directions with strong current-task response relative to accumulated historical response, yielding a task-adaptive basis that remains fixed during training. Second, approximate polar orthogonalization of momentum updates reduces spectral concentration within theselected space. An orthonormal basis connects these mechanisms by transferring the factor-update spectrum exactly tothe induced weight update. We establish a max--min characterization of exact subspace selection and derive cumulative spectral bounds under controlled cross-step anisotropy. Across five class-incremental benchmarks and eight incremental settings, \texttt{MuLoRA} achieves the highest mean accuracy in 15 of 16 reported metrics.
zh_title: MuLoRA：用于持续学习的谱平衡低秩适应
translation: 低秩适应（LoRA）为持续学习提供了一种参数高效的方法，但其名义秩可能会掩盖有效适应能力的丧失。我们指出了“谱塑性坍塌”现象：在顺序适应过程中，更新能量集中在一个很小的奇异模子集上，导致大部分可用的低秩空间未被充分利用。这暴露了仅靠干扰回避的局限性：保护历史表示并不能确保剩余的适应能力对新任务具有响应性或被有效利用。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了MuLoRA，它联合控制了容量分配与利用。首先，历史白化识别出相对于累积历史响应具有强烈当前任务响应的输入方向，从而产生在训练期间保持固定的任务自适应基底。其次，动量更新的近似极坐标正交化减少了所选空间内的谱集中。正交基通过将因子更新谱精确传递到诱导的权重更新来连接这些机制。我们建立了精确子空间选择的最大-最小特征，并在受控的跨步各向异性下推导出了累积谱界。在五个类增量基准和八个增量设置中，MuLoRA在16个报告指标中的15个中实现了最高的平均准确率。
tldr: 提出MuLoRA解决LoRA在持续学习中的谱塑性坍塌问题，通过容量分配和利用的联合控制，大幅提升了模型的持续学习准确率。
ai_comments: 该论文针对LoRA在持续学习中遭遇的“谱塑性坍塌”问题，提出了MuLoRA方法。该方法从容量分配与利用两个维度入手，通过历史白化和动量更新的近似极坐标正交化，有效提升了低 rank 空间的利用率，并在多个持续学习基准测试中取得了领先的准确率，具有很高的创新性和实用价值。
motivation: LoRA在持续学习中存在nominal rank掩盖有效适应能力丢失的问题（即谱塑性坍塌），仅靠干扰规避无法保证剩余的适应能力对新任务具有响应性或被有效利用。
method: 提出了MuLoRA方法，包含两个主要机制：一是通过历史 whitening 识别对当前任务响应强的输入方向以实现任务自适应基底的固定；二是利用动量更新的近似极坐标正交化来减少选定空间内的谱集中现象。通过正交基将因子更新谱精确传递至诱导的权重更新。
results: 在5个类增量基准和8个增量设置中，MuLoRA在16个报告指标中的15个中实现了最高的平均准确率。
conclusion: MuLoRA通过联合控制容量分配与利用，克服了持续学习中LoRA的谱塑性坍塌问题，显著提升了模型在多个基准测试上的表现。

title: Effects of interpulse-interval variation on deep-learning classification of bat vocalizations
authors: Welmoed R. Eversteijn, Burooj Ghani, A. Leonie Baier, Dan Stowell
abstract: Temporal context may aid automated bat-species classification, but the contribution of specific features remains unclear. We investigated whether variation in the interpulse interval (IPI)-the time between consecutive call onsets-provides species-discriminative information and whether transformer-based models are more sensitive to this information than convolutional neural networks. We created two matched datasets from European bat recordings: a natural-IPI condition retaining the original call timing and a normalized-IPI condition in which call onsets were spaced at 50-ms intervals. EfficientNet-B0 and PaSST were fine-tuned and evaluated within each condition. In an additional experiment, each architecture was trained separately on natural-IPI and normalized-IPI recordings, and evaluated on the same natural-IPI test set. Finally, the pretrained classifiers BatDetect2 and BAT were evaluated on both conditions. Within-condition IPI normalization had model-dependent effects. PaSST accuracy differed little between the natural-IPI ($71 \pm 2.3\%$) and normalized-IPI ($70 \pm 6.3\%$) conditions, whereas EfficientNet accuracy increased from $47 \pm 4.7\%$ to $57 \pm 3.9\%$. PaSST exceeded EfficientNet under both conditions. In the cross-condition evaluation, models trained on natural-IPI recordings outperformed those trained on normalized-IPI recordings on the natural-IPI test set: accuracy decreased from 54% to 50% for EfficientNet and from 65% to 57% for PaSST. BatDetect2 and BAT differed little between IPI conditions. Overall, we found limited support for the hypotheses that natural IPI variation contributes substantially to bat-species classification and that it is used more effectively by transformer-based than CNN-based models. Nevertheless, the cross-condition performance decrease shows that results obtained under normalized conditions may not transfer fully to natural recordings.
zh_title: 脉冲间间隔变异对蝙蝠叫声深度学习分类的影响
translation: 时间上下文可能有助于自动化蝙蝠物种分类，但特定特征的贡献仍不明确。我们研究了脉冲间间隔（IPI，即连续叫声起始时间之间的间隔）的变化是否提供了物种区分信息，以及基于Transformer的模型是否比卷积神经网络对这些信息更敏感。我们从欧洲蝙蝠录音中创建了两个匹配的数据集：保留原始叫声时序的自然IPI条件，以及叫声起始时间以50毫秒间隔排列的归一化IPI条件。EfficientNet-B0和PaSST在每个条件下进行微调和评估。在另一项实验中，每个架构分别在自然IPI和归一化IPI录音上进行训练，并在相同的自然IPI测试集上进行评估。最后，在两个条件下评估了预训练分类器BatDetect2和BAT。条件内IPI归一化对模型具有依赖性影响。在自然IPI（$71 \pm 2.3\%$）和归一化IPI（$70 \pm 6.3\%$）条件下，PaSST的准确率差异很小，而EfficientNet的准确率从$47 \pm 4.7\%$提高到$57 \pm 3.9\%$。在两个条件下，PaSST的性能均超过了EfficientNet。在跨条件评估中，在自然IPI录音上训练的模型在自然IPI测试集上的表现优于在归一化IPI录音上训练的模型：EfficientNet的准确率从54%下降到50%，PaSST的准确率从65%下降到57%。BatDetect2和BAT在IPI条件下的差异很小。总体而言，我们发现关于“自然IPI变异对蝙蝠物种分类有显著贡献”以及“基于Transformer的模型比CNN模型能更有效地利用该变异”这两个假设的支持有限。然而，跨条件性能的下降表明，在归一化条件下获得的结果可能无法完全转化到自然录音中。
tldr: 本研究发现自然脉冲间间隔（IPI）变异对深度学习进行蝙蝠物种分类的贡献有限，且Transformer模型并未比CNN表现出更高的敏感性，但标准化处理会影响模型向自然录音的泛化能力。
ai_comments: 该研究探讨了脉冲间间隔（IPI）变化对蝙蝠叫声深度学习分类的影响，发现自然IPI变异对分类的贡献有限，但跨条件评估表明标准化数据的结果不能完全推广到自然录音中，对未来野生动物声学监测具有方法论上的启示意义。
motivation: 探究脉冲间间隔（IPI）的变化是否为蝙蝠物种分类提供具有区分度的信息，以及基于Transformer的模型是否比卷积神经网络（CNN）对这种信息更敏感。
method: 通过构建欧洲蝙蝠录音的自然IPI和标准化IPI（50毫秒间隔）两个匹配数据集，微调了EfficientNet-B0和PaSST模型，并评估了预训练分类器BatDetect2和BAT，同时开展了跨条件训练与测试实验。
results: 在条件内评估中，PaSST的准确率在自然和标准化IPI条件下差异很小（71% vs 70%），而EfficientNet的准确率有所提高（47% vs 57%）；在跨条件评估中，使用自然IPI训练的模型表现优于标准化IPI训练的模型；BatDetect2和BAT在两个条件下的差异也很小。
conclusion: 研究表明自然IPI变异对蝙蝠物种分类的贡献有限，且Transformer模型并未表现出比CNN更强的敏感性，但跨条件性能差异提示标准化处理可能限制模型向自然场景的泛化。

title: CLEAN: Psychometrically Consistent Incremental Cognitive Diagnosis under Concept-Space Expansion via Architectural Isolation
authors: Tao He, Jinxing Xiang, Fan Jiang
abstract: Cognitive diagnosis (CD) is a fundamental task in intelligent education that profiles learner proficiency over knowledge concepts. In real-world learning platforms, newly added items continually introduce previously unseen concepts, necessitating dynamic expansion of the underlying concept space. Yet existing incremental CD models assume a fixed concept space, allowing gradients from new items to overwrite historical pathways and induce catastrophic forgetting. More critically, these methods rely solely on soft constraints to preserve historical diagnoses. Such constraints may fail to satisfy the requirement of diagnostic invariance after incremental updates, a requirement known as psychometric consistency in cognitive diagnosis. Therefore, we propose CLEAN (Continual Learning with Expandable and Architecturally Isolated Networks), a novel incremental CD framework supporting concept-space expansion while providing structural guarantees for pointwise invariance of historical diagnoses. Specifically, CLEAN first introduces a strict topological bipartition protocol, freezes historical diagnostic functions and applies deterministic orthogonal column masking to sever gradient interference. Second, to accommodate concept expansion, expandable full-rank branches with micro-variance initialization are deployed to learn novel concepts. Finally, to verify that this architectural design achieves invariance by construction, we formalize Representation Drift (RD) to quantify the perturbation of historical traits. Extensive experiments on three large-scale educational datasets demonstrate that CLEAN achieves zero RD, preserving old-item metrics identically to static anchors through architectural isolation while remaining competitive with or superior to strong continual-learning baselines on new items.
zh_title: CLEAN：通过架构隔离在概念空间扩展下实现心理测验一致的增量认知诊断
translation: 认知诊断（CD）是智能教育中的一项基本任务，它根据知识概念对学习者的熟练程度进行画像。在现实世界的学习平台中，新添加的题目不断引入以前未见的概念，这就需要动态扩展底层概念空间。然而，现有的增量认知诊断模型假设概念空间是固定的，允许来自新题目的梯度覆盖历史路径并引起灾难性遗忘。更关键的是，这些方法仅仅依靠软约束来保护历史诊断。此类约束可能无法满足增量更新后诊断不变性的要求，这一要求在认知诊断中被称为心理测验一致性。因此，我们提出了 CLEAN（具有可扩展和架构隔离网络的持续学习），这是一种新颖的增量 CD 框架，支持概念空间扩展，同时为历史诊断的逐点不变性提供结构保证。具体而言，CLEAN 首先引入了严格的拓扑二分协议，冻结历史诊断函数并应用确定性的正交列掩码来切断梯度干扰。其次，为了适应概念扩展，部署了具有微方差初始化的可扩展全秩分支来学习新概念。最后，为了验证这种架构设计通过构造实现了不变性，我们形式化了表征漂移（RD）来量化历史特征的扰动。在三个大规模教育数据集上的大量实验表明，CLEAN 实现了零表征漂移，通过架构隔离使旧题目的指标与静态锚点完全相同，同时在处理新题目时与强大的持续学习基线相比保持竞争优势或更胜一筹。
tldr: 论文提出了 CLEAN 框架，利用架构隔离在认知诊断中实现概念扩展，同时保证历史诊断结果零漂移。
ai_comments: 该论文在智能教育领域的认知诊断中引入了持续学习的架构隔离思想，通过严格的拓扑二分协议和正交列掩码，首次在概念空间扩展下实现了历史诊断结果的零表征漂移，兼顾了历史稳定性与新知识的学习能力，具有很强的理论创新性和实际应用价值。
motivation: 现实教育平台中不断引入新概念，导致概念空间动态扩展，但现有的增量认知诊断模型假设固定的概念空间，容易产生灾难性遗忘，且仅依赖软约束无法满足认知诊断所需的心理测验一致性（即历史诊断的不变性）。
method: 提出了 CLEAN 框架，采用严格的拓扑二分协议、冻结历史诊断函数、应用确定性正交列掩码以切断梯度干扰，并部署具有微方差初始化的高秩可扩展分支来学习新概念。
results: 在三个大规模教育数据集上的实验表明，CLEAN 实现了零表征漂移，通过架构隔离使旧题目的指标与静态锚点完全一致，同时在新题目上保持了与强持续学习基线相当或更好的性能。
conclusion: CLEAN 通过架构隔离成功解决了增量认知诊断中的灾难性遗忘和心理测验一致性问题，在扩展新概念的同时保证了历史诊断的零表征漂移。

title: HakemBench: A Turkish Benchmark of Typed Decisions
authors: Sait Furkan Teke
abstract: HakemBench is a Turkish benchmark of typed decisions, in which the model under test reads a text, a question and a fixed set of options and returns a probability for every option. Version 1.0 is released fully open under CC BY 4.0, with 2,346 items and 4,275 choice, yes/no and score questions in seven tracks (fact-check triage, education, guardrails, legal routing, moderation, spam and phishing, and customer support). One harness scores decision quality (macro F1), calibration (from the normalised Brier score) and selective automation (from the normalised area under the generalised risk-coverage curve), combines them by a geometric mean and reports intervals from 2,000 bootstrap draws; probes for option order, paraphrase, English translation and substituted names are reported alongside. Most gold labels come from blind passes of one AI model family compared with the votes of a panel of large language models from other model families; they are not human-verified. On a board of 16 rows the leader scores a composite of 0.888 and the lab's own model is 7th at 0.660. Its numbers are not blind. Earlier runs' test results shaped its training data, so its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers are flagged; with every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16.
comment: 9 pages including references. Data, harness, scorer and board: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ufakai/HakemBench, https://github.com/ufakai/hakembench

title: AdaptViT: Runtime-Adaptive Vision Transformer Deployment on Custom RISC-V
authors: Vishnu PS, Ajay Kumar M, Yike Li, Robert Bogdan Staszewski, Deepu John
abstract: Deploying Vision Transformers (ViTs) on low-power edge devices is challenging due to high computational demands. Conventional pruning frameworks require a separate compiled binary for each sparsity level, increasing storage overhead and limiting runtime adaptability. This paper presents an end-to-end deployment pipeline that transforms pretrained ViTs into a single runtime-configurable binary, enabling dynamic compute-budget switching on embedded CPUs. This is achieved by restructuring generated C kernels with modified loop bounds and binary-mask control logic, allowing execution to switch across discrete sparsity levels via compact external configuration files. Compared to multi-binary deployment, the proposed runtime-adaptive approach reduces on-device storage by up to 4.86x, requiring only 163 MB for ViT-Base instead of nearly 800 MB. To maximize pruning efficiency, we introduce a hardware-aligned block pruning strategy for Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) layers. In addition, a custom ISA extension is proposed to exploit input-reuse patterns in linear projection kernels. On a Synopsys TRV32P3FX RISC-V processor, the full system achieves up to 2.8x speedup at 65% MLP and 50% attention-head pruning for ViT-Base. The ISA extension alone provides a 1.56x speedup and 33% lower inference energy, with a 24.7% area overhead in a TSMC 28 nm implementation.

zh_title: AdaptViT：定制RISC-V上的运行时自适应视觉Transformer部署
translation: 在低功耗边缘设备上部署视觉Transformer（ViT）由于高计算需求而极具挑战性。传统的剪枝框架需要为每个稀疏度级别编译一个单独的二进制文件，这增加了存储开销并限制了运行时的适应性。本文提出了一种端到端的部署管道，将预训练的ViT转换为单一的运行时可配置二进制文件，从而能够在嵌入式CPU上实现动态计算预算切换。这是通过重构生成的C内核（具有修改过的循环边界和二进制掩码控制逻辑）来实现的，允许通过紧凑的外部配置文件在离散的稀疏度级别之间切换执行。与多二进制部署相比，所提出的运行时自适应方法将设备端存储减少了高达4.86倍，ViT-Base仅需163 MB而不是近800 MB。为了最大化剪枝效率，我们引入了针对多层感知器（MLP）层的硬件对齐块剪枝策略。此外，提出了一种定制的ISA扩展，以利用线性投影核中的输入重用模式。在Synopsys TRV32P3FX RISC-V处理器上，对于ViT-Base，在65% MLP和50%注意力头剪枝下，整个系统实现了高达2.8倍的加速。仅ISA扩展就在TSMC 28 nm实现中提供了1.56倍的加速、降低了33%的推理能耗，并带来了24.7%的面积开销。
tldr: AdaptViT通过单二进制文件动态切换稀疏度、硬件对齐剪枝及定制RISC-V ISA扩展，实现了ViT在边缘设备上的高效部署，大幅减少存储并提升了运行速度。
ai_comments: 该论文针对低功耗边缘设备上ViT部署的存储和动态调整难题，创新性地提出了运行时自适应的多稀疏级别单二进制文件部署方案，并结合硬件对齐的块剪枝策略和定制RISC-V ISA扩展，实现了显著的存储缩减、速度提升和能效优化。方法兼顾软件编译流与硬件加速，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 在低功耗边缘设备上部署视觉Transformer（ViT）面临高计算需求挑战；传统剪枝框架需要为每个稀疏度级别编译独立的二进制文件，导致存储开销增加并限制了运行时的适应性。
method: 提出一个端到端的部署管道，通过修改循环边界和二进制掩码控制逻辑将预训练ViT转换为单个运行时可配置的二进制文件；引入硬件对齐的块剪枝策略；提出利用线性投影核中输入重用模式的自定义ISA扩展。
results: 相比多二进制部署，存储空间减少了高达4.86倍（ViT-Base仅需163MB）；在Synopsys TRV32P3FX RISC-V处理器上，ViT-Base在65% MLP和50%注意头剪枝下实现了高达2.8倍的加速；仅ISA扩展就提供了1.56倍的加速和33%的推理能耗降低。
conclusion: AdaptViT通过单二进制文件动态切换稀疏度、硬件对齐剪枝以及定制ISA扩展，成功实现了Vision Transformer在定制RISC-V处理器上的高效、低功耗及运行时自适应部署。

title: Diffusion-Based Synthetic Data Pretraining for Enhancing Activity Recognition
authors: E. Riveros, D. Vega-Oliveros, A. Soriano-Vargas, A. Rocha
abstract: Human activity recognition (HAR) is increasingly important for healthcare, well-being, and daily monitoring ap- plications, for which detecting alimentary activities such as eating and drinking can provide actionable insight into dietary habits and chronic disease management. HAR systems, however, often underperform on subtle and underrepresented classes, limiting their utility in real-world dietary monitoring. This work builds upon CABiGRU, a convolutional architecture with Bidirectional GRU layers, multi-head attention, and residual connections, designed to capture discriminative temporal patterns from smart- watch accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer data. To improve CaBiGRU's generalization and reduce underfitting in the minority class, we leverage synthetic sensor data windows using a diffusion model and adopt a two-stage training strategy: pre-training CABiGRU on synthetic data, followed by fine-tuning on the real-world data. On the DEO (drinking/eating/other) dataset, the proposed pipeline achieves a balanced accuracy of 90.6%, improving over a strong supervised baseline and showing the benefits of diffusion-based synthetic pre-training for recognizing alimentary activities and representing a step forward dealing with unbalanced classes. These results suggest that combining diffusion-generated data with targeted fine-tuning enhances robust recognition of dietary behaviors, supporting more reliable deployment in healthcare and nutrition-monitoring settings.
zh_title: 基于扩散模型的合成数据预训练用于增强活动识别
translation: 人类活动识别（HAR）对于医疗保健、健康和日常监测应用日益重要，其中检测进食和饮水等饮食活动可以为饮食习惯和慢性病管理提供可操作的见解。然而，HAR系统在微妙且代表性不足的类别上往往表现不佳，限制了其在现实世界饮食监测中的实用性。本研究基于CABiGRU（一种具有双向GRU层、多头注意力和残差连接的卷积架构，旨在从智能手表加速度计、陀螺仪和磁力计数据中捕获判别性时间模式）展开。为了提高CaBiGRU的泛化能力并减少少数类的欠拟合，我们利用扩散模型生成合成传感器数据窗口，并采用两阶段训练策略：首先在合成数据上预训练CABiGRU，然后在真实世界数据上进行微调。在DEO（饮酒/进食/其他）数据集上，所提出的管道实现了90.6%的平衡准确率，超过了强监督基线，展示了基于扩散模型的合成预训练在识别饮食活动方面的优势，并代表了处理不平衡类别向前迈出的一步。这些结果表明，将扩散生成的数据与有针对性的微调相结合，可以增强对饮食行为的稳健识别，支持在医疗保健和营养监测环境中更可靠地部署。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合扩散模型合成数据预训练与微调的两阶段策略，显著提升了人类活动识别中对饮食等少数类活动的识别准确率。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将扩散模型生成的合成数据应用于人类活动识别（HAR）中的少数类样本增强，并通过两阶段预训练策略显著提升了模型在饮食监测等细微任务上的泛化能力。
motivation: 人类活动识别系统在处理细微且代表性不足的类别（如饮食活动）时表现往往不佳，限制了其在现实世界饮食监测中的应用，亟需提升模型对少数类的泛化能力并减少欠拟合。
method: 采用结合扩散模型的两阶段训练策略：首先在合成传感器数据窗口上预训练CABiGRU模型，随后在真实世界数据上进行微调。
results: 在DEO（饮酒/进食/其他）数据集上，所提出的流程实现了90.6%的平衡准确率，优于传统的强监督基线模型。
conclusion: 基于扩散模型的合成数据预训练和微调策略能有效解决人类活动识别中类别不平衡和少数类表现不佳的问题，在DEO数据集上取得了优异的平衡准确率。

title: From Alert Floods to Precedence Forests: Zero-Prior-Knowledge Incident Triage with LOGOS
authors: Radhika Niranjan Mysore
abstract: Commercial observability platforms rely on domain artifacts like distributed traces, topology maps, and baseline metrics. However, when troubleshooting proprietary software, enterprise operators are left with only raw, unannotated text logs. We explore the extreme boundary of log-only diagnosis: To what extent can we isolate failure propagation using strictly raw text logs? We present LOGOS, an unsupervised system that exploits entity-event co-occurrence and temporal precedence to collapse millions of raw log lines into a compact precedence forest. Evaluated across 25 production enterprise outages and 12 open-source issues, LOGOS operates with zero prior knowledge---requiring no seed queries, observed symptoms, or pre-defined incident boundaries. In a median wall-time of 4.5 minutes, LOGOS eliminates a median 99.8% of background noise, achieves 0.76 mean recall, and detects failure cascades with a 16-hour median diagnosis-verified lead time---consolidating alert floods 124x to enable 80% enterprise (100% open-source) zero-shot LLM root-cause accuracy.
