title: Augmenting Large Audio Language Models with Low-Level Acoustic Features for Dysarthric Speech Detection
authors: Mahdi Amiri, Hatef Otroshi Shahreza, Pascal Frossard, Ina Kodrasi
abstract: Automatic dysarthric speech detection approaches can support traditional clinical diagnosis, which relies on costly and time-consuming evaluation by a speech and language pathologist. Existing automatic approaches predominantly rely on deep learning (DL). More recently, Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) have emerged as a promising alternative given their strong performance across various tasks, but their application to dysarthric speech detection has not yet been established. We propose a framework that fine-tunes LALMs for dysarthric speech detection on speech recordings combined with textual information comprising low-level acoustic features and speaker demographics. Across two LALMs, our framework outperforms DL-based baselines, with Qwen2-Audio-Instruct achieving state-of-the-art performance. An ablation study shows that incorporating acoustic features and speaker demographics during fine-tuning improves LALM performance, while LALMs alone exhibit only chance-level zero-shot performance. These findings establish an effective approach for adapting LALMs to dysarthric speech detection.

title: A Two-Element Capsule Antenna for Near-Field Polarization MIMO in Wireless Capsule Endoscopy
authors: Pyry Kiviharju, Lauri Vähä-Savo, Clemens Icheln, Kenichi Takizawa, Katsuyuki Haneda
abstract: Multiple-Input-Multiple-Output (MIMO) technology is considered to be a viable method for spectral efficiency and data rate enhancement in wireless communications. This article presents a two-element capsule antenna with orthogonal current distributions for polarization multiplexing in a wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE) application at 915 MHz. The proposed antenna was evaluated in a MIMO link where it served as the transmitter and an existing on-body antenna was the receiver. The performance was assessed in two distinct environments: an anatomically accurate human body model using full-wave (FW) simulations, and a homogeneous liquid tissue phantom, using both FW simulations and measurements. The former was used to evaluate the performance in a realistic environment and to demonstrate the superiority of the proposed capsule antenna against existing two-element antennas in the literature, while the latter aimed at verifying the antenna design by comparison of simulated and measured MIMO links. We studied channel capacity and eigenvalues for the comparisons. The MIMO link with the proposed antenna provided nearly doubled median channel capacity relative to a baseline single-input-single-output link, consistently in the simulations and measurements. Our results prove the suitability of the proposed antenna for polarization multiplexing and, in terms of channel capacity, establish it as the best conformal two-element capsule antenna design at 915 MHz.

title: Multiclass Speech Classification Under Noise Disparity
authors: Mahdi Amiri, Sayantan Biswas, Mingchi Hou, Pascal Frossard, Ina Kodrasi
abstract: We investigate noise disparity in multi-class speech classification tasks and develop a strategy to prevent classifiers from exploiting class-dependent noise characteristics. Building on our previous work for binary classification, we introduce a multi-class cross-augmentation scheme that exposes each class to the noise characteristics of the other classes, thereby removing the association between individual noise conditions and class labels. We compare this training-based approach with speech enhancement (SE) as a preprocessing strategy, which aims to suppress noise-related cues directly from the input. Experiments on multi-class emotion recognition show that cross-augmentation effectively mitigates the effect of noise disparity across a range of signal-to-noise-ratios, while SE has a detrimental effect on model performance.

title: Learning-Based Beam Adaptation for Active/Passive-Aware Monopulse ISAC with Leakage Suppression
authors: Jafar Norolahi, Alireza Vahid
abstract: This paper proposes a learning-based beam adaptation framework for active/passive-aware monopulse integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) with spatial leakage suppression. A single gNB uses a shared array and orthogonal frequency division multiplexing dual-functional radar-communication signaling to jointly support downlink transmission and monopulse sensing. Radar detections and uplink spatial evidence are fused to distinguish cooperative active directions from passive directions, while a protected angular zone limits unintended illumination. Soft Actor-Critic deep reinforcement learning adapts the transmit beam using communication, sensing, leakage, and previous-action feedback. Numerical results show accurate active/passive spatial classification and robust leakage control as the number of passive targets increases from one to twelve. The proposed SAC controller maintains aggregate passive leakage below the prescribed budget across the full sweep and, from two passive targets onward, achieves the highest leakage-compliant sum rate among the considered baselines.

title: FedSwitch: Federated Region Classification From Wireless Channel Measurements
authors: Mattia Piana, Stefano Rini, Stefano Tomasin
abstract: Wireless Internet-of-Things (IoT) networks can leverage locally observed channel state information (CSI) at base-stations (BSs) to perform region classification, i.e., infer the region of origin of a transmitter (TX), thereby enabling channel-based authentication. However, centralizing these measurements incurs substantial communication overhead and requires sharing location-dependent radio fingerprints. To address these difficulties, we propose an edge-native federated learning (FL) framework where BSs collaboratively train a shared classifier via a parameter server (PS) without exposing raw data, thereby supporting physical-layer security tasks like spoofing detection. To overcome the statistical heterogeneity arising from diverse BS locations and propagation conditions, we introduce FedSwitch, a personalized FL algorithm that automatically transitions edge nodes from collaborative training to local fine-tuning upon loss stagnation. We provide theoretical convergence guarantees for the proposed collaborative training phase and derive analytical bounds linking classification errors to statistical discrepancies. Extensive evaluations on synthetic channel measurements demonstrate that FedSwitch significantly improves region-classification accuracy over standard FL baselines.

title: Joint Discrete Pinching-Antenna Activation and Beamforming Design for Efficient PASS-ISAC
authors: Joshua Ogundiya, Animesh Yadav, Octavia Dobre
abstract: Pinching-antenna systems (PASS) offer flexible radiation points for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), but existing designs largely assume continuous antenna placement, which may be impractical with pre-installed hardware. We investigate a discrete-activation multi-waveguide PASS-ISAC system that selects sparse transmit and receive pinching antennas (TPAs/RPAs) from predefined locations. We formulate a communication-rate maximization problem by jointly optimizing beamforming and TPA/RPA activation under transmit-power, activation, and sensing signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) constraints. To solve this nonconvex problem, we develop a low-complexity joint discrete pinching-antenna activation and beamforming optimization (JDPABO) algorithm based on alternating optimization, successive convex approximation, and reweighted $\ell_1$ minimization. Simulations show that JDPABO approaches continuous-placement performance at low sensing SNR requirements and outperforms fixed activation schemes with sparse PA activation.

title: SAC-Controlled RIS-Assisted Monopulse Radar for Multipath-Robust Vital-Sign Localization
authors: Jafar Norolahi, Alireza Vahid
abstract: Contactless radar sensing offers a promising approach to continuous vital-sign monitoring. However, indoor multipath can distort direction estimates and generate ghost responses. This paper presents a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted monopulse radar whose RIS phase configuration is controlled by a soft actor-critic agent to improve angular localization. The proposed framework combines simultaneous sum and difference beams with a programmable reflected path, enabling a single radar node to adapt the propagation environment without relying on multiple synchronized sensors. A compact multipath model formulates RIS control as a continuous-action reinforcement-learning problem whose reward penalizes bearing errors and misleading multipath reinforcement. Numerical results compare the proposed method with conventional monopulse processing without an RIS, a frequency-modulated continuous-wave range-angle fast Fourier transform baseline, random RIS phase configurations, and deterministic RIS controllers. The evaluation considers different target separations, signal-to-noise ratio levels, and multipath conditions.

title: Outage Probability Analysis of Tunable Liquid Lens-assisted VLC Systems
authors: Kapila W. S. Palitharathna, Nikos A. Mitsiou, Constantinos Psomas, Ioannis Krikidis
abstract: This paper presents a tunable liquid lens (TLL)-assisted indoor mobile visible light communication system. To mitigate performance degradation caused by user mobility and random receiver orientation, an electrowetting cuboid TLL is used at the receiver. By dynamically controlling the orientation angle of the liquid surface through voltage adjustments, signal reception and overall system performance are enhanced. An accurate mathematical framework is developed to model channel gains, and two lens optimization strategies, namely ($i$) the best signal reception (BSR), and ($ii$) the vertically upward lens orientation (VULO) are introduced for improved performance. Closed form expressions for the outage probability are derived for each scheme for practical mobility and receiver orientation conditions. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed TLL and lens adjustment strategies significantly reduce the outage probability compared to fixed lens and no lens receivers across various mobility and orientation conditions. Specifically, the outage probability is improved from $1\times 10^{-1}$ to $3\times 10^{-3}$ at a transmit power of $12$ dBW under a $8^{\circ}$ polar angle variation in random receiver orientation using the BSR scheme.

title: Cellwise, Blockwise, and Casewise Robust Multiblock PCA for Sustainable and Inclusive Wellbeing in the EU
authors: Arthur Daisomont, Fabio Centofanti, Mia Hubert
abstract: Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is widely used to guide economic and social decision-making, but it provides only a partial view of wellbeing. For this reason, the European Union (EU) has launched initiatives to monitor sustainable and inclusive wellbeing beyond GDP, developing indicator frameworks that cover dimensions such as health, education, environment, and social inclusion. These indicators are naturally grouped into thematic areas, and policymakers are interested in understanding how these areas contribute to global wellbeing and which indicators explain differences across countries. However, such data are high-dimensional, contain missing values, and may include anomalies affecting entire observations, specific thematic areas, or individual indicators. We introduce blockwise outliers and propose bloccPCA, a robust multiblock PCA method that simultaneously handles casewise, blockwise, and cellwise outliers, as well as missing values. The method provides robust global components to summarize the overall structure of wellbeing, while preserving thematic-area contributions through robust blockcomponents. It also yields diagnostic tools to identify whether anomalies arise at the case, block, or cell level. Monte Carlo simulations and an application to the EU wellbeing dataset show that bloccPCA provides valuable insights into sustainable and inclusive wellbeing.

title: Bayesian Analysis of Covariate-Driven Hawkes Processes with Application in Plant Epidemiology
authors: Katarzyna Adamczyk-Chauvat, Madalina Deaconu, Sylwester Masny, Guillaume Kon Kam King
abstract: Hawkes processes are widely used to model temporal point patterns exhibiting self-exciting behavior. In this work, we consider a Hawkes model with a baseline intensity depending on a set of dynamic covariates and an exponential triggering function. A Bayesian approach is applied to variable selection in this context. Spike-and-slab priors are proposed to enable a parsimonious choice of relevant variables. We also provide practical simulation procedures for the fitted covariate-driven Hawkes model, which support posterior predictive checks and probabilistic forecasting. This approach is illustrated by the example of spore release of Venturia inaequalis, the fungus responsible for apple scab disease. We study the dependence of primary spore releases on environmental covariates and highlight the self-exciting behavior of subsequent releases. The Bayesian framework also provides a natural basis to forecast future spore releases. By delivering interpretable posterior inclusion probabilities alongside uncertainty-aware predictive risk bands, this new methodology provides a rigorous foundation for managing temporal event risks driven by both external environmental forcing and internal contagion.

title: When defaults cannot be hedged: xVA calculations via local risk-minimization
authors: Francesca Biagini, Alessandro Gnoatto, Katharina Oberpriller
abstract: We consider the pricing and hedging of counterparty credit risk and funding when there is no possibility to hedge the jump to default of either the bank or the counterparty. This represents the situation which is most often encountered in practice, due to the absence of quoted corporate bonds or CDS contracts written on the counterparty and the difficulty for the bank to buy/sell protection on her own default. We apply local risk-minimization to find the optimal strategy and compute it via a BSDE.

title: Estimation of conditional inequality curves and measures via estimating the conditional quantile function
authors: Alicja Jokiel-Rokita, Sylwester Piątek, Rafał Topolnicki
abstract: In the paper conditional inequality curves and measures are proposed which allow us to describe the inequality/concentration of the conditional distribution of the feature we are interested in with respect to certain continuous variables. Moreover, for a graphical illustration of the change in values of the proposed conditional indices, a curve of conditional inequality measures is introduced. To estimate the curves and measures, a new method is proposed to estimate the conditional quantile function. This method uses quantile regression estimates for a given set of quantile orders, followed by isotonic regression on the estimated regression coefficients to ensure that the estimated conditional quantile function is nondecreasing. The consistency of the proposed estimators is proved while their finite sample performance is evaluated through simulation studies and compared with existing approaches. Finally, practical application of conditional curves and measures is demonstrated by determining estimated curves of conditional salary inequalities with respect to years of experience in different employee tenure groups, based on some real data. The code used to prepare the simulation results presented in this paper is available in a dedicated GitHub repository.

title: PreFER: Interactive Robo-Advisor with Scoring Mechanism
authors: Yuwei Wang, Hoi Ying Wong
abstract: We propose an interactive robo-advising framework that learns personalized risk preferences from scores provided by clients. The resulting preference-learning problem is closely related to inverse reinforcement learning (IRL), as the robo-advisor infers the client's latent reward specification from feedback. The robo-advisor interacts with clients iteratively as follows. At each interaction time, the advisor generates investment advice based on the optimal policy distribution derived from an inferred personalized risk preference. The client scores the advice. The advisor updates its assessment of the client's risk preference based on the feedback. This learning procedure motivates us to investigate discrete-time Predictable Forward Exploratory Reward (PreFER) processes and derive an exploratory investment strategy. By interpreting the score as the acceptance probability of a piece of advice, our inverse learning procedure learns the client's exploratory investment distribution using the acceptance-rejection method pioneered by von Neumann. Under CARA preferences, we show that, even though the scores contain noise, the robo-advisor can identify the client's current risk aversion after a sufficiently large number of interactions. The PreFER process then carries the learned preference forward and generates future recommendations under updated market conditions.

title: Reverse Item Response Theory for Sparsity-Robust Ranking in Fragmented Cancer Drug-Response Matrices
authors: Jung Min Kang
abstract: We introduce reverse Item Response Theory (IRT) to pharmacogenomic drug-response analysis by treating cancer types as latent "subjects" with resistance ability and drugs as "items" with evasion difficulty. Applied to 242,036 drug sensitivity measurements from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC2) database, the model estimates cancer-type-level in-vitro resistance and drug-level broad activity on a shared latent scale. Validation across four missingness regimes demonstrates that reverse IRT better recovers the full-data latent ranking than simple averaging, with advantages of Delta-rho = +0.089 to +0.095 at 60% missingness under MCAR, cancer-biased, and drug-biased sparsity. Held-out prediction confirms IRT achieves the best Brier score among five evaluated methods. Bootstrap confidence intervals show 19 of 28 cancer types have stable resistant/sensitive classifications. Cross-platform PRISM replication shows 82% directional agreement but weak rank-order correlation (rho = 0.25), indicating the contribution is methodological robustness under fragmented evaluation, not a universal clinical resistance leaderboard.

title: PEDAL: Open Infrastructure for Citable AI Prompts in STEM Education and Research
authors: Murat Kahveci
abstract: The rapid integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into educational practice has created an urgent need for infrastructure that treats AI prompts not as disposable instructions but as reproducible scholarly artifacts. This paper presents PEDAL (Pedagogical Evaluation, Design, & Analysis Lab), an open-research platform implementing a three-tier Laboratory-to-Archive pipeline: (1) an Orchestration Layer with AI-assisted prompt generation and automated metadata extraction; (2) a Laboratory Layer supporting Git-style version control, LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation, and Mann-Whitney U statistical testing; and (3) a Public Archive Layer with per-version DOI minting via Zenodo, multi-format exports (JSON, CSV, LaTeX), and SEO-optimized discoverability. PEDAL's Scholarly Sync 2 (SS2) framework attaches a 24+ field metadata envelope encoding Bloom's Revised Taxonomy, Webb's Depth of Knowledge, SAMR levels, 5E phases, and NGSS alignment. A chemistry education exemplar demonstrates the full pipeline from Socratic inquiry scaffolding through statistical evaluation to DOI-minted archival. We further present NExAIE (Nexus AI & Education), applying PEDAL's infrastructure to AI-augmented peer review through a 42-prompt evaluation matrix spanning six quality dimensions, introducing Radical Transparency by publicly archiving all review rubrics with DOIs. Initial deployment data -- 4,684 views from 1,810 researchers within one month -- indicates strong demand for citable AI scaffolding in STEM education. Released under CC-BY-4.0 (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19474709).

title: How Far is Adam from Natural Gradient Descent?
authors: Vihaan Paka-Hegde
abstract: Adam is the standard optimizer in deep learning, yet its geometric relationship to natural gradient descent (NGD) contains unresolved questions. We study Adam's full update rule, including momentum, as a diagonal empirical Fisher approximation subject to diagonal truncation, empirical label substitution, and temporal lag. Using the scale-invariant $γ(Δθ)$ metric, we measure Adam's geometric deviation from true NGD across four loss landscapes: well-conditioned linear regression, ill-conditioned linear regression, logistic regression, and a non-convex small neural network. Adam's geometric trajectory is context-dependent. Deviation remains low in well-conditioned settings but rises significantly under ill-conditioning, reaching misalignments of $\approx 10^3$ in the neural network. Higher geometric drift correlates with slower initial optimization but does not degrade final objective minimization; Adam consistently reaches low loss. Furthermore, the improved empirical Fisher (iEF) tracks more stable paths than the standard empirical Fisher (EF), which frequently oscillates or diverges. Our results suggest Adam's practical optimization power may stem from a balance of structural approximation errors and momentum smoothing rather than close tracking of the natural gradient path.
zh_title: Adam 距离自然梯度下降有多远？
translation: Adam 是深度学习中的标准优化器，然而它与自然梯度下降（NGD）的几何关系包含着未解之谜。我们研究了 Adam 的完整更新规则（包括动量），将其视为受对角线截断、经验标签替换和时间滞后影响的对角经验 Fisher 近似。使用尺度不变的 $\gamma(\Delta\theta)$ 指标，我们在四种损失地形（良条件线性回归、病条件线性回归、逻辑回归和一个非凸小型神经网络）上测量了 Adam 与真实 NGD 的几何偏差。Adam 的几何轨迹是与上下文相关的。在良条件设置中偏差保持较低，但在病条件下显著上升，在神经网络中达到了约 $10^3$ 的错位。更高的几何漂移与较慢的初始优化相关，但不会降低最终的目标函数极小化；Adam 始终能达到低损失。此外，改进的经验 Fisher（iEF）比标准经验 Fisher（EF）追踪到更稳定的路径，后者经常振荡或发散。我们的结果表明，Adam 的实际优化能力可能源于结构近似误差和动量平滑的平衡，而不是对自然梯度路径的紧密跟踪。
keywords: 经验 Fisher 信息矩阵
tldr: 本文通过几何分析发现，Adam 优化器与自然梯度下降（NGD）的偏离程度取决于任务的条件数，其成功更多归因于近似误差与动量的平衡，而非紧密跟踪自然梯度。
ai_comments: 该论文从几何角度深入探讨了深度学习中最常用的优化器 Adam 与自然梯度下降（NGD）之间的深层关系，指出了 Adam 在不同条件下的偏差及其对优化过程的影响，对理解自适应优化器具有重要意义。
motivation: 尽管 Adam 是深度学习中的标准优化器，但它与自然梯度下降（NGD）之间的几何关系仍存在未解之谜，需要进一步研究。
method: 将 Adam 的完整更新规则（包括动量）研究为受对角线截断、经验标签替换和时间滞后影响的对角经验 Fisher 近似；并使用尺度不变的 $\gamma(\Delta\theta)$ 指标，在四种损失地形上测量 Adam 与真实 NGD 的几何偏差。
results: Adam 的几何轨迹取决于具体情况：在良好条件下的设置中偏差较低，但在条件恶劣的情况下显著上升（在神经网络中达到约 $10^3$ 的错位）；更高的几何漂移会导致较慢的初始优化，但不会降低最终的收敛效果。此外，改进的经验 Fisher（iEF）比标准经验 Fisher（EF）轨迹更稳定。
conclusion: Adam 的实际优化能力可能源于结构近似误差和动量平滑的平衡，而不是对自然梯度路径的紧密跟踪。

title: STATERA: Hidden Mass Estimation via Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Kinematics using Frozen Temporal Tubelets
authors: Animesh Varma
abstract: Vision models pretrained for frame-level appearance often struggle to infer hidden physical properties from motion. We study center-of-mass (CoM) localization for opaque, asymmetric rigid bodies from short monocular videos, where surface cues and point tracking are unreliable under self-occlusion. We propose STATERA, which adapts a pretrained video backbone (V-JEPA) with mostly frozen weights and a lightweight temporal tubelet mixer to predict per-frame CoM heatmaps and trajectories. To support this task, we introduce the HiddenMass Benchmark, comprising 50K MuJoCo trajectories and a 63-sequence real-world test set with physically calibrated CoM ground truth. In simulation, STATERA-50K-Sigma improves normalized CoM error from 41.7% (DINOv2) to 25.2%. In zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, we observe a fundamental trade-off in supervision: phase-aware targets can induce bimodal predictions, while phase-agnostic targets can collapse toward statistically safe centroids. Nevertheless, our phase-aware STATERA-50K-Crescent is the only evaluated method that demonstrates consistent movement toward the true hidden offset. While this leads to a monocular vector overshoot artifact that marginally increases absolute Euclidean error compared to a static geometric centroid, it improves physics capture from 2.6% to 41.0%. These results suggest that frozen temporal representations can better separate inertial dynamics from visual geometry for hidden-parameter estimation.
zh_title: STATERA：利用冻结时空管子进行零样本仿真到真实世界运动学的隐式质量估计
translation: 针对基于帧级外观预训练的视觉模型在从运动中推断隐藏物理属性时常遇瓶颈的问题，本文研究了短单目视频中不透明、非对称刚体的质心（CoM）定位，此时自遮挡会导致表面线索和点跟踪不可靠。我们提出了STATERA，它通过调整一个预训练的视频骨干网络（V-JEPA，大部分权重冻结）和一个轻量级的时空管子混合器，来预测每帧的CoM热图与轨迹。为支持该任务，我们引入了HiddenMass基准，包含50K条MuJoCo轨迹以及一个包含63个真实世界序列、具有物理标定CoM真值的测试集。在仿真中，STATERA-50K-Sigma将归一化CoM误差从DINOv2的41.7%降低到25.2%。在零样本仿真到真实世界迁移中，我们发现监督方式存在根本权衡：相位感知目标易产生双峰预测，而相位无关目标则会向统计上安全的质心坍缩。尽管如此，具有相位感知的STATERA-50K-Crescent是唯一被评估、且表现出持续向真实隐藏偏移运动的方法。虽然这导致了单目向量过冲伪影，使其绝对欧几里得误差较静态几何质心略有增加，但它将物理捕捉能力从2.6%提升到了41.0%。这些结果表明，冻结的时序表征能更好地将惯性动力学与视觉几何分离，用于隐藏参数估计。
keywords: 零样本仿真到真实世界
tldr: 论文提出了STATERA模型，通过利用冻结的视频骨干网络和时空管子特征，实现了从单目视频中对隐藏刚体质心的准确零样本仿真到真实世界的估计。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出利用冻结的预训练视频骨干网络（V-JEPA）结合轻量级时空管子混合器来进行隐藏物理属性（质心）的估计，并构建了包含模拟与真实世界数据的HiddenMass基准测试。这为零样本仿真到真实世界的物理推理提供了一个有价值的视角，展现了冻结时序表征在分离惯性动力学与视觉几何方面的潜力。
motivation: 现有的预训练视觉模型通常专注于帧级外观，难以从运动中推断出隐藏的物理属性；且在处理不透明、非对称刚体的短单目视频时，表面线索和点跟踪容易因自遮挡而变得不可靠。为此，需要研究如何从运动视频中有效估计隐藏的质量中心（CoM）。

results: 在仿真中，STATERA-50K-Sigma将归一化质心误差从DINOv2的41.7%降低至25.2%；在零样本仿真到真实世界的迁移中，具有相位感知的STATERA-50K-Crescent是唯一展现出向真实隐藏偏移持续移动的方法，将物理捕捉能力从2.6%提升至41.0%。
conclusion: 基于冻结时序管子特征的STATERA方法成功提升了隐式质心定位的物理捕捉能力，证明了预训练视频表征在跨域物理属性推理中的有效性，同时也揭示了零样本仿真到真实世界迁移中监督信号设计的核心权衡。

title: Emergent Object Binding Has a Finite Spatial Horizon
authors: Mayank Singal
abstract: Pretrained Vision Transformers encode whether two image patches belong to the same object. This IsSameObject signal is decodable from frozen patch embeddings at high accuracy, which suggests that object binding emerges from self-supervised pretraining alone. We show that this single accuracy number hides the structure of the signal. Binding is local: the probability that two patches of the same object are decoded as bound falls off monotonically with the distance between them and levels off at a nonzero floor, a falloff well described by an exponential with a finite length scale. This decay holds across object sizes, across three families of probe, on both ADE20K and COCO, and across DINO and CLIP backbones, which indicates that it is a property of the representation rather than of the decoder. Reading binding as local spatial coherence with a finite range accounts for a set of behaviors that the aggregate score leaves unexplained: binding weakens on large objects, separates distinct objects of the same class less reliably than objects of different classes, and groups object parts with their wholes. It is, by contrast, unaffected by occlusion once object size is controlled. We map each behavior with confounds controlled. As a preliminary observation, the horizon and its floor are organized at different depths in DINOv2 and DINOv3, which we report as suggestive given the small number of layers probed and the confound between the two models.
zh_title: 突现的对象绑定具有有限的空间视界
translation: 预训练的视觉Transformer编码了两个图像块是否属于同一个物体。这个IsSameObject信号可以从冻结的块嵌入中以高精度解码出来，这表明对象绑定仅凭自监督预训练就能突现出来。我们发现，这个单一的准确率数字隐藏了信号的结构。绑定是局部的：两个属于同一对象的图像块被解码为绑定的概率随着它们之间的距离单调下降，并在一个非零的下限处趋于平缓，这种衰减可以用具有有限长度尺度的指数很好地描述。这种衰减存在于各种对象大小、三个系列的探针、ADE20K和COCO数据集以及DINO和CLIP骨干网中，这表明它是表征的属性而不是解码器的属性。将绑定解读为具有有限范围的局部空间相干性，解释了一组 aggregate score 无法解释的行为：绑定在大对象上减弱，对同类不同对象的区分不如对不同类对象的区分可靠，并且将对象部分与其整体进行分组。相比之下，一旦控制了对象大小，它就不会受到遮挡的影响。我们在控制了混杂因素的情况下绘制了每种行为。作为初步观察，视界及其下限在 DINOv2 和 DINOv3 中组织在不同的深度，鉴于探测的层数较少以及两个模型之间的混杂因素，我们将其报告为暗示性的。
tldr: 预训练视觉Transformer中的对象绑定能力具有局限性，其空间作用范围是有限的，表现为随距离增加而呈指数衰减的局部空间相干性。
ai_comments: 本文揭示了预训练视觉Transformer中对象绑定能力的一个重要局限性——其空间视界是有限的，且呈指数衰减。这一发现对于理解自监督视觉模型的表征特性具有重要意义，解释了模型在处理大对象或同类相近对象时的失效现象。
motivation: 以往研究表明预训练视觉Transformer能够编码两个图像块是否属于同一对象（IsSameObject），但单一的准确率指标掩盖了该信号的空间结构特性，因此有必要探究对象绑定在空间上的范围及其衰减规律。
method: 通过在不同数据集（ADE20K和COCO）、不同骨干网络（DINO和CLIP）以及多种探针族上测试图像块距离与解码绑定概率的关系，分析IsSameObject信号的空间衰减特性。
results: 研究发现绑定概率随patch间距离的增加而单调衰减，并最终趋于一个非零下限，该衰减可用具有有限长度尺度的指数函数很好地描述；这一局部性解释了模型在大对象、同类不同物体以及整体与部分关系处理中的表现。
conclusion: 对象绑定在预训练视觉Transformer中是局部的，具有有限的空间视界，这深刻影响了模型对图像中物体关系的表征和理解。

title: On-Device Named-Entity Recognition: A Deployability Study of Accuracy, Cost, Reliability, and Confidence
authors: Vinay Kumar Chaganti
abstract: Named-entity recognition (NER) is increasingly wanted on-device (no API, low latency, data kept local). The practitioner's question is not the leaderboard but which model is deployable, how to evaluate it without human annotation, and whether its confidence can be trusted. We answer these jointly. We place nine systems across three paradigms and 13 M to 8 B parameters: a classical tagger (spaCy), bidirectional-encoder specialists (GLiNER, 166 to 460 M), and generative LLMs run locally (Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B), on three datasets of differing character, and report accuracy plus two axes the literature omits: latency and output validity. Because our corpus (RSS-News) had no gold, we built silver gold from a cross-family LLM judge panel, then measured its fidelity against benchmark gold and a full human re-validation of the corpus (strict F1 0.95, an upper bound since the human gold was silver-seeded); gold provenance flips the paradigm ranking, moving from LLM-authored silver to human gold raises every encoder and lowers every generative model. On accuracy alone a 4 B instruct LLM is competitive (it leads on clean newswire), so the encoder's case is deployability: it matches or slightly trails at one-ninth to one-twenty-fourth the size, at millisecond-to-second latency, with zero malformed output, while the smallest generative models emit up to 27% invalid output on long inputs, a failure fixed by scale, not output budget. We then characterize GLiNER's per-span confidence: it ranks correctness well (AUROC 0.76 to 0.86) but is overconfident (ECE 0.24 to 0.47, halved by temperature scaling); thresholding gives a small honest out-of-sample F1 gain; an all-local small-to-large cascade gives a modest, corpus-dependent gain over cost-matched random routing; and confidence tracks correctness but not novelty. Every number recomputes offline from per-span records.
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables. Code and per-span records reproduce all reported numbers offline
zh_title: 端侧命名实体识别：关于准确率、成本、可靠性和置信度的部署研究
translation: 命名实体识别（NER）在端侧的需求日益增加（无需API、低延迟、数据本地保存）。实践者关心的不是排行榜，而是哪个模型可 deployable（可部署）、如何在没有人工标注的情况下评估它，以及它的置信度是否可信。我们共同回答了这些问题。我们将九个系统置于三个范式和13M至8B参数中：一个经典标记器（spaCy）、双向编码器专家（GLiNER，166至460M）以及本地运行的生成式LLM（Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct，DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B），涵盖三个不同特征的数据集，并报告了准确率以及文献所忽略的两个轴：延迟和输出有效性。因为我们的语料库（RSS-News）没有黄金标准，我们通过跨家族LLM裁判组构建了白银黄金，然后测量了其对基准黄金以及语料库完整人工重新验证的保真度（严格F1 0.95，由于人类黄金是白银播种的，因此这是一个上限）；黄金来源会颠覆范式排名，从LLM撰写的白银转向人类黄金会提升所有编码器并降低所有生成式模型。仅就准确率而言，4B指令LLM具有竞争力（在干净的新闻导语中领先），因此编码器的优势在于可部署性：它在实体规模缩小1/9到1/24、延迟在毫秒到秒级别、零畸形输出的情况下，匹配或略微落后；而最小的生成式模型在长输入下会发出高达27%的无效输出，这种失败通过规模扩展而不是输出预算来解决。然后，我们表征了GLiNER的每跨度置信度：它对正确性排序很好（AUROC 0.76到0.86），但过度自信（ECE 0.24到0.47，通过温度标度减半）；阈值化给出了一个小的诚实的样本外F1增益；全本地的小到大级联对成本匹配的随机路由产生了适度的、依赖于语料库的增益；置信度跟踪正确性但不跟踪新颖性。每个数字都是从每跨度记录中离线重新计算的。
tldr: 本文综合评估了端侧命名实体识别（NER）在准确率、成本、可靠性和置信度方面的表现，发现编码器模型在资源受限的端侧场景下比生成式大模型更具实际部署优势。
ai_comments: 该论文深入探讨了端侧命名实体识别（NER）的实际落地问题，超越了传统单纯对比排行榜准确率的局限，综合评估了准确率、成本、可靠性和置信度。特别是指出了生成式大模型在长输入下的输出有效性问题及黄金标准来源对评估结果的颠覆性影响，对实际工程应用具有很高的指导价值。
motivation: 随着端侧对命名实体识别（NER）需求的增长，实践者面临的核心问题不再是简单的排行榜准确率，而是如何选择可部署的模型、如何在没有人工标注的情况下进行评估，以及模型的置信度是否可信。现有文献通常忽略了延迟和输出有效性等关键维度，因此本研究旨在全面解答这些部署考量。
method: 对比了三个范式下的9个系统（参数量从13M到8B，包括经典标记器spaCy、双向编码器GLiNER和本地生成式LLM），在三个不同特性的数据集上进行评估。通过交叉家族LLM裁判组构建白银/黄金标准，并结合全人工重新验证评估准确率、延迟和输出有效性，同时对GLiNER的每跨度（per-span）置信度进行了表征和校准分析。
results: 研究发现，虽然4B指令LLM在准确率上具竞争力，但编码器模型以1/9至1/24的体量、毫秒级至秒级的延迟实现了相媲美或略逊的准确率，且零畸形输出（而最小的生成式模型在长输入下会产生高达27%的无效输出）。此外，黄金标准的来源会颠覆范式排名；GLiNER的置信度能较好地对正确性排序（AUROC 0.76-0.86），但存在过度自信问题（温度标度可减半ECE）。
conclusion: 对于端侧NER任务，尽管大语言模型在干净的新闻语料上表现出竞争力，但双向编码器专家模型（如GLiNER）在参数量、延迟、输出稳定性和综合部署成本方面更具压倒性优势。此外，黄金标准的来源会改变模型排名的结论，且置信度校准对提升模型可靠性至关重要。

title: Bounded-Fidelity Sim-as-Demo-Stage: Mocap Handoff for Governance Benchmarks
authors: Xue Qin, Simin Luan, Cong Yang, Zhijun Li
abstract: Sim-to-real research pursues physics fidelity as a primary objective: simulators are judged by how closely they reproduce real-world contact dynamics. For governance benchmarking of LLM-driven robots, where the simulator demonstrates that an admission/policy/contract/audit pipeline behaves correctly, contact fidelity at object handoffs (grasp, carry, place) becomes a liability: contact-force integration noise injects audit-chain divergence that is structurally unrelated to the governance property under test. We propose bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage, a design pattern that suppresses contact physics within explicitly bracketed handoff envelopes while preserving full dynamics elsewhere. The construction uses MuJoCo's mocap-body primitive driven by a 220-line Python adapter that the governance bridge invokes via structured intents. We formalise audit-chain stability as byte-equality of the hashed event log across replays and identify two structural envelope properties that imply it. Across N=1000 replays per posture, the mocap variant produces one distinct audit-chain hash (1000/1000 byte-identical; Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]); the contact-force baseline produces 584 distinct hashes (993/1000 diverged; CI [0.987, 0.998]). A timestep sweep (1, 2, 5, 10 ms) shows the divergence is structural, not a tuning artefact: it stays at 0.985 at every timestep. Envelope-edge timing jitter (+/-10 simulation steps, 1,400 replays) produces 0 divergence, and audit chains remain byte-equal across K in {1, 2, 3} sequentially handed-off objects (1,500 replays) with sub-linear per-pick-and-place overhead. The pattern gives benchmark designers audit-chain reproducibility at near-zero engineering cost; we also map where it is harmful (sim-to-real validation, policy training, contact-rich tasks) so it is not mis-deployed.
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Reference implementation and data: https://github.com/s20sc/bounded-fidelity-mocap-handoff
zh_title: 有界保真度仿真演示阶段：用于治理基准的动捕交接
translation: Sim-to-real研究将物理保真度作为主要目标：模拟器通过其对现实世界接触动力学的重现程度来评判。对于LLM驱动机器人的治理基准测试，当模拟器证明准入/策略/合约/审计管道表现正确时，对象交接（抓取、搬运、放置）时的接触保真度就成了一种累赘：接触力积分噪声注入了与被测试治理属性结构上无关的审计链分歧。我们提出了有界保真度仿真演示阶段（bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage），这是一种设计模式，它在明确界定的交接包络内抑制接触物理，同时在其他地方保留完整的动力学。该结构使用MuJoCo的mocap-body基元，由一个220行的Python适配器驱动，治理网桥通过结构化意图调用该适配器。我们将审计链稳定性形式化为重放间哈希事件日志的字节相等性，并确定了暗示它的两个结构包络属性。在每个姿势N=1000次重放中，mocap变体产生了一个不同的审计链哈希（1000/1000字节相同；威尔逊95%置信区间[0.997, 1.000]）；接触力基准产生了584个不同的哈希（993/1000分歧；置信区间[0.987, 0.998]）。时间步长扫描（1, 2, 5, 10毫秒）表明这种分歧是结构性的，而不是调整产物：它在每个时间步长都保持在0.985。包络边缘时间抖动（+/-10个模拟步骤，1,400次重放）产生0分歧，并且在K个（{1, 2, 3}）顺序交接对象（1,500次重放）中审计链保持字节相等，具有亚线性的每个抓取和放置开销。该模式为基准设计者提供了接近零工程成本的审计链可复现性；我们还绘制了它有害的领域（sim-to-real验证、策略训练、富接触任务），以防被错误部署。
tldr: 提出了一种在机器人治理基准测试中抑制交接接触物理噪声、保证审计链100%可复现的设计模式。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的“有界保真度”设计模式，巧妙地通过动捕原语绕过接触物理仿真中的噪声，解决了大模型机器人治理基准测试中审计链分歧的痛点，具有极高的工程价值和理论意义。
motivation: 在用于大模型驱动机器人的治理基准测试中，模拟器对物体交接时接触物理的高保真还原会导致接触力积分噪声，从而引发与测试的治理属性无关的审计链分歧。
method: 提出了一种名为“bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage”的设计模式，利用MuJoCo的mocap-body基元和220行的Python适配器，在明确界定的交接包络内抑制接触物理，并在其他地方保持完全动力学。
results: 在1000次重放中，动捕变体产生了完全一致的审计链哈希（1000/1000字节相同），而接触力基准则产生了584个不同的哈希（993/1000分歧），证明该方法有效解决了审计链分歧问题。
conclusion: 有界保真度仿真演示阶段模式有效地消除了接触力积分噪声引起的审计链分歧，在几乎零工程成本下实现了确定性的治理基准复现。

title: FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law
authors: Athanasios Zeris
abstract: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG m = 2) outperform non-admissible Gaussians at the same scale and provide partial protection against bilateral FFT leakage; (4) bilateral FFT leakage scales monotonically with spectral coverage -- narrowband filters (gap > +4) are clean, wideband filters (gap < +2) are leaky; and (5) causal time-domain Morlet at character scale cannot beat BASE-DOT (K=128 taps covers 50% of T=256 context), motivating word-level experiments in the companion MorletQK paper [Zeris, 2026f]. Together, findings (1)-(5) characterise FourierQK as effective in bidirectional attention settings (encoder-style, e.g. BERT), where full-sequence context is available at both training and inference time; autoregressive generation requires a causal spectral variant such as MorletQK [Zeris, 2026f] (decoder-style, e.g. GPT). Code available at: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention
zh_title: 傅里叶QK：滤波器形状、可容许性和泄漏覆盖定律
translation: 频率崩溃注意力[Zeris, 2026e]通过用学习到的频率的带通滤波内积替换Q/K点积，实现了比标准点积注意力更大的收益。一个自然的问题是：哪种滤波器形状效果最好，为什么？我们使用字符级语言建模（TinyShakespeare，6层GPT）上的受控消融实验，测试了关于滤波器属性——直流抑制、奈奎斯特抑制、带宽、中心频率和多尺度覆盖——的五种假设。我们的主要发现是：（1）直流和奈奎斯特分量是有害的（val ~= 2.0，相当于相位随机化），证实了振荡带通结构是必不可少的，而不仅仅是任何低维谱摘要；（2）最优的单尺度带宽为sigma ~= 2个bin，中心在段落尺度（~70个token），相比BASE-DOT带来了Delta = +1.15 nats的清洁增益；（3）可容许滤波器（零均值， mexicanos hat DOG m = 2）在相同尺度下优于不可容许的高斯滤波器，并提供对双边FFT泄漏的部分保护；（4）双边FFT泄漏与谱覆盖成单调关系——窄带滤波器（gap > +4）是清洁的，宽带滤波器（gap < +2）是泄漏的；（5）字符级的因果时间域Morlet滤波器无法超越BASE-DOT（K=128抽头覆盖T=256上下文的50%），这启发了在伴随的MorletQK论文[Zeris, 2026f]中进行词级别实验。总之，发现（1）-（5）将FourierQK表征为在双向注意力设置（编码器风格，例如BERT）中是有效的，其中在训练和推理时间都可以获得完整的序列上下文；自回归生成需要因果谱变体，如MorletQK[Zeris, 2026f]（解码器风格，例如GPT）。代码可在：https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention 获取。
keywords: Alice Corp. v. CLS Bank International
Mayo Collaborative Services v. Prometheus Laboratories
Inc. v. Association for Molecular Pathology
tldr: 该研究探讨了傅里叶注意力机制中滤波器的形状对模型性能的影响，发现直流和奈奎斯特分量有害，最优带宽约为70个token，可容许滤波器优于高斯滤波器，并且泄漏与频谱覆盖成正比。
ai_comments: 该研究对傅里叶注意力机制中的滤波器设计进行了深入的实证分析，提供了关于最优滤波器形状、带宽和可容许性等方面的宝贵见解。研究结果对于理解和改进基于频率的注意力机制具有重要意义。然而，实验主要基于字符级语言模型，其在更复杂的下游任务上的泛化能力有待进一步验证。
motivation: 在频率崩溃注意力机制中，用学习到的频率带通滤波内积取代Q/K点积可以带来显著的性能提升，因此研究者希望确定哪种滤波器形状效果最好以及其原因。
method: 通过在字符级语言建模（TinyShakespeare，6层GPT）上进行受控消融实验，测试了关于滤波器属性（直流抑制、奈奎斯特抑制、带宽、中心频率和多尺度覆盖）的五种假设。
results: 研究发现：（1）直流和奈奎斯特分量对模型性能有害；（2）最优的单尺度带宽约为70个token，比基线模型提高了1.15 nats；（3）可容许滤波器优于非可容许高斯滤波器；（4）双边FFT泄漏与频谱覆盖成单调关系；（5）字符级的因果时间域Morlet滤波器无法超越基线模型，这表明在词级别进行实验的必要性。
conclusion: 研究结果表明，傅里叶QK在双向注意力设置（如BERT）中是有效的，而在自回归生成（如GPT）中需要因果谱变体（如MorletQK）。

title: Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents
authors: Xinyuan Song, Zekun Cai
abstract: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.
zh_title: 长期语言智能体中的重尾记忆痕迹
translation: 长期语言智能体越来越多地依赖外部记忆作为冻结的世界模型，然而当前的记忆系统通常只根据任务成功率或Token成本来评判。我们认为缺失的客体是记忆使用的形状：在有限上下文和重复检索下，智能体记忆可以集中在一个小核心，而将罕见状态留在预测误差累积的长尾中。我们通过保守的尾部审计研究了这一效应，发现集中现象是可复现的，但取决于策略。随机游走智能体会产生与对数正态兼容的检索人工产物，而语义LLM策略则产生最强的与截断幂律兼容的核心-尾部痕迹。受此审计启发，我们提出了核心-尾部世界模型（CTWM），这是一种基于排名的记忆控制器，它使用单一指数 $\tau$ 分配提示词预算，同时保留一个总结的尾部。在合成图世界（Synthetic Graph World）上，与图记忆基线相比，CTWM保留了完整的状态和转移覆盖率，减少了5.9%的提示词Token，并将下半部分尾部预测误差降低了13.6%。相同的配对比较在ALFWorld上产生了持续的Token节省，在LongMemEval上减少了24.48%的Token，且总体准确率相当。这些结果表明，重尾记忆痕迹不仅是有限检索的诊断指标，也是Token高效智能体世界模型的实用控制信号。
tldr: 本文发现了语言智能体记忆使用的重尾分布规律，并据此提出了CTWM记忆控制器，实现了Token的高效利用与尾部预测误差的降低。
ai_comments: 本文揭示了长期语言智能体中记忆使用的重尾分布特性，并据此提出了Core--Tail World Model (CTWM)方法，在减少提示词Token的同时降低了尾部预测误差，为构建高效的智能体世界模型提供了新思路。
motivation: 当前的记忆系统通常仅根据任务成功率或Token成本来评判，忽略了记忆使用的形状（即在有限上下文和重复检索下，智能体记忆集中在一个小核心，而罕见状态留在累积预测错误的重尾中）。
method: 通过保守的尾部审计研究记忆使用形状，并提出Core--Tail World Model (CTWM)，一种基于排名的记忆控制器，通过单一指数分配提示词预算并保留总结的尾部。
results: 在Synthetic Graph World上，CTWM保持了完整的状态和转移覆盖率，减少了5.9%的提示词Token，并将下半部分尾部预测误差降低了13.6%；在ALFWorld和LongMemEval上也实现了显著的Token节省，并保持了准确率。
conclusion: 重尾记忆痕迹不仅是有限检索的诊断指标，更可作为设计Token高效智能体世界模型的实用控制信号。

title: From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution
authors: Stefan G. Creadore
abstract: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures. Engineering validation and descriptive pilot. Public artifacts: https://github.com/praxa-labs/praxa-benchmarks/releases/tag/preprint-v1.4.0
zh_title: 从提案到验证效果：Praxa，一个用于受治理 AI 代理执行的证据绑定框架
translation: 大语言模型代理可以提出并执行动作，但提案、权限、调度、已验证的外部效果以及服务提升是不同的主张。我们提出了 Praxa，这是一个代理框架，通过确定性准入、经纪执行、外部回读、对账和审查提升，显式地表示这些状态。我们报告了四个证据通道。首先，在固定修订版上进行的作者运行的存储库本地审计通过了 1,027/1,027 个单元测试和 89/89 个 Workerd 测试，测量了所有 363 个预期的源文件，并达到了四个覆盖率底线；原始的每个测试的记录副本和独立复现不可用。其次，在跨 12 个策划任务的提供商支持的 Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 试点中，基线和可靠性层组均通过了 37/36（注：原文如此）次严格试验中的 17 次。可靠性层多使用了 37.49% 的输入和 50.73% 的输出标记，因此该试点不支持优越性结论。第三，在调试后、两阶协调代理开发比较中，基线和源代码编写的候选者均完成了 180/180 次试验，具有相同的测量准确度、完全的封闭崩溃恢复以及零受保护违规。候选者少使用了 37.11% 的标记、降低了 33.84% 的估计端点成本，并减少了 11.63% 的步骤；但这并未确立改进的质量、延迟或生产行为。第四，已部署的源代码/配置证据显示了有界的反射、召回核算、内存编译和工具健康路径，但没有生产成果的提升。Praxa 支持的贡献是一个证据绑定的架构，它使权限到效果的转换变得明确且可测试。当前的证据并未确立对抗性安全性、生产安全性、一般的专家优越性、自主递归优化或用户益处。
tldr: Praxa 是一个受治理的 AI 代理执行框架，通过显式状态转换和证据绑定来管理代理动作，但当前证据尚不足以证明其具备生产安全性或通用优越性。
ai_comments: 本文提出了 Praxa 框架，用于规范受治理的 AI 代理执行过程，其最大亮点在于强调基于证据的架构设计和明确的权限到效果转换。作者保持了高度的学术严谨性，坦诚地指出了当前实验证据的局限性。
motivation: 大型语言模型代理虽然可以提出并执行动作，但提案、权限、调度、验证的外部效果以及服务提升是不同的概念，缺乏明确且受治理的执行框架。
method: 引入 Praxa 代理框架，通过确定性准入、经纪执行、外部回读、对账和审查提升来显式表示代理的各个执行状态，并通过四个证据通道进行评估。
results: 在代码库审计、Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 试点、开发对比和部署配置证据中，虽然实现了各项具体测试或效率提升，但未证明全面优于基线或具备生产安全性。
conclusion: Praxa 提供了一个将代理权限到效果转换显式化和可测试的证据绑定架构，但目前的证据尚不能证明其具有普遍的优越性或生产安全性。

title: When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents
authors: Xinyuan Song, Zekun Cai
abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.
zh_title: 因果世界模型何时对模块化LLM代理有帮助
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地通过模块化系统（如订单、支付、inventory和配送服务）进行操作，其中一个模块中的动作会改变另一个模块中哪些转换是有效的。标准世界模型通常拟合观测轨迹，但这并不是干预时规划所需的量：轨迹可能显示支付先于配送，却无法识别是支付授权了配送、库存中介了该效应，还是存在隐藏的触发因素解释了这两者。我们通过FedCausalCompose研究了这一差距，这是一个针对模块化LLM代理的因果世界模型框架，其中本地动作提供跨模块接口的干预-响应证据。我们首先证明，在未阻断的后门路径下，观测世界模型会导致不可约减的干预误差；接口恢复随着干预-响应覆盖率的提高而改善；并且当覆盖率和局部机制误差得到控制时，预言机因果组合可以超越非因果下界。然后，我们在诊断代理设置中测试了由此产生的预测。因果接口在结构化工具环境中帮助最大，在这些环境中API签名暴露了前提条件和下游效应。相比之下，对话和叙事环境通常会忽略原始边列表，除非短注意力锚点使因果信息与决策相关。这些结果确定了LLM代理中因果世界模型的具体条件：当跨模块接口在统计上可识别并以代理在行动时可以使用的形式呈现时，因果结构会有所帮助。
tldr: 本文研究了因果世界模型对模块化大语言模型代理的帮助条件，发现只有在跨模块接口可识别且形式可用时，因果结构才能真正提升代理性能。
ai_comments: 本文深入探讨了因果世界模型在模块化大语言模型代理中的应用条件，创新性地结合了因果推理与模块化系统，指出了纯观察性世界模型的局限性，并明确了因果结构发挥作用的具体场景与边界。
motivation: 标准的世界模型通常拟合观察轨迹，但这并不是干预时规划所需的量（无法区分因果关系、中介变量或混杂因素），因此需要研究因果世界模型何时以及如何帮助模块化LLM代理。
method: 提出了FedCausalCompose框架，利用本地动作为跨模块接口提供干预-响应证据，并通过理论分析与诊断代理设置（如结构化工具环境与对话环境）进行实证测试。
results: 观察性世界模型会产生不可约减的干预误差；因果接口在API签名等预条件和下游效果明确的结构化工具环境中帮助最大，而在对话/叙事环境中往往被忽略，除非有注意力锚点使其与决策相关。
conclusion: 当且仅当跨模块接口在统计上可识别且以代理在行动时可用的形式呈现时，因果世界模型才能真正帮助模块化LLM代理。

title: Spatial Lifting for Dense Prediction
authors: Mingzhi Xu, Tao Zhou, Yong Li, Yizhe Zhang
abstract: We present Spatial Lifting (SL), a novel methodology for dense prediction tasks. SL operates by lifting standard inputs, such as 2D images, into a higher-dimensional space and subsequently processing them using networks designed for that higher dimension, such as a 3D U-Net. Counterintuitively, this dimensionality lifting allows us to achieve good performance on benchmark tasks compared to conventional approaches, while reducing inference costs and \textbf{drastically lowering the number of model parameters}. The SL framework produces intrinsically structured outputs along the lifted dimension. This emergent structure facilitates dense supervision during training and enables single-forward-pass self-consistency-based quality and uncertainty estimation at test time. Spatial Lifting introduces a simple and general modeling strategy that offers a promising path toward more efficient, accurate, and reliable deep networks for dense prediction tasks in vision.
zh_title: 用于密集预测的空间提升方法
translation: 我们提出了空间提升（SL），这是一种用于密集预测任务的新颖方法。SL通过将标准输入（如2D图像）提升到更高维度的空间，随后使用专为该高维空间设计的网络（如3D U-Net）对其进行处理。与直觉相反，这种降维/升维处理使我们能够在基准任务上与传统方法相比获得良好的性能，同时降低推理成本并大幅减少模型参数数量。SL框架沿着提升的维度产生内在结构化的输出。这种突现结构有助于在训练期间进行密集监督，并在测试时实现单前向传播的基于自一致性的质量和不确定性估计。空间提升引入了一种简单而通用的建模策略，为视觉中密集预测任务的高效、准确和可靠深度网络提供了一条有前景的途径。
tldr: 通过将图像升维到高空间进行处理，Spatial Lifting方法大幅减少了模型参数和推理成本，同时提升了密集预测的性能与可靠性。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的空间提升（Spatial Lifting）方法，通过将2D图像等输入提升到更高维度空间进行处理，不仅降低了模型参数量和推理成本，还实现了单前向传播的自一致性质量和不确定性估计，具有很高的效率和实用价值。
motivation: 现有的密集预测方法在效率、参数量和可靠性方面仍有提升空间，作者旨在开发一种能够降低模型参数和推理成本，同时保持或提高性能并具备不确定性估计能力的通用建模策略。
method: 将标准输入（如2D图像）提升到更高维度的空间，并使用专为该高维空间设计的网络（如3D U-Net）进行处理，同时利用升维带来的内在结构进行密集监督和自一致性评估。
results: 在基准任务上取得了良好的性能，同时降低了推理成本，大幅减少了模型参数数量，并支持单前向传递的自一致性质量和不确定性估计。
conclusion: 空间提升（SL）框架为计算机视觉中的密集预测任务提供了一种简单、通用且高效的建模策略，实现了准确性、效率和可靠性的平衡。

title: Topologically Relevant Landmark Selection on Point Clouds
authors: Kaifeng Zhang, Kai Ming Ting
abstract: Persistent Homology (PH) is an important tool in Topological Data Analysis for point clouds, but can be prohibitively expensive for large datasets. A practical approximation is to compute PH on a smaller subset of representative points, known as landmarks. Existing landmark selection methods mainly address challenges such as outlier contamination rather than restoring the topological features of the full dataset. To select topologically relevant landmarks, we propose a landmark selection method based on Hodge Laplacian. It assigns each point a topological relevance score based on its harmonic participation and selects points with high scores as landmarks. By quantifying each point's participation in global homological structures, our method restores the PH of the original point cloud more accurately than geometric baselines and a method built upon local PH on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
zh_title: 点云上拓扑相关的地标选择
translation: 持久同调（PH）是拓扑数据分析中处理点云的重要工具，但对于大型数据集而言，其计算成本可能过高。一种实用的近似方法是在较小的代表性点子集（称为地标）上计算PH。现有的地标选择方法主要解决诸如离群点污染等挑战，而不是恢复完整数据集的拓扑特征。为了选择拓扑相关的地标，我们提出了一种基于Hodge Laplacian的地标选择方法。它根据每个点的谐波参与度为其分配一个拓扑相关性得分，并选择得分高的点作为地标。通过量化每个点对全局同调结构的参与度，我们的方法在合成和真实数据集上，比几何基线和基于局部PH的方法更准确地恢复了原始点云的PH。
tldr: 提出了一种基于Hodge Laplacian的点云地标选择新方法，能更准确地保留大规模点云的全局拓扑特征。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于Hodge Laplacian的点云拓扑相关地标选择方法，创新性地通过量化点在全局同调结构中的参与度来恢复原始点云的持久同调（PH），在计算效率和拓扑特征保留方面表现出优越性。
motivation: 大规模点云上的持久同调（PH）计算成本高昂，而现有的地标选择方法主要关注离群点污染等问题，无法很好地恢复全数据集的拓扑特征。
method: 提出一种基于 Hodge Laplacian 的地标选择方法，通过计算每个点在谐波参与度上的拓扑相关性得分，选择高分点作为地标。
results: 实验表明，该方法比几何基线和基于局部PH的方法能更准确地恢复原始点云的持久同调（PH）。
conclusion: 该方法能够有效选择保留全局拓扑特征的地标点，在合成和真实数据集上均优于现有的几何和局部PH基线方法。

title: What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA
authors: Jiameng Zhang, Hongqiu Wu
abstract: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.
zh_title: 理性传达了什么？角色专业化问答中的消息干预研究
translation: 角色专业化的问答管道越来越多地将理由从推理器传递给验证器，但这种消息实际上带来了什么并不清楚：更好的答案、更强的支持度评估，还是一个新的失败面。我们引入了一种消息干预诊断方法，该方法在固定证据和候选答案的同时，仅改变在推理器-验证器边界传递的理由。在使用DeepSeek作为生成器和验证器的400个MuSiQue、HotpotQA和2WikiMultiHopQA示例中，忠实的理由几乎没有增加比没有理由时更高的答案准确率，而损坏的理由却强烈地改变了支持度判断。在盲验证器提示下，无害的改写仅使支持度偏移0-2.5%，而损坏的理由则使支持度偏移10-22%；显式的理由检查提示将同一模式放大了34-55%。最终答案的变化较小（2-30%），并且只有2.9-35.3%的损坏支持反转与答案变化同时发生。人工审计展示了这为何重要：42个有效的损坏案例中有16个是“损坏过度信任”案例，盲审人类拒绝或标记为不清的损坏理由中，有9/10被模型接受。跨模型和任务边界的检查显示了该通道何时处于活动、放大、惰性或折叠到任务标签中。理由共享应当作为一种验证消息机制来评估，而不仅仅是作为通往更高答案准确率的途径。
tldr: 角色分工问答中传递的“理由”对提升答案准确率帮助不大，但损坏的理由会显著误导验证器的支持度判断，暴露出模型对理由的过度信任问题。
ai_comments: 该论文通过巧妙的消息干预实验，揭示了多Agent/角色分工问答中“理由（rationale）”传递在提升答案准确率上的微弱作用与在影响验证阶段（support judgment）的巨大影响力，为大模型推理与验证管道的设计提供了重要的实证警示和视角转变。
motivation: 角色分工型问答管道越来越多地将理由从推理器传递给验证器，但这种消息传递究竟带来的是更好的答案、更强的支持度评估，还是新的失败面，目前尚不清楚。
method: 引入了一种消息干预诊断方法，在固定证据和候选答案的同时，仅改变推理器到验证器之间传递的理由，并在三个多跳问答数据集（MuSiQue、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA）上使用DeepSeek进行了实验和人工审计。
results: 忠实的理由几乎不增加答案准确率，而损坏的理由会强烈改变支持度判断；人类审计表明存在明显的“理由破坏过度信任”现象，且模型会接受人类拒绝的损坏理由。
conclusion: 理由共享机制应当被作为一种验证消息机制来进行评估，而不仅仅是作为提高答案准确率的途径。

title: Smooth Curves from Curvature-Driven Subdivision
authors: Hassan Ugail
abstract: We introduce and analyse an interpolatory subdivision scheme in which each inserted point is defined by a curvature-profile model rather than by an affine combination of its neighbours, and we establish its convergence and geometric regularity. On each edge, curvatures estimated from circumscribed circles prescribe a curvature profile, the segment is reconstructed by Frenet integration with geodesic shooting, and the new point is taken at half arc length. The construction works identically in the plane and on the sphere, reproduces geodesics and circles exactly, and a unique curvature prefilter turns its planar linearisation into the six-point Deslauriers-Dubuc scheme. The straightening condition of Ewald, Reif, and Sabin fails for this scheme. Measuring only the normal part of the relative distortion repairs their theory, and we prove that the refined polygons converge to a regular interpolatory limit curve with continuous tangent direction and curvature, twice continuously differentiable in arc length. Regularity is thus governed by the normal companion scheme alone, as these authors conjectured.
zh_title: 由曲率驱动细分生成的平滑曲线
translation: 我们引入并分析了一种插值细分方案，其中每个插入的点由曲率轮廓模型而不是其邻居的仿射组合来定义，并确立了其收敛性和几何正则性。在每条边上，根据外接圆估计的曲率规定曲率轮廓，通过带有测地线射击的Frenet积分重建线段，并在半弧长处取新点。该构造在平面和球面上完全相同地工作，能精确复现测地线和圆，并且独特的曲率预滤波器将其平面线性化转化为六点Deslauriers-Dubuc方案。Ewald、Reif和Sabin的矫直条件对该方案失效。仅测量相对畸变的法向部分修复了他们的理论，我们证明了细化多边形收敛于具有连续切线方向和曲率、且按弧长二次连续可微的正则插值极限曲线。因此，正如这些作者所猜想的那样，正则性仅由法向伴随方案本身控制。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于曲率模型的插值细分方案，证明了其可生成具有连续曲率和二次连续可微弧长的光滑曲线。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于曲率驱动的细分方案，打破了传统的仿射组合方法，通过几何方法在平面和球面上实现了高正则性的光滑曲线生成，对几何造型领域具有重要理论价值。
motivation: 传统的细分方案通常由邻居的仿射组合定义插入点，而作者旨在引入和分析一种基于曲率轮廓模型的插值细分方案，以探索其收敛性和几何正则性。
method: 在每条边上利用外接圆估计曲率并规定曲率轮廓，通过采用测地线射击的Frenet积分重建线段，并在半弧长处取新点；通过测量相对畸变的法向部分来修正Ewald、Reif和Sabin的矫直条件。
results: 该结构在平面和球面上均可等效工作，能精确复现测地线和圆；精细多边形收敛于具有连续切线方向和曲率、且按弧长二次连续可微的正则插值极限曲线。
conclusion: 该曲率驱动细分方案在几何上收敛且正则，其规律性仅由法向伴随方案控制，证明了学界此前的猜想。

title: Encoded but Disconnected: Decomposing Vision-Language Model Failures under a Patching Null
authors: Genpei Zhang
abstract: Across three vision-language model architectures (LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B), we report a universal negative finding for mid-layer interpretability. On POPE -- the benchmark common to all three -- the mid layers encode the ground-truth answer in 68-91% of errors, yet this signal is not causally active for the final prediction: residual-stream patching yields 0% non-trivial flip at the layer level on all three architectures, and on two of three at the per-head level (Qwen: 0/12,600 patched forwards). The lone exception, InternVL3 layer-20 head-2, is a non-vocab, self-attending head whose effect is localized to that specific head (p < 1e-4). Despite the null, the errors separate operationally into three failure modes -- Perception Failure, Encoded-but-Disconnected, Prior-Override -- learnable above 60% on all three architectures, and the architecture's prior direction predicts which of two interventions elicits a category-specific response. We report these mitigation effects under oracle labels as evidence the categories are mechanistically real, not as a deployable method.
zh_title: 编码却断开：在修补零效应下分解视觉语言模型的失效
translation: 跨越三个视觉语言模型架构（LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B），我们报告了一个关于中间层可解释性的普遍负面发现。在所有三个模型通用的 POPE 基准测试中，中间层在 68-91% 的错误中编码了真实答案，但该信号对最终预测没有因果活跃性：在所有三个架构的层级别上，残差流修补产生了 0% 的非平凡翻转，在三个架构中的两个（Qwen：0/12,600 次修补前向传播）的每个注意力头级别上也同样如此。唯一的例外是 InternVL3 的第 20 层第 2 个头，这是一个非词表、自我注意力的头，其影响局限于该特定头（p < 1e-4）。尽管存在这种零效应，错误在操作上仍可分为三种失效模式——感知失效（Perception Failure）、编码但断开（Encoded-but-Disconnected）、先验覆盖（Prior-Override）——在所有三个架构上的可学习率均超过 60%，并且架构的先验方向预测了哪种干预能够引发特定类别的响应。我们在神谕标签（oracle labels）下报告这些缓解效果，作为这些类别在机制上真实存在的证据，而不是作为一种可部署的方法。
tldr: 视觉语言模型中间层虽然编码了正确答案，但对最终预测没有因果影响，研究揭示了模型的三种典型失效模式。
ai_comments: 该论文深入探讨了当前主流视觉语言模型（VLM）在中间层可解释性上的一个普遍缺陷（即虽然中间层编码了正确答案，但对最终预测没有因果作用），并通过将错误分解为三种失效模式揭示了其背后的机制，对VLM的可解释性研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 旨在揭示和分解当前视觉语言模型（VLM）在中间层可解释性上的普遍负面发现，即模型内部表征与最终预测之间存在的因果断层现象。
method: 采用残差流修补（residual-stream patching）和逐头修补（per-head patching）等因果干预方法，在POPE基准上测试了三种VLM架构（LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B），并对模型错误进行了三模式操作化分类。
results: 在三个VLM架构中发现普遍的负面现象：中间层在68-91%的错误中编码了真实答案，但残差流修补在层级别上产生0%的非平凡翻转。同时，错误可分为感知失效、编码但断开、先验覆盖三种可学习的失效模式。
conclusion: VLM的中间层虽然编码了正确答案，但在因果上与最终预测脱节；通过错误分类和干预实验证明了模型存在可区分的底层失效机制。

title: Software Project Management with LLM-Based Automation: Coordination, Validation, and Governance in Practice
authors: Ronnie de Souza Santos, Cleyton Magalhaes, Italo Santos
abstract: As software engineering has evolved, development environments have increasingly integrated automated support for tasks such as testing, analysis, and code generation, requiring project management to coordinate both human work and automated workflows. In this paper, we investigate how software project managers perceive changes in their work and learning demands associated with LLM-based automation. Motivated by a gap in software engineering research, which has largely focused on task-level and developer-centered uses of LLMs, we adopted an exploratory case study approach to capture managerial perspectives on automation in practice. Based on the experience of software project managers working in a large, multi-project software organization, our analysis indicates that LLM-based automation influences planning, estimation, coordination, monitoring, and governance activities rather than introducing new formal management practices. Participants described LLMs as becoming embedded in everyday project work, producing uneven effects on productivity, increasing the need for review and validation, and reducing visibility into task execution. These effects contribute to greater reliance on managerial judgment and coordination. Learning demands were perceived as experiential and incremental, centered on understanding LLM capabilities and limitations, critically assessing generated artifacts, and guiding responsible use within teams. The findings provide empirical evidence on how software project management work is adapted in contexts where LLM-based automation is integrated into ongoing software development practice.
zh_title: 基于大语言模型自动化的软件项目管理：实践中的协调、验证与治理
translation: 随着软件工程的发展，开发环境越来越多地集成了对测试、分析和代码生成等任务的自动化支持，这要求项目管理既要协调人类工作，又要协调自动化工作流程。在本文中，我们调查了软件项目管理者如何看待与基于LLM的自动化相关的工作变化和学习需求。受软件工程研究中存在一个空白（该研究主要集中在LLM的任务级和以开发者为中心的使用上）的驱使，我们采用了探索性案例研究方法来捕捉管理层对实践中自动化的看法。根据在大型多项目软件组织中工作的软件项目管理者的经验，我们的分析表明，基于LLM的自动化影响了计划、估算、协调、监控和治理活动，而不是引入了新的正式管理实践。参与者描述了LLM如何融入日常项目工作中，对生产力产生不均衡的影响，增加了审查和验证的需求，并降低了对任务执行的可见性。这些影响导致对管理判断和协调的更大依赖。学习需求被认为是体验式和渐进式的，核心在于理解LLM的功能和局限性、批判性地评估生成的工件，以及指导团队内的负责任使用。这些研究结果为在软件开发实践中整合基于LLM自动化的背景下，软件项目管理工作如何进行调整提供了经验证据。
tldr: 本论文通过案例研究探讨了基于LLM的自动化如何重塑软件项目管理者的工作、协调方式及学习需求。
ai_comments: 该论文首次将研究视角从开发者层面的LLM应用扩展到了软件项目管理层面，通过探索性案例研究揭示了LLM自动化对项目规划、监控及治理的实际影响，具有很高的现实指导意义和创新价值。
motivation: 现有软件工程研究大多集中在任务层面和以开发者为中心的LLM应用上，缺乏从管理视角探讨LLM自动化对软件项目管理工作及学习需求影响的研究。
method: 采用探索性案例研究方法，基于大型多项目软件组织中软件项目管理者的实践经验进行分析。
results: LLM自动化影响了日常的管理活动（如规划、估算、协调等），对生产力产生不均衡的影响，增加了审查和验证的需求，降低了任务执行的可见性，从而加大了对管理判断和协调的依赖。
conclusion: 大语言模型自动化改变了软件项目管理中的计划、估算、协调、监控和治理活动，增加了对管理判断、人工验证以及理解LLM能力与限制的持续学习的需求。

title: Domain generalization and synthetic data in object detection: the enabler, the probe, and the gap
authors: Elfi I.S. Hofmeijer, Ella P. Fokkinga, Friso G. Heslinga, Klamer Schutte, Jörgen M. Karlholm
abstract: Object detection models often experience performance degradation when deployed under distribution shifts, caused by for example changes in weather type, operational environment, or object appearance. Domain Generalization (DG) aims to develop models that remain robust under such shifts and generalize well to unseen domains. DG research specifically focused on object detection models is scarce, although these models face additional challenges around localization and multi-scale representations. Synthetic data is a promising tool to support in DG, by enabling large-scale generation of diverse new samples. In this paper, we present an object detection-centric review of DG and examine the role of synthetic data from three complementary perspectives. First, synthetic data acts as an enabler of DG through diversification and alignment strategies that aim to improve robustness to distribution shifts. Second, it serves as a probe that enables controlled experimentation to identify and understand failure modes. Third, we discuss the synthetic-to-real gap, a particularly challenging form of domain shift that arises when models trained on synthetic imagery are deployed on real-world data. Through reviewing these perspectives, we identify limitations of current DG approaches for object detection and argue that future research requires representation-aware methods that explicitly address both localization and classification under domain shift.
zh_title: 目标检测中的领域泛化与合成数据：赋能者、探测器与差距
translation: 目标检测模型在部署于由天气类型、操作环境或物体外观变化等引起的分布偏移下时，经常会出现性能下降。领域泛化（DG）旨在开发在这些偏移下保持鲁棒性并能很好泛化到未见域的模型。专门针对目标检测模型的领域泛化研究依然稀缺，尽管这些模型面临着关于定位和多尺度表征的额外挑战。合成数据是通过大规模生成多样化新样本来支持领域泛化的有力工具。在本文中，我们提出了一个以目标检测为中心的领域泛化综述，并从三个互补的视角检查了合成数据的角色。首先，合成数据通过旨在提高对分布偏移鲁棒性的多样化和对齐策略，充当了领域泛化的赋能者。其次，它作为一个探测器，支持受控实验以识别和理解失效模式。第三，我们讨论了“合成到真实”的差距，这是当在合成图像上训练的模型部署到现实世界数据时产生的一种特别具有挑战性的域偏移形式。通过回顾这些视角，我们指出了当前目标检测领域泛化方法的局限性，并认为未来的研究需要显式解决域偏移下定位和分类问题的表征感知方法。
tldr: 本文综述了合成数据在目标检测领域泛化中的角色，分析了其作为赋能者、探测器及面临的差距，并指出了未来研究方向。
ai_comments: 该论文从目标检测的中心视角出发，系统探讨了领域泛化与合成数据的角色，指出了当前方法在表征、定位及分类上的局限性，对未来研究方向具有重要的指导意义。
motivation: 由于天气、环境或物体外观变化等分布偏移，目标检测模型在部署时常出现性能退化；尽管合成数据是支持领域泛化的有力工具，但专门针对目标检测模型的领域泛化研究依然稀缺。
method: 从三个互补的视角（赋能者、探测器、合成到真实的差距）对目标检测领域的领域泛化和合成数据作用进行了综述和审查。
results: 识别出了当前目标检测领域泛化方法的局限性，并强调了未来研究需要关注表征感知方法。
conclusion: 未来的目标检测领域泛化研究需要开发能够显式处理域偏移下定位与分类的表征感知方法。

title: Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?
authors: Jundong Hu, Shekar Ramachandran
abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).
comment: Preprint. under review at a NeurIPS 2026 workshop. 15 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables
zh_title: 衡量微任务资格差距：何时现成的SLM足以构建代理？
translation: 代理模型越来越多地希望在前端LLM规划器周围的微任务上运行小型语言模型（SLM）：自动批准shell命令、写入记忆、选择工具、对过去的轮次进行排名。我们询问现成的SLM是否能达到从业者定义的阈值，以及在它们失败时，原因是什么，量化是否会改变答案。我们构建了一个包含4个此类微任务的基准，具有固定的提示和自动指标，每个任务都有一个预先指定的阈值τ，该阈值与廉价的非LLM基线和CI感知的资格规则相关联（只有当其置信区间清除τ时，配置才算通过）。通过在最佳条件下（FP16、贪婪、一个冻结的提示、无调优）测试Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B，我们发现存在一个资格差距：16种配置（4个任务x4个模型）中有0种通过（通过检查原始输出和解析器行为进行验证）。一个对数概率决策阈值诊断（T1/T3/T4；T2通过上下文长度/级联探测）将失败分为能力缺陷和可以通过更改解码阈值解决的失败（4种状态）。量化到4位（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）会造成损害，具体取决于模型大小，并且没有一种配置能够达到资格（在可重构的硬标签任务T1/T3上得到认证，在T2/T4上进行诊断/窗口化鲁棒性测试），因此差距比精度更能反映模型大小；它在Llama-3.x上得到复制（12/12个不合格），并且对于锚点选择（τ-sweep）和提示词措辞（在原始的每个单元格基础上增加3个中性释义词，共112个中112个不合格）具有鲁棒性。实际启示：将SLM置于满足CI支持的阈值的基线之后，并且仅在基线未能达到阈值的地方使用SLM；例如，一个4B的重排序器优于BM25（+0.047 [0.020, 0.073]，而自身不证明资格）。
tldr: 现成的SLM在LLM代理任务的微任务上表现不佳，存在资格差距。量化和模型大小会影响性能，但即使是4位量化也无法弥补差距。建议将SLM置于满足置信区间阈值的基线之后，仅在基线无法满足阈值时使用SLM。
ai_comments: 这项研究解决了LLM代理应用中一个非常实际的问题：现成的SLM是否足够好？研究设计了一个巧妙的基准和评估方法，清晰地揭示了“资格差距”的存在。实验结果表明，即使是相对较大的SLM，在没有进一步微调的情况下，也难以满足LLM代理任务对可靠性和准确性的要求。量化对性能的影响以及其与模型大小的关联性也为模型选择提供了有价值的见解。研究提出的将SLM置于基线之后的策略，为在资源受限的环境中部署LLM代理提供了一个务实的解决方案。然而，未来可以进一步探索哪些类型的微调或提示工程技术可以有效缩小这种资格差距，以及如何更经济高效地评估SLM在更广泛任务上的资格。
motivation: 随着LLM代理越来越普遍，研究人员希望在LLM规划器周围的微任务中使用小型语言模型（SLM），例如自动批准shell命令、写入记忆、选择工具和对过去对话进行排名。然而，尚不清楚现成的SLM是否能满足从业者定义的性能阈值，以及量化等因素如何影响其性能。
method: 该研究构建了一个包含4个微任务的基准，每个任务都有固定的提示和自动评估指标，并预先设定了与廉价非LLM基线相匹配的置信区间（CI）感知的资格规则。研究人员测试了不同大小（0.6/1.7/4/8B）的Qwen模型，并进行了FP16、贪婪解码和无微调的评估。他们还研究了4位量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）的影响，并在Llama-3.x模型上进行了验证。此外，还评估了基线锚点选择和提示词变化的影响。
results: 在所有测试的16种配置（4个任务x4个模型）中，没有一种能够通过资格测试，表明存在“资格差距”。该差距主要与模型大小相关，而非精度。量化到4位会损害性能，并且没有一种量化配置能够达到资格要求。即使对Llama-3.x模型进行测试，结果也类似。资格差距在不同的基线锚点选择和提示词变化下仍然存在。一个4B的重排序器在BM25候选列表上表现优于纯BM25，但其自身的资格仍需验证。
conclusion: 现成的SLM在LLM代理任务的微任务上存在显著的资格差距，无法满足从业者定义的性能阈值。量化（如4位量化）通常会损害性能，并且不能弥补这种差距。因此，建议将SLM置于一个能够满足置信区间阈值的基线之后，仅在基线无法满足阈值的情况下才使用SLM。例如，可以使用一个4B的重排序器来改进BM25的排序结果，但需要注意的是，重排序器自身的资格仍需进一步验证。

title: High-Value Synthetic Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of a Compact Japanese Speech Model
authors: Sidi Chang, Peiying Zhu
abstract: Private domain speech is difficult to collect and redistribute, while compact models need task-specific supervision. We study an auditable synthetic pipeline that maps Japanese care handoffs directly to six-field structured notes. Using 182 synthetic training and development clips, we adapt a 1.47B audio model by full fine-tuning and rank-16 LoRA. On a 39-clip scenario-seed-disjoint synthetic test, an unadapted model obtains a model-judged factuality-recall score of 0.0500, full tuning 0.8664, and LoRA 0.8461. LoRA reaches 97.7% of the full-tuning aggregate as a descriptive ratio while project telemetry reports 12.4M trainable parameters, about 0.85% of the backbone. Both adaptations show large paired gains over the same base; the full-versus-LoRA interval crosses zero, and differing optimization settings preclude an equivalence claim. This is a parameter-efficient capability-acquisition result, not a device-performance result: latency, memory, energy, and real-time factor were not measured. All evaluation speech and targets are synthetic, references are model-proposed, and the judge is uncalibrated. The evidence shows that a compact model can acquire a narrow audio-to-structure transformation from a few hundred provenance-linked synthetic examples; it does not establish clinical validity, real-speech transfer, or superiority to a clean cloud system.
