title: Diffusable Latents from Structure-Agnostic Distillation
authors: Adrien Ramanana Rahary, Nicolas Dufour, Patrick Pérez, David Picard
abstract: Distilling pretrained foundation models into an autoencoder bottleneck improves latent diffusability, enabling diffusion models to converge faster and reach higher sample quality. Standard distillation aligns the latent at each position to a co-located teacher feature, tying the latent layout to the teacher's. We show this constraint is unnecessary: aligning a single pooled image-level descriptor to the teacher's performs as well as or slightly better than dense position-wise distillation. We compare first-order and relational pooled objectives across latent shapes and teacher modalities. First-order matching extends naturally to 1D token-sequence latents and across modalities, where distilling a text encoder into an image autoencoder still improves diffusability; a relational objective based only on each image's nearest neighbours improves it as well. Code and blog post are available at https://github.com/AdrienRR/structure-agnostic-distillation and https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-09-28-structure-agnostic-distillation/.

title: Testing Induced-Subgraph Freeness in Outerplanar Graphs under the Random-Neighbor Oracle
authors: Pan Peng, Kefan Yu
abstract:
We prove that, for every fixed nonempty graph $H$, induced-$H$-freeness is testable with $\varepsilon^{-O_H(1)}$ queries on outerplanar graphs with no maximum-degree bound in the $\textit{random-neighbor model}$, where each query at a vertex returns a uniformly random neighbor. Thus, the query complexity is polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$ and independent of the number $n$ of vertices. Previously, the best bound known for this problem was the $\operatorname{poly}(\log n)$-query guarantee that follows from the general outerplanar-graph tester of Babu, Khoury, and Newman (2016) in the stronger $\textit{adjacency-list model}$, which provides exact degree queries and indexed access to neighbors.
  Our tester has $\textit{two-sided error}$, which is necessary in general: induced-$P_3$-freeness has no one-sided constant-query tester in the random-neighbor model, even on outerplanar graphs of maximum degree two.

title: Graph Residual Conjugate Diffusion: SNR-Equalized Heat Flow for Graph Signals
authors: Jinwei Li, Daniel Tenbrinck
abstract: Diffusion models generate data by reversing a forward corruption process that typically approaches a simple Gaussian prior. Recent work has extended this framework to signals supported on fixed graphs, e.g., road-network traffic and sensor-network measurements. Many graph signals have nonuniform spectral energy, whereas isotropic corruption adds the same conditional noise variance to every graph-frequency mode. Driving all modes to near-zero terminal signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) requires strong corruption, which increases the noise range that must be covered under a fixed sampling budget. We introduce Graph Residual Conjugate Diffusion (GRCD), which replaces the shared clock of graph heat diffusion with a mode-dependent clock that gives every graph-Fourier mode the same conditional SNR. GRCD fits a zero-mean graph-spectral Gaussian reference on the training split and stops at a finite terminal SNR at which the propagated reference still carries the fitted spectral variances. The Gaussian component has an exact modewise propagator in the probability-flow ODE, so sampling advances it analytically and integrates only the learned residual score numerically. We evaluate GRCD on five settings (METR-LA traffic, Molene weather, and three stochastic block models) against seven comparators under a matched protocol: Graph-Aware Diffusion (GAD), EDM (graph backbone), two adaptations of Whitened Score Diffusion (WSD), and three preconditioning controls. At four function evaluations (NFEs), GRCD lowers averaged maximum mean discrepancy (aMMD) by 22 to 36 times over the best comparator on all five settings, reaching 0.054 on METR-LA, where it clears an aMMD 0.1 target with 87% less sampling wall-clock time than the cheapest comparator that reaches it. Fitting the terminal reference reduces aMMD by 2.7 to 7.3 times at finite terminal SNR, while the factors shrink to 1.00 to 1.01 near zero.

title: Typographic Attack Against VLM-based AI-generated Image Detection
authors: Eunmin Lee, Jungwoo Kim, Jong-Seok Lee
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for AI-generated image (AIGI) detection, providing natural-language explanations for authenticity judgments. However, their ability to interpret text within images may also expose these judgments to misleading semantic cues. We systematically evaluate typographic attack strategies across detection-oriented, open-weight, and commercial VLMs, considering both real-to-fake and fake-to-real attacks. Our results show that reasoning modes generally exhibit greater vulnerability than direct modes and that attack effectiveness exhibits pronounced directional asymmetry. Moreover, larger models tend to exhibit higher clean detection accuracy but also higher attack success rates. We further examine attack robustness under image and text transformations and investigate whether overlays indicating the correct class can aid error correction. Together, these analyses characterize how typographic attacks influence authenticity judgments and expose limitations of current VLM-based AIGI detection systems.

title: BAM! Bayesian Anything Model: a foundation model for generative computational imaging
authors: Alessio Spagnoletti, Charlesquin Kemajou Mbakam, Jonathan Spence, Andrés Almansa, Marcelo Pereyra
abstract: Generative models are transforming Bayesian computational imaging, yet the field still lacks physics-aware foundation models. Current practice falls into two camps. Large foundation image models are deployed as plug-and-play priors with zero-shot approximate likelihood guidance, which introduces significant bias and computational cost. Physics-aware generative models avoid this bias, but each is tied to a specific dataset, task and instrument. We introduce BAM (Bayesian Anything Model), a lightweight foundation model for few-step, physics-aware posterior sampling that generalises robustly to unseen data and tasks, zero-shot or with minimal finetuning. BAM upgrades the operator-conditioned Reconstruct Anything Model (RAM) backbone (Terris et al.) into a conditional flow map, so instrument physics is specified at inference time rather than fixed during training. BAM has just 36M parameters and is pre-trained jointly on large image corpora and libraries of forward operators. A single network then draws posterior samples in a few steps, with no likelihood approximation and no guidance weights to tune. Across linear inverse problems on FFHQ, AFHQ, LSUN, DIV2K and the Kohler camera-shake benchmark, BAM outperforms in just 3 steps both specialised models and leading zero-shot methods in sample quality, at a fraction of their computational cost. BAM gives the community an accessible entry point to generative computational imaging, lowers the economic and environmental cost of training imaging models, and opens a new path for research on physics-aware Bayesian computational imaging. Official page: https://bayesian-anything-model.github.io/

title: The Evolution of Attention in Large Language Models: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Emerging Trends
authors: Zhentao Tan, Jingyi Shen, Yanbo Li, Yao Liu, Yue Wu, Jieping Ye
abstract:
Self-attention gives LLMs fine-grained, query-dependent access to context, but dense token interactions incur quadratic prefill cost and a key--value cache growing with context length. Research thus spans explicit-memory compression, sparse access, recurrent state construction, structured state dynamics, and heterogeneous mechanism composition. This survey analyzes these developments as model-internal contextual memory. We introduce a five-dimensional lens---Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration---describing what is represented, how it changes, what is query-eligible, how it is read, and how readouts form outputs. This lens compares overlapping research lines without imposing one computational model.
  We reconstruct mechanism-level developments and architectural adoption using 59 release-level records from 14 major model lineages and 11 high-performing open-weight endpoints. First, explicit-memory and recurrent-state methods retain distinct interfaces but increasingly control overlapping memory functions. Second, heterogeneous architectures increasingly coordinate across network depth: layer-wise composition distributes complementary memory processing across representational stages, while cross-layer reuse carries selected memory and routing artifacts forward. Depth thus becomes a dimension along which contextual memory is constructed and managed. Third, these developments motivate a stateful multidimensional memory-routing hypothesis: persistent memory is organized across temporal scope, network depth, substrate type, and representation granularity, while coordinated Sparse Write and Sparse Read determine what is maintained and what contributes to each query. Overall, efficient sequence architecture design increasingly concerns the organization, lifecycle, and selective use of contextual memory rather than an isolated Attention operator.

title: ChronoGraph: Functional 4D Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Interaction Understanding and Grounded Planning
authors: Chenyangguang Zhang, Malgorzata Gwiazda, Guanlong Jiao, Yuanchen Ju, Federico Tombari, Koushil Sreenath, Marc Pollefeys, Sunghwan Hong
abstract: Embodied agents must determine where to act, anticipate the resulting scene changes, and interpret observed outcomes to guide subsequent actions. This requires connecting 4D interaction understanding, which explains how past actions changed the scene, with spatially grounded planning, which determines how and where to act toward a goal and anticipates the resulting scene changes. We introduce ChronoGraph, a functional 4D scene graph that links actions on affordance parts to semantic and geometric state changes. By representing observed and anticipated transitions in the same form, it provides a shared basis for understanding and planning. We construct ChronoGraphBench through an automatic data engine that converts human-interaction videos and simulated robot trajectories into graph-annotated questions for training and evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on both tasks. Using these annotations, we train ChronoGraphVLM by adapting pretrained VLMs in two stages. Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought supervised fine-tuning teaches the models to reconstruct observed transitions and predict future ones as graph traces before answering. Subsequent joint 4D graph reinforcement learning directly rewards graph properties and answer correctness. Experiments across model scales show improvements over the corresponding pretrained baselines and zero-shot transfer to VLM4D. Real-world demonstrations further show that graph-based planning and affordance grounding support mobile manipulation through existing robot skills without additional fine-tuning.
zh_title: ChronoGraph：结合视觉语言模型的功能性4D场景图，用于交互理解与具身定位规划

title: Distribution of Age of Information in the Erlang Loss System
authors: Nail Akar, Sennur Ulukus
abstract: In this paper, we study the exact distributions of the age of information (AoI) and peak AoI (PAoI) in a bufferless setting in which time-stamped updates, or processed tasks, generated by one or several information sources according to a Poisson process for each source, are submitted to a shared pool of $c$ homogeneous servers with exponentially distributed service times, i.e., the so-called M/M/c/c or the Erlang loss system. We consider three update management policies which come into play when a new update arrives to find all the servers busy: the arriving update is blocked (non-preemptive, NP) as in the Erlang loss system, or it preempts a randomly chosen update of its own source in service (preempt at random, PR), or the stalest such update (preempt the stalest, PS). All three policies preserve the same birth-death structure of the server occupancy process associated with the underlying Erlang loss system. However, their AoI and PAoI distributions can be very different. The approach we take is the absorbing Markov chain (AMC) method, in which a single AoI cycle, rather than the entire sample path of the system, is modeled by an absorbing Markov chain. Via the AMC method, we derive the exact distributions of AoI and PAoI in matrix-exponential form. The method extends to multiple sources sharing the same pool of servers, with the AoI of a given source being affected by the remaining sources only through their aggregate update rate. Numerical examples illustrate the implications of our findings, including distribution-based server provisioning under age violation constraints.
zh_title: Erlang损失系统中信息年龄的分布
translation: 在本文中，我们研究了在无缓冲设置下信息年龄（AoI）和峰值AoI（PAoI）的精确分布。在这种设置中，由一个或几个信息源根据泊松过程生成的时间戳更新或已处理任务，被提交到一个由 $c$ 个具有指数服务时间的同构服务器组成的共享池中，即所谓的M/M/c/c或Erlang损失系统。我们考虑了三种更新管理策略，当新更新到达时发现所有服务器都忙碌时，这些策略会发挥作用：到达的更新被阻塞（非抢占式，NP），如同在Erlang损失系统中；或者它抢占其自身源中正在服务的一个随机选择的更新（随机抢占，PR）；或者抢占最旧的此类更新（抢占最旧的，PS）。所有这三种策略都保留了与底层Erlang损失系统相关的服务器占用过程的相同生灭结构。然而，它们的AoI和PAoI分布可能非常不同。我们采用的方法是吸收马尔可夫链（AMC）方法，其中单个AoI周期，而不是系统的整个样本路径，通过吸收马尔可夫链进行建模。通过AMC方法，我们以矩阵指数形式推导出了AoI和PAoI的精确分布。该方法扩展到多个源共享同一服务器池的情况，其中给定源的AoI仅通过其总更新率受其余源的影响。数值例子说明了我们发现的含义，包括在年龄违规约束下基于分布的服务器配置。

title: From Local Whole-Body VLA Behaviors to Scene-Scale Aerial Manipulation
authors: Weixiang Guo, Rui Jin, Haotian Jin, Xinhang Xu, Ruiyang Liu, Haoran Zhao, Yi Wang, Weiqi Gai, Kun Cao, Lihua Xie
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable task-conditioned interaction, but extending them to scene-scale aerial manipulation remains challenging due to costly whole-body demonstrations, latency-induced action-state misalignment, and cross-site behavior composition. We present a unified framework for synthetic policy training and scene-scale execution on articulated uncrewed aerial manipulators (UAMs). A scene-reconfigurable pipeline synthesizes task-conditioned, kinodynamically feasible trajectories and synchronized multiview observations for VLA training without physical-platform demonstrations. Measured-progress-aligned realization (MPAR) aligns asynchronously returned action chunks with measured execution progress and realizes them as continuous, dynamically feasible trajectories. A relational Scene Graph grounds language goals to object instances and feasible interaction regions, while topology-guided transfer connects local behaviors across sites. Local VLA skills achieve 39/60 successes (65.0%) in simulation under oracle target and feasible-handoff conditions. Under 500-ms added latency, with and without a transient command-update stall, MPAR reduces median takeover phase error by 0.212 s over nominal-time alignment. The complete system completes 21/50 simulated multi-site missions (42.0%) and is further validated on a physical articulated UAM.
zh_title: 从局部全身VLA行为到场景尺度空中操纵
translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型支持任务条件下的交互，但由于昂贵的全身演示、延迟引起的操作-状态错位以及跨站点的行为组合，将其扩展到场景尺度的空中操纵仍然充满挑战。我们提出了一个统一框架，用于在关节式无人机机械臂（UAM）上进行合成策略训练和场景尺度执行。一个场景可重构的管道能够合成任务条件、运动学可行的轨迹和同步多视图观测，用于VLA训练，而无需物理平台演示。测量进度对齐实现（MPAR）将异步返回的动作块与测量的执行进度对齐，并将其实现为连续、动态可行的轨迹。一个关系场景图将语言目标映射到对象实例和可行的交互区域，而拓扑引导的传输则连接跨站点的局部行为。在先知目标和可行切换条件下，局部VLA技能在模拟中取得了39/60的成功率（65.0%）。在增加500毫秒延迟的情况下，无论是否存在瞬态命令更新停滞，MPAR相较于标称时间对齐，将中位数接管阶段误差减少了0.212秒。完整的系统在模拟中完成了21/50的多站点任务（42.0%），并进一步在物理关节式UAM上进行了验证。
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一框架，用于在关节式无人机机械臂（UAM）上进行合成策略训练和场景尺度空中操纵，解决了昂贵的全身演示、延迟引起的操作-状态错位和跨站点行为组合等挑战。

title: Connected Dominating Set on Semi-Ladder-Free Graphs
authors: Sobyasachi Chatterjee, Sushmita Gupta, Saket Saurabh, Sanjay Seetharaman, Anannya Upasana
abstract:
We study \textsc{Connected Dominating Set} on graphs whose closed-neighborhood set systems are $d$-semi-ladder-free. This structural condition strictly generalizes the biclique-free setting and provides a natural regime for connectivity-constrained domination. We obtain both a fixed-parameter algorithm and an approximate kernelization framework for the problem on this class.
  Our algorithmic result is based on a new compact representation theorem for inclusion-wise minimal set covers in $d$-semi-ladder-free set systems. Although the number of minimal set covers of size at most $k$ may be as large as $n^{Ω(k)}$, we show that all such set covers can nevertheless be encoded by a family of at most $k^{kd+1}$ tuples, and that this family can be enumerated in time $\Oh(k^{kd+2}\cdot nm)$. Combining this representation with a \textsc{Group Steiner Tree} subroutine, we obtain an algorithm for \textsc{Connected Set Cover}, which in turn yields an algorithm for \textsc{Connected Dominating Set} running in time $k^{kd+2}\cdot 2^k \cdot n^{\Oh(1)}$ and polynomial space.
  For the preprocessing result, we introduce grouped domination cores and dominator cores, and prove polynomial upper bounds on their sizes in $d$-semi-ladder-free graphs. Using these structures, we obtain, for every fixed $d$ and $\varepsilon>0$, a polynomial-time $(1+\varepsilon)$-lossy compression for \textsc{Connected Dominating Set} to an equivalent reduced instance of size $k^{\Oh(d^2/\varepsilon)}$. The reduced instance is a \textsc{Connected Dominating Set} instance on a $(d+2)$-semi-ladder-free graph.
comment: This is an archived version of the paper accepted at ISAAC 2026
zh_title: 无半阶梯图上的连通支配集问题
translation: 我们研究了闭邻域集合系统为d-无半阶梯（d-semi-ladder-free）的图上的“连通支配集”问题。这一结构条件严格推广了无完全二分图（biclique-free）的设定，为带连通性约束的支配问题提供了一个自然的理论框架。我们针对该图类上的该问题，获得了一个固定参数算法和一个近似核化框架。\n我们的算法结果基于d-无半阶梯集合系统中按包含关系极小的集合覆盖的一个新紧凑表示定理。尽管大小至多为k的极小集合覆盖数量可能高达$n^{\Omega(k)}$，但我们证明所有这类集合覆盖仍可由至多$k^{kd+1}$个元组构成的族进行编码，并且该族可在$\mathcal{O}(k^{kd+2}\cdot nm)$时间内完成枚举。将这种表示与“群斯坦纳树”子程序相结合，我们得到了一个求解“连通集合覆盖”的算法，进而得到了一个在多项式空间内以$k^{kd+2}\cdot 2^k \cdot n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$时间运行的“连通支配集”算法。\n对于预处理结果，我们引入了分组支配核心与支配者核心，并证明了它们在d-无半阶梯图中的大小具有多项式上界。利用这些结构，针对任意固定的d和$\varepsilon>0$，我们获得了“连通支配集”的多项式时间$(1+\varepsilon)$-有损压缩，可将其规约至大小为$k^{\mathcal{O}(d^2/\varepsilon)}$的等价简化实例。该简化实例是定义在$(d+2)$-无半阶梯图上的“连通支配集”实例。
tldr: 本文在更广泛的d-无半阶梯图上给出了连通支配集问题的FPT算法以及多项式大小的$(1+\varepsilon)$-近似核化方案。
ai_comments: 该论文将连通支配集（CDS）问题的可解性从无完全二分图（biclique-free）图类成功拓展到更一般的d-无半阶梯图（d-semi-ladder-free graphs）。其主要理论创新在于提出了极小集合覆盖的紧凑表示定理，即使极小覆盖数量可能达到指数级，仍能利用紧凑元组进行高效编码与枚举；同时提出的分组支配核心结构为设计近似核化（lossy kernelization）提供了强有力的工具。
motivation: 研究闭邻域集合系统为d-无半阶梯图上的连通支配集问题。该结构条件严格推广了无完全二分图（biclique-free）的情形，为受连通性约束的支配问题提供了更广泛的图论环境。
method: 提出了d-无半阶梯集合系统中按包含关系极小集合覆盖的紧凑表示定理，将其编码为大小至多为$k^{kd+1}$的元组族并快速枚举，结合群斯坦纳树子程序求解；在预处理方面，引入了分组支配核心与支配者核心概念，并证明了其多项式大小界限，从而构建有损压缩框架。
results: 获得了运行时间为$k^{kd+2} \cdot 2^k \cdot n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$且仅需多项式空间的FPT算法；同时，针对任意固定的$d$和$\varepsilon>0$，提出了多项式时间$(1+\varepsilon)$-有损压缩算法，将问题规约到大小为$k^{\mathcal{O}(d^2/\varepsilon)}$的$(d+2)$-无半阶梯图等价实例上。
conclusion: 论文证明了在闭邻域系统为d-无半阶梯的图类上，连通支配集问题不仅是固定参数可解的（FPT），而且存在多项式规模的近似核化方案。

title: Aletheia: Permission-Minimality Testing for Coding-Agent Rules
authors: Jieke Shi, Yuchen Chen, Junda He, Yue Liu, David Lo
abstract: Repository instruction files guide coding agents, but also expose them to prompt injection. Malicious rules can request credential access or data transfer while the agent produces a correct patch. We present Aletheia, a framework for permission-minimality testing. Aletheia translates requested authority into a typed language and synthesizes executable sandbox configurations. It runs the unchanged rule and task under full permissions and independent restrictions that remove one permission at a time. Passing independent functional tests under strictly reduced authority provides a dispensability witness, which Aletheia interprets against task context to diagnose suspicious requests. We formalize synthesis and the conditions connecting witnesses to enforced restrictions. On a shared refactoring task, Aletheia executes and detects all 314 AIShellJack attack inputs, with no alarms on five benign templates. Among 80 manually verified benign GHAgentFiles rules, it raises three false positives (3.75%).
zh_title: Aletheia：编码代理规则的权限最小化测试
translation: 存储库指令文件指导编码代理，但也使它们暴露于提示注入。恶意规则可以请求凭证访问或数据传输，而代理则生成正确的补丁。我们提出了Aletheia，一个用于权限最小化测试的框架。Aletheia将请求的权限转换为一种类型化语言，并合成可执行的沙箱配置。它在完全权限下运行未经修改的规则和任务，并通过每次移除一项权限的独立限制来运行。在严格限制权限下通过独立的功能测试，可以提供一个可弃用性证明，Aletheia将此证明与任务上下文进行解释，以诊断可疑请求。我们形式化了合成和连接证明与强制执行的限制的条件。在共享重构任务中，Aletheia执行并检测了所有314个AIShellJack攻击输入，对五个良性模板没有误报。在80个经过人工验证的良性GHAgentFiles规则中，它产生了三个误报（3.75%）。
tldr: Aletheia是一个框架，用于测试编码代理规则的权限最小化，通过运行时检查，确保代理只请求完成任务所必需的权限，从而防御提示注入攻击。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法来解决编码代理中的安全漏洞，特别是提示注入攻击。Aletheia框架通过强制执行权限最小化原则，为提高代码安全性和代理可靠性提供了一个有价值的工具。其在实际攻击和良性规则上的表现令人鼓舞，但未来的工作可以进一步探索其在更复杂场景下的可扩展性和效率。
motivation: 编码代理指令文件在指导代理的同时，也容易受到提示注入的攻击，恶意规则可能在代理生成正确代码补丁的同时，请求凭证访问或数据传输。
method: Aletheia将请求的权限转换为一种类型化语言，并合成可执行的沙箱配置。它在完全权限下运行未经修改的规则和任务，并通过每次移除一项权限的独立限制来运行。在严格限制权限下通过独立的功能测试，可以提供一个可弃用性证明。Aletheia将此证明与任务上下文进行解释，以诊断可疑请求。该框架还形式化了合成和连接证明与强制执行的限制的条件。
results: 在共享重构任务中，Aletheia成功检测到所有314个AIShellJack攻击输入，并且对五个良性模板没有误报。在80个经过人工验证的良性GHAgentFiles规则中，Aletheia产生了三个误报（3.75%）。
conclusion: Aletheia框架能够有效地检测编码代理中的权限最小化问题，并在实际应用中表现出较低的误报率，为防御提示注入攻击提供了一种有前景的解决方案。

title: NodeGround: A Node Classification Benchmark in the Graph Foundation Model Era
authors: Jinmo Lee, Dooho Lee, Minho Jeong, Jaemin Yoo
abstract: Can a pretrained graph model replace training and tuning a separate predictor for each dataset? Answering this requires evaluating prediction quality alongside computational cost. We present NodeGround, a node classification benchmark that puts graph foundation models (GFMs) and dataset-specific supervised learning under a common evaluation framework. The benchmark spans 51 datasets and evaluates six GFMs alongside 15 supervised methods under two label-availability regimes. Shared data partitions, validation-only model selection, controlled hyperparameter searches, and multiple predictive metrics make comparisons systematic, while workflow measurements account for adaptation, training, tuning, and inference. The results favor carefully tuned graph neural networks overall. GraphPFN reaches third place by Elo when more labels are available, yet its relative strengths vary substantially with dataset properties. Efficiency comparisons further qualify the benefits of pretrained reuse: GVT and GraphPFN appear on the Pareto frontiers when supervised methods are represented by their default and fully tuned configurations. Adding intermediate tuning budgets removes this advantage for GVT and leaves GraphPFN extending the estimated frontier in the label-rich setting alone. Thus, reusing pretrained parameters does not yet provide a broadly reliable route to either stronger predictions or cheaper workflows. We release the evaluation pipeline, run-level records, and an open leaderboard at https://github.com/nums-ai/nodeground.
zh_title: 节点地面：图基础模型时代中的节点分类基准
translation: 能否在每个数据集上训练和调整单独的预测器，而不是使用预训练的图模型？回答这个问题需要评估预测质量和计算成本。我们提出了NodeGround，一个节点分类基准，在通用评估框架下对图基础模型（GFM）和特定数据集的监督学习进行评估。该基准涵盖51个数据集，在两种标签可用性条件下评估了六个GFM和15个监督学习方法。共享数据分区、仅验证的模型选择、受控超参数搜索和多项预测指标使比较系统化，而工作流程测量则考虑了适应、训练、调整和推理。结果总体上支持精心调整的图神经网络。当有更多标签可用时，GraphPFN在Elo排名中位列第三，但其相对优势因数据集属性而异。效率比较进一步限定了预训练模型重用的优势：当监督方法由其默认和完全调整的配置表示时，GVT和GraphPFN出现在帕累托前沿。增加中间调整预算消除了GVT的优势，并且仅在标签丰富的设置中，GraphPFN才扩展了估计的前沿。因此，重用预训练参数尚未提供一种广泛可靠的途径来获得更强的预测能力或更经济的工作流程。我们在https://github.com/nums-ai/nodeground发布了评估流程、运行记录和开放排行榜。
tldr: 在图基础模型（GFM）时代，NodeGround基准测试表明，精心调整的图神经网络（GNN）在预测质量和计算成本方面总体上优于GFM。虽然一些GFM在特定条件下表现良好，但它们并未提供广泛可靠的更优预测或更便宜工作流程的途径。
ai_comments: 该研究通过NodeGround基准对图基础模型（GFM）在节点分类任务上的表现进行了全面评估，强调了在评估预训练模型时同时考虑预测性能和计算成本的重要性。研究结果表明，尽管GFM具有潜力，但当前精心调整的监督学习方法在许多情况下仍是更优选择。这项工作为未来图基础模型的研究和应用提供了重要的参考和基准，但也指出了GFM仍需在泛化能力和效率方面取得进一步突破。
motivation: 评估预训练的图模型是否能在图基础模型时代取代针对每个数据集单独训练和调整预测器，需要同时考虑预测质量和计算成本。
method: 提出了NodeGround基准，包含51个数据集，在两种标签可用性条件下评估了6个GFM和15个监督学习方法。通过共享数据分区、仅验证的模型选择、受控超参数搜索和多项预测指标进行系统性比较，并测量工作流程成本（适应、训练、调整、推理）。
results: 总体而言，精心调整的图神经网络表现更优。GraphPFN在标签可用性较高时排名第三，但其相对优势随数据集属性变化很大。在效率方面，GVT和GraphPFN在监督方法代表其默认和完全调整配置时，似乎处于帕累托前沿。增加中间调整预算消除了GVT的优势，并且仅在标签丰富的设置中，GraphPFN才扩展了估计的前沿。
conclusion: 重复使用预训练参数尚未提供一种广泛可靠的途径来获得更强的预测能力或更经济的工作流程。

title: SE-ADD: Self-Evolving Audio Deepfake Detection with Mistake-Driven Supervision
authors: Rong Wan, Wei Xie, Jiaxi Li, Wenwu Wang, Lu Yin, Yiliao Song, Xilu Wang
abstract: Audio deepfake detection (ADD) must remain effective when new spoofing attacks emerge after deployment. Emerging audio language model (ALM)-based ADD methods are built on predefined supervision from ground-truth labels or verified forensic rationales. However, this paradigm overlooks an ALM's own mistakes, which indicate where targeted supervision is most needed. To this end, we first introduce evolving spoofing environments for ALM-based ADD, where a new attack becomes dominant while previously observed attacks persist. Motivated by the above learning-from-mistakes perspective, we further propose SE-ADD, a self-evolving framework that iteratively adapts an ALM via low-rank adaptation (LoRA) using mistake-driven supervision built from its verdicts and self-generated forensic cues. All training samples receive direct authenticity supervision, while misclassified ones receive additional cue-augmented supervision. As verdicts and cues are regenerated by the updated ALM, the resulting supervision evolves accordingly. Experiments on two ALMs demonstrate the effectiveness of SE-ADD in generalizing to unseen attacks, reducing the equal error rate (EER) from $36.72\%$ to $7.52\%$ for Qwen2-Audio and from $19.93\%$ to $3.97\%$ for MOSS-Audio.
zh_title: 自演化音频深度伪造检测与错误驱动的监督
translation: 音频深度伪造检测（ADD）必须在部署后出现新的欺骗攻击时保持有效。新出现的基于音频语言模型（ALM）的 ADD 方法依赖于来自真实标签或已验证的法证依据的预定义监督。然而，这种范式忽略了 ALM 自身的错误，这些错误指明了最需要针对性监督的地方。为此，我们首先为基于 ALM 的 ADD 引入了演化的欺骗环境，其中新的攻击成为主导，而先前观察到的攻击则持续存在。受上述从错误中学习的视角启发，我们进一步提出了 SE-ADD，一个自演化框架，通过使用由其判断和自生成的法证线索构建的错误驱动监督，利用低秩适应（LoRA）来迭代地适应 ALM。所有训练样本都接收直接的真实性监督，而错误分类的样本则接收额外的线索增强监督。随着判断和线索由更新后的 ALM 重新生成，由此产生的监督也随之演化。在两个 ALM 上的实验证明了 SE-ADD 在泛化到未知攻击方面的有效性，将 Qwen2-Audio 的等错误率（EER）从 36.72% 降低到 7.52%，将 MOSS-Audio 的 EER 从 19.93% 降低到 3.97%。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为SE-ADD的自演化音频深度伪造检测框架，通过利用模型自身的错误进行监督，以适应不断出现的新的伪造攻击。实验证明，SE-ADD能显著提高模型对未见攻击的泛化能力。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的 SE-ADD 框架在音频深度伪造检测领域具有重要的创新性。通过利用模型自身的错误进行监督，解决了传统方法在面对新型攻击时泛化能力不足的问题。错误驱动的监督机制以及低秩适应（LoRA）的应用，使得模型能够更有效地适应动态变化的环境。然而，生成法证线索的准确性和鲁棒性可能是该方法的一个潜在挑战。
motivation: 现有的音频深度伪造检测方法依赖于预定义的监督信号，忽略了模型自身在识别错误时提供的宝贵信息，而这些错误恰恰指明了最需要针对性监督的方向，尤其是在面对不断演变的新型攻击时。
method: 提出了一种名为SE-ADD的自演化框架，该框架利用低秩适应（LoRA）技术，并结合由模型自身判断和生成的法证线索（forensic cues）所驱动的监督信号来迭代地更新音频语言模型（ALM）。所有训练样本都接收直接的真实性监督，而错误分类的样本则获得额外的、经过线索增强的监督。随着模型判断和线索的不断更新，监督信号也随之演化。
results: 在两个音频语言模型（Qwen2-Audio 和 MOSS-Audio）上的实验表明，SE-ADD 能够有效地泛化到未知的攻击类型。具体来说，Qwen2-Audio 的等错误率（EER）从 36.72% 降低到 7.52%，MOSS-Audio 的 EER 从 19.93% 降低到 3.97%。
conclusion: SE-ADD 通过引入错误驱动的监督，能够有效地适应不断演变的新型音频伪造攻击，显著提升了音频深度伪造检测的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: A Graph Theoretic Approach to Spatial Modeling of Post Disaster Shelter Camps Using Rainbow and Roman Domination Parameters
authors: Didem Gözüpek, Piotr Lange, Joanna Raczek
abstract: Effective spatial organization of post-disaster shelter camps is essential for ensuring access to basic services while making efficient use of limited space and resources. In this paper, we propose a graph-theoretic framework for shelter-camp facility placement based on rainbow $k$-domination and Roman domination. Rainbow $k$-domination models the simultaneous accessibility of distinct facility types, such as sanitation units, kitchens, water points, and schools, whereas Roman domination is used to represent services with different capacity levels, illustrated through Wi-Fi deployment. We present an $O(nk)$-time algorithm for finding a minimum rainbow $k$-dominating set of a tree with $n$ vertices, which is linear in $n$ for fixed $k$, and computational experiments confirm its scalability on large instances. For general graphs, we establish new lower and upper bounds on the rainbow $k$-domination number. We further investigate its relationship with Roman domination, derive structural properties of graphs attaining the extremal equality between the two parameters, and prove that recognizing such graphs is NP-hard. These results provide a theoretical foundation for domination-based approaches to facility placement in post-disaster shelter planning.
zh_title: 使用彩虹和罗马支配参数对灾后避难营地进行空间建模的图论方法
translation: 灾后避难营地的有效空间组织对于确保基本服务的可达性，同时高效利用有限空间和资源至关重要。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于彩虹k-支配和罗马支配的图论框架，用于避难营地设施选址。彩虹k-支配模拟了不同设施类型（如卫生单元、厨房、水点和学校）的同时可达性，而罗马支配则用于表示具有不同容量水平的服务，通过Wi-Fi部署进行说明。我们提出了一种在n个顶点的树图中找到最小彩虹k-支配集的O(nk)-时间算法，对于固定的k，该算法是n的线性时间复杂度，并且计算实验证实了其在大规模实例上的可伸缩性。对于一般图，我们建立了彩虹k-支配数的新下限和上限。我们进一步研究了它与罗马支配的关系，推导了达到两个参数之间极值相等的图的结构特性，并证明了识别此类图是NP-难的。这些结果为基于支配的灾后避难规划中的设施选址方法提供了理论基础。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于彩虹k-支配和罗马支配的图论框架，用于灾后避难营地的设施选址，旨在优化有限空间和资源下的服务可达性。研究包括树图的算法、一般图的界限以及与罗马支配的关系和NP-难性证明。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将图论中的彩虹k-支配和罗马支配参数应用于灾后避难营地的空间建模和设施选址问题，为优化有限资源下的服务可达性提供了新颖的理论框架和计算方法。其提出的树图算法具有实际应用潜力，而对一般图的理论分析也加深了对这些支配参数的理解。
motivation: 有效组织灾后避难营地的空间对于确保基本服务的可达性，同时高效利用有限空间和资源至关重要。
method: 本文提出了一个图论框架，用于基于彩虹k-支配和罗马支配的避难营地设施选址。彩虹k-支配用于模拟不同设施类型（如卫生单元、厨房、水点、学校）的同时可达性，而罗马支配则用于表示不同容量级别的服务（如Wi-Fi部署）。
results: 1. 提出了一种在n个顶点的树图中找到最小彩虹k-支配集的O(nk)-时间算法，对于固定的k，该算法是n的线性时间复杂度，并通过计算实验证实了其在大规模实例上的可伸缩性。2. 建立了关于一般图的彩虹k-支配数的新下限和上限。3. 调查了彩虹k-支配与罗马支配之间的关系，推导了达到两个参数之间极值相等的图的结构特性。4. 证明了识别这些图是NP-难的。
conclusion: 这些结果为基于支配的灾后避难规划中的设施选址方法提供了理论基础。

title: Unapologetically Distributed: A Call for Decentralized Document Analysis
authors: Adrià Molina, Oriol Ramos Terrades, Josep Lladós
abstract: Privacy has become an increasingly important concern in the Document Analysis community, to the extent that in many environments such as archives, governmental institutions, and local businesses, the adoption of automation is restricted by legal and policy constraints. While federated learning has often been regarded as a ``necessary evil'', implying an unavoidable performance trade-off in exchange for decentralization and privacy, many prior works overlook its potential to improve robustness to out-of-distribution data. In this paper, we present Unapologetically Distributed, the first comprehensive study evaluating distributed learning in Document Analysis along three key axes simultaneously: the tasks addressed, the architectures employed, and the fine-tuning strategies applied. Specifically, we demonstrate how various distributed training approaches enhance generalization capabilities across diverse tasks such as Table Recognition, handwriting recognition, and Word Spotting, particularly during transfer learning stages. Our results provide strong evidence that decentralization is not merely a constraint, but a valuable opportunity to improve model robustness and adaptability in real-world Document Analysis scenarios.
zh_title: 毫不犹豫地分布式：呼吁去中心化文档分析
translation: 隐私已成为文档分析领域日益重要的关注点，以至于在许多环境（如档案馆、政府机构和本地企业）中，自动化的采用受到法律和政策的限制。虽然联邦学习通常被视为一种“必要的妥协”，意味着为了去中心化和隐私而牺牲性能，但许多先前的工作忽略了其提高对分布外数据鲁棒性的潜力。在本文中，我们提出了“毫不犹豫地分布式”，这是第一个全面评估分布式学习在文档分析中应用的综合研究，沿着三个关键维度同时进行：处理的任务、采用的架构以及应用的微调策略。具体来说，我们证明了各种分布式训练方法如何增强跨越表格识别、手写识别和词语识别等多样化任务的泛化能力，特别是在迁移学习阶段。我们的结果有力地证明，去中心化不仅仅是一种限制，更是改善现实世界文档分析场景中模型鲁棒性和适应性的宝贵机会。
tldr: 该研究首次全面评估了分布式学习在文档分析中的应用，涵盖任务、架构和微调策略，并证明去中心化不仅是隐私的必要措施，还能提高模型的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于，它不仅将分布式学习视为解决隐私问题的“必要之恶”，更深入地挖掘了其在提升模型泛化能力和鲁棒性方面的潜力。通过在文档分析领域同时考虑任务、架构和微调策略这三个关键维度，该研究提供了迄今为止最全面的评估。其结论具有重要的实际意义，表明去中心化可以成为改进现实世界文档分析系统性能的积极因素。未来可以进一步探索不同分布式策略在更广泛的文档分析任务和更复杂的真实世界场景中的具体效果。
motivation: 隐私问题限制了自动化在文档分析领域的应用，而传统的联邦学习被视为性能的妥协。本研究旨在探索分布式学习在文档分析中的潜力，证明其不仅能解决隐私问题，还能提升模型性能。
method: 在文档分析领域，对分布式学习进行了全面的评估，同时考虑了任务、架构和微调策略。评估了不同的分布式训练方法在表格识别、手写识别和词语识别等任务上的表现，特别是在迁移学习阶段。
results: 分布式学习方法显著增强了模型在各种文档分析任务上的泛化能力，尤其是在迁移学习过程中。研究结果表明，去中心化是一种提升模型鲁棒性和适应性的有效途径。
conclusion: 去中心化不仅是文档分析领域应对隐私挑战的必要手段，更是一个提升模型泛化能力、鲁棒性和适应性的重要机遇，尤其是在实际应用场景中。

title: RoboCoach: World Models as Active Coaches for Compositional Robot Skills
authors: Jiajun Liu, Yifan Chen, Yichao Liu, Jiayi Zhang, Ruoqu Chen, Shaoxuan Xie, Guocai Yao, Mengdi Xu, Sen Cui, Changshui Zhang
abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation reuses skills across many task compositions, but improving these compositions with additional end-to-end demonstrations is costly. A practical self-improving system must decide both what to teach next and where to apply that supervision. We present ROBOCOACH, a world-model-guided coaching framework that uses imagined failures to guide demonstration requests and expert updates. Its Route-Imagine-Diagnose-Improve (RIDI) loop executes reusable skill experts inside COACHWORLD, our shared action-conditioned world model, and uses a progress judge to record the first subtask that fails to complete. Aggregated records select which subtask demonstrations to acquire and which expert adapters to update. Across two simulation suites and two real-robot platforms, imagined and deployed success correlate over 22 task-policy pairs (rho = 0.840). Controlled comparisons show that our coaching method outperforms matched baselines under matched data budgets and update schedules. With only 150 additional subtask demonstrations, success rises from 13.3% to 75.0% on Franka and from 40.0% to 83.8% on AgileX. The coached experts also transfer to four held-out compositions, achieving an average success of 35.0%, compared with 0% for a shared-policy baseline updated with uniformly acquired demonstrations. Together, these results show that world models can serve as active coaches, turning imagined failures into targeted supervision for modular policy improvement. Project Page: https://robocoach-ai.github.io/
zh_title: RoboCoach：作为组合机器人技能主动教练的世界模型
translation: 长周期机器人操作在多个任务组合中重用技能，但通过额外的端到端演示来改进这些组合成本高昂。一个实用的自改进系统必须决定下一步教什么以及在哪里应用这些监督。我们提出了 ROBOCOACH，这是一个世界模型指导的教练框架，它利用想象中的失败来指导演示请求和专家更新。其“路线-想象-诊断-改进”（RIDI）循环在我们的共享动作条件世界模型 COACHWORLD 中执行可重用的技能专家，并使用进度判断器记录未能完成的第一个子任务。聚合记录选择要获取哪些子任务演示以及要更新哪些专家适配器。在两个模拟套件和两个真实机器人平台上，想象的成功与部署的成功在 22 个任务策略对中相关（rho = 0.840）。受控比较表明，在匹配的数据预算和更新计划下，我们的教练方法优于匹配的基线。通过仅 150 次额外的子任务演示，Franka 上的成功率从 13.3% 提高到 75.0%，AgileX 上的成功率从 40.0% 提高到 83.8%。经过指导的专家还迁移到四个未见过的组合中，平均成功率为 35.0%，而使用统一获取的演示更新的共享策略基线的成功率为 0%。总之，这些结果表明世界模型可以充当主动教练，将想象中的失败转化为模块化策略改进的有针对性的监督。项目网页：https://robocoach-ai.github.io/
tldr: 通过世界模型模拟失败来指导机器人子任务的数据采集与更新，大幅提升了机器人组合技能的成功率与泛化能力。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将世界模型应用于机器人技能的闭环自监督指导中，通过“想象失败”来精确定位技能瓶颈，大幅减少了对全链路人类演示的依赖，具有很高的实用价值和迁移能力。
motivation: 长周期机器人操作需要跨任务组合复用技能，但通过额外的端到端演示来改进这些组合的成本高昂，因此需要一个能自主决定“教什么”和“在哪里监督”的自改进系统。
method: 提出了ROBOCOACH框架，包含Route-Imagine-Diagnose-Improve (RIDI)循环。利用动作条件世界模型COACHWORLD运行可复用技能专家，通过进度评估器记录失败子任务，进而指导演示请求和专家适配器的更新。
results: 在两个仿真套件和两个真实机器人平台上，想象成功率与实际部署成功率高度相关（rho = 0.840）。在Frank和AgileX平台上，仅需150个额外的子任务演示，成功率就分别从13.3%提升至75.0%和从40.0%提升至83.8%，且训练出的专家能够良好迁移至未见过的任务组合。
conclusion: 世界模型可以作为主动教练，通过想象失败有效指导模块化机器人的策略改进和数据采集，显著优于传统的均匀数据采集基准方法。

title: MC-PanDA++: Simpler, Stronger, and More Robust Domain-Adaptive Panoptic Segmentation
authors: Ivan Martinović, Josip Šarić, Yuki M. Asano, Siniša Šegvić
abstract: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) reduces the annotation burden in panoptic segmentation by leveraging a cost-effectively labeled source domain (e.g., synthetic) and an unlabeled target domain to bridge the distribution gap. Existing panoptic UDA methods rely on teacher-student consistency learning built upon suboptimal per-pixel segmentation architectures. In contrast, state-of-the-art mask transformers are rarely adopted due to their pronounced vulnerability to confirmation bias in consistency learning, where erroneous teacher predictions are reinforced during training. Our earlier approach, MC-PanDA, mitigates this issue through fine-grained confidence estimation, which suppresses gradients from unreliable masks while sampling informative yet reliable locations for loss computation. However, this method entails a complex multi-stage training and requires careful hyperparameter tuning. This work presents MC-PanDA++, which addresses these limitations by introducing: (i) self-supervised vision encoders that provide a stronger and more robust initialization, further reducing the reliance on human annotations, (ii) per-class, self-adapting mask-wide loss scaling that stabilizes training and enables the usage of a single set of hyperparameters across domains, and (iii) a single-stage training pipeline that decreases overall conceptual complexity. Together, these improvements result in a conceptually simpler, better-performing, and more robust method for domain-adaptive panoptics. Source code: https://github.com/martinovicivan/MC-PanDA
zh_title: MC-PanDA++：更简单、更强、更鲁棒的域自适应全景分割
translation: 无监督域自适应（UDA）通过利用成本效益高的有标签源域（例如合成数据）和无标签目标域来弥补分布差距，从而减轻全景分割中的标注负担。现有的全景UDA方法依赖于构建在次优每像素分割架构之上的师生一致性学习。相比之下，最先进的掩码Transformer很少被采用，因为它们对一致性学习中的确认偏差具有明显的脆弱性，即错误的教师预测在训练过程中被强化。我们早期的工作MC-PanDA通过细粒度置信度估计缓解了这一问题，该估计抑制了不可靠掩码的梯度，同时采样信息丰富但可靠的位置进行损失计算。然而，该方法涉及复杂的多阶段训练，并且需要仔细调整超参数。这项工作提出了MC-PanDA++，它通过以下方式解决了这些局限性：（i）引入自监督视觉编码器，提供更强且更鲁棒的初始化，进一步减少对人类标注的依赖；（ii）引入按类别、自适应的掩码级损失缩放，稳定训练并允许跨域使用单一的一组超参数；（iii）采用单阶段训练管道，降低整体概念复杂度。这些改进共同促成了一种概念上更简单、性能更好且更鲁棒的域自适应全景分割方法。
tldr: 提出MC-PanDA++，通过自监督初始化、自适应损失缩放和单阶段训练，解决了掩码Transformer在全景域自适应中的确认偏差和训练复杂问题。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入自监督视觉编码器、自适应掩码级损失缩放以及单阶段训练流程，显著简化了MC-PanDA的训练复杂度，同时提升了域自适应全景分割的性能和鲁棒性，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有全景域自适应方法依赖于亚优化的像素级架构，而最先进的掩码Transformer容易受到一致性学习中确认偏差的影响；此外，早期的MC-PanDA方法存在多阶段训练复杂和超参数调谐繁琐的问题。
method: 引入自监督视觉编码器提供鲁棒初始化，设计每类自适应的掩码级损失缩放以稳定训练，并采用简化的单阶段训练流程。
results: 实现了概念更简单、性能更好且更具鲁棒性的域自适应全景分割方法。
conclusion: MC-PanDA++通过自监督初始化、自适应损失缩放和单阶段训练，成功解决了现有掩码Transformer在全景域自适应中对确认偏差敏感且训练复杂的问题，实现了更简单、更强劲的域自适应全景分割。

title: When the Label Ignores the Request: Auditing Policy-Selected Targets in Synthetic Conversational Music Recommendation
authors: Sanjeev Suresh
abstract: Synthetic dialogues generated by LLM pipelines now serve as complete conversational-recommendation benchmarks: an LLM listener talks to an LLM recommender, and the track logged next in the conversation becomes the official label for each turn. These policy-selected labels make large-scale evaluation reproducible, but they are proxies for what the simulated user asked. We audit the one place where label and request are directly comparable: turns where the user asks for an exact song by name. In the RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay benchmark, using visible dialogue and catalog metadata alone, we find that the official label contradicts the user's exact-song request in half of the audited development turns. This matters beyond one benchmark: naming the desired item is the dominant intent in real music search, where deployed systems avoid substituting an alternative for an exactly named item, on the premise that it costs satisfaction. A small training-time supplement closes most of the gap: adding catalog-resolved request-satisfying targets to a small fraction of training turns yields a 53.3% relative gain in nDCG@20 on the 43 conflict turns while leaving the official metric intact, verified against a matched control that detects the same requests but trains only on official labels.
comment: 6 pages, 2 tables. Camera-ready version (CC BY 4.0). RecSys Challenge 2026 Workshop at ACM RecSys 2026, Minneapolis, October 2, 2026. Code and audit artifacts: https://github.com/Sanjeev-S/recsys2026-request-audit
zh_title: 当标签忽略请求：合成会话音乐推荐中策略选择目标的审计
translation: 由LLM管道生成的合成对话现在充当了完整的会话推荐基准：一个LLM听众与一个LLM推荐器对话，对话中记录的下一首曲目成为每个轮次的官方标签。这些策略选择的标签使大规模评估具有可重复性，但它们只是模拟用户实际需求的代理。我们审计了标签和请求可以直接比较的一个地方：用户按名称精确请求歌曲的轮次。在RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay基准中，仅使用可见对话和目录元数据，我们发现官方标签在半数审计开发轮次中与用户的精确歌曲请求相矛盾。这不仅限于一个基准：命名所需项目是真实音乐搜索中的主要意图，在此类搜索中，部署的系统避免为精确命名的项目替代其他项目，因为这会损害用户满意度。一个很小的训练时补充填补了大部分差距：将目录解析的、满足请求的目标添加到一小部分训练轮次中，在43个冲突轮次中使nDCG@20取得了53.3%的相对增益，同时保持官方指标不变，并通过检测相同请求但仅使用官方标签训练的匹配对照组进行了验证。
tldr: 大语言模型合成推荐基准中的官方标签常与用户的精确请求相矛盾，通过引入小比例的真实请求满足目标，可以在不破坏官方评估的前提下大幅提升推荐性能。
ai_comments: 该论文聚焦于大语言模型合成对话音乐推荐基准中的标签噪声问题，发现官方日志标签与用户实际精确请求在半数情况下存在冲突。创新点在于通过审计精确匹配请求揭示了代理标签的缺陷，并提出了一种轻量级的训练补充方案，在不损害官方指标的前提下显著提升了推荐准确性。这对于对话式推荐系统的评估和训练具有重要启示。
motivation: 由大语言模型管道生成的合成对话已被广泛用作会话推荐基准，但作为官方标签的“下一首曲目”往往只是用户请求的代理，可能与用户的真实意图不符，因此需要对其进行审计和修正。
method: 审计了RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay基准中用户明确按名称索取歌曲的对话轮次，比较了官方日志标签与用户实际请求的一致性，并提出在训练时补充一小部分经目录解析的满足请求的目标。
results: 在审计的开发轮次中，官方标签有一半与用户的精确歌曲请求相矛盾。通过在少量训练轮次中加入目录解析的请求满足目标，在43个冲突轮次上的nDCG@20相对提升了53.3%，同时保持官方指标不变。
conclusion: 利用合成对话进行推荐系统评估时，代理标签经常与用户的真实请求相矛盾。通过引入少量与用户请求相符的目标进行训练，可以有效解决这一冲突并提升推荐性能。

title: ShieldCLIP: Selective Safety Alignment for Harmful Content Mitigation in Multimodal Foundation Models
authors: Tobia Poppi, Silvia Cappelletti, Samuele Poppi, Marcella Cornia, Lorenzo Baraldi, Diego Garcia-Olano, Rita Cucchiara
abstract: Multimodal encoders such as CLIP underlie many downstream systems, but their web-scale training data embed harmful associations that safety alignment must suppress without unnecessarily changing benign representations. Because ethical and practical constraints prevent collecting real unsafe content at scale, existing datasets pair safe real samples with generated counterparts, but label every generated sample unsafe, even when one modality is individually safe. To address this, we introduce ShieldCLIP, the first framework to condition safety alignment on the observed safety state of each modality rather than the origin of a sample, preserving safe content while redirecting only what is unsafe. We also introduce ViSUv2, a 195k-quadruplet dataset with independent per-modality safety labels across 578 concepts and 28 categories. Using these labels, ShieldCLIP defines a four-way conditional objective beyond pair-level supervision: safe content is anchored, unsafe modalities are redirected to their safe counterparts, mixed pairs update only the unsafe branch, and coherence is enforced when both are unsafe. We evaluate ShieldCLIP on cross-modal retrieval, text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion v1.4 and SDXL, and image-to-text generation with LLaVA. Across these settings, ShieldCLIP consistently reduces harmful outputs over prior safety-aligned encoders and strong mitigation baselines, while preserving the utility of the original embedding space. Extensive ablation studies further show that both modality-specific supervision and the selective alignment objective contribute to these gains. Source code, trained models, and ViSUv2 (under a controlled-access protocol) will be made publicly available at https://aimagelab.github.io/ShieldCLIP/.
zh_title: ShieldCLIP：多模态基础模型中用于缓解有害内容的选择性安全对齐
translation: 诸如CLIP等多模态编码器是许多下游系统的基础，但其网络规模的训练数据嵌入了有害关联，安全对齐必须在不必要地改变良性表示的情况下抑制这些有害关联。由于伦理和实际限制阻止了大规模收集真实的不安全内容，现有的数据集将安全的真实样本与生成的对应样本配对，但将每个生成的样本都标为不安全，即使其中一个模态单独来看是安全的。为了解决这个问题，我们推出了ShieldCLIP，这是第一个将安全对齐条件化建立在每个模态观察到的安全状态（而不是样本来源）之上的框架，它在保留安全内容的同时只重定向不安全的内容。我们还推出了ViSUv2，这是一个包含195k四元组的数据集，跨越578个概念和28个类别，具有独立的每模态安全标签。利用这些标签，ShieldCLIP定义了一个超越成对监督的四路条件目标：锚定安全内容，将不安全的模态重定向到其安全的对应项，混合对仅更新不安全的分支，并在两者的模态都不安全时强制保持一致性。我们在跨模态检索、使用Stable Diffusion v1.4和SDXL的文本到图像生成以及使用LLaVA的图像到文本生成上评估了ShieldCLIP。在这些设置中，与先前的安全对齐编码器和强缓解基线相比，ShieldCLIP始终减少有害输出，同时保留原始嵌入空间的实用性。广泛的消融研究进一步表明，模态特定的监督和选择性对齐目标都对这些增益做出了贡献。源代码、训练模型和ViSUv2（在受控访问协议下）将在 https://aimagelab.github.io/ShieldCLIP/ 上公开提供。
tldr: 提出ShieldCLIP框架与ViSUv2数据集，通过基于模态独立安全状态的选择性对齐，在有效缓解多模态模型有害内容的同时保留了良性内容的效用。
ai_comments: 该论文针对多模态基础模型（如CLIP）的安全对齐问题，创新性地提出了基于模态独立安全状态的ShieldCLIP框架以及大规模数据集ViSUv2。其核心贡献在于实现了选择性安全对齐，能够在有效抑制有害内容的同时，最大程度地保留良性内容的实用性，克服了传统方法对整个样本对进行无差别标注或修改的局限性。
motivation: 现有的安全对齐数据集将所有生成样本一概标注为不安全，忽略了单模态可能安全的情况，导致在抑制有害内容时破坏了良性表示的实用性。为此需要一种能够根据各模态实际安全状态进行选择性对齐的方法。
method: 提出ShieldCLIP框架，基于观察到的各模态安全状态进行条件化安全对齐；引入包含独立模态安全标签的195k四元组数据集ViSUv2；设计超越成对监督的四路条件化目标函数。
results: 在跨模态检索、文生图（Stable Diffusion v1.4和SDXL）以及图生文（LLaVA）任务的评估中，ShieldCLIP在减少有害输出的同时，有效保持了原始嵌入空间的实用性。
conclusion: ShieldCLIP通过条件化安全对齐与ViSUv2数据集，在不损失模型原有实用性的前提下，显著降低了多模态基础模型的有害输出。

title: GFD-OPD: Guidance-Folded On-Policy Distillation of Diffusion Models Across Scales
authors: Zhenxing Zhang, Jiayan Teng, Wenxu Wu, Zhuoyi Yang, Jiazheng Xu, Wendi Zheng, Jie Tang, Dan Guo, Meng Wang
abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has demonstrated two important capabilities in language models: compressing large teachers into smaller students and merging expert models into a single model. Existing diffusion OPD, however, mostly focus on the latter, with teachers and students sharing the same backbone and scale. We investigate large-to-small diffusion opd from large teachers to a small student and find that the standard recipe fails. To find the underlying cause, we propose Fixed-State KL, an effective and fair way to measure the distribution gap between student and teacher during OPD training for diffusion models. We are the first to clarify why large-to-small OPD is challenging for diffusion models: a smaller student struggles to perfectly match the distribution of a larger teacher, while classifier-free guidance can accumulate and amplify the distributional discrepancies between the student's conditional and unconditional branches and those of the teacher. To solve this problem, we propose GFD-OPD, a simple yet effective method that reduces the student-teacher gap while avoiding the error amplification of the CFG composition. Across numerous experiments, GFD outperforms previous baselines in both training efficiency and final performance, achieving state-of-the-art results on all benchmarks.
zh_title: GFD-OPD：跨规模扩散模型的引导折叠在线策略蒸馏
translation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在语言模型中展示了两项重要能力：将大型教师模型压缩为较小的学生模型，以及将专家模型合并为单一模型。然而，现有的扩散模型OPD主要关注后者，教师和学生共享相同的骨干网络和规模。我们研究了从大型教师到小型学生的大到小扩散OPD，发现标准方法失效了。为了找出根本原因，我们提出了Fixed-State KL，这是一种有效且公平的方法，用于衡量扩散模型在OPD训练期间学生与教师之间的分布差距。我们首次阐明了为什么大到小OPD对扩散模型具有挑战性：较小的学生难以完美匹配较大教师的分布，而分类器自由引导（CFG）会累积并放大学生条件分支与无条件分支之间相对于教师的分布差异。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了GFD-OPD，这是一种简单而有效的方法，它既能减小师生差距，又能避免CFG组合的误差放大。通过大量实验，GFD在训练效率和最终性能上均优于以前的基线，在所有基准测试中都取得了最先进的结果。
tldr: 本文提出了GFD-OPD方法，解决了扩散模型跨规模在线策略蒸馏（large-to-small OPD）中由于CFG导致的误差放大问题，显著提升了蒸馏小模型的效率和性能。
ai_comments: 本文针对扩散模型中跨规模的在线策略蒸馏（large-to-small OPD）进行了深入研究，首次揭示了分类器自由引导（CFG）在误差累积与放大上的负面影响，并提出了GFD-OPD方法，在训练效率和最终性能上均取得了突破，具有很高的实用价值和理论贡献。
motivation: 现有的扩散模型在线策略蒸馏（OPD）主要集中于同等规模模型的合并，而直接将大模型蒸馏到小模型的跨规模OPD方法往往会失效，其根本原因尚不明确，因此需要探究其失败原因并寻找有效的解决方案。
method: 提出了“Fixed-State KL”方法来准确测量扩散模型在OPD训练过程中的师生分布差距，并在此基础上设计了GFD-OPD方法，在减小师生差距的同时避免CFG组合带来的误差放大。
results: 通过大量实验证明，GFD-OPD在训练效率和最终性能上均超越了以往的基线方法，在所有基准测试中均取得了最先进的结果。
conclusion: 本文提出的GFD-OPD方法有效解决了扩散模型在跨规模在线策略蒸馏中由于分类器自由引导（CFG）导致的误差放大问题，实验证明其在训练效率和生成性能上均达到了最先进的水平。

title: Values as Style: Disentangling Values from Semantics with One-Way Mixing for Low-Damage LLM Steering
authors: Jiale Dai, Hongcan Deng, Liuxian Ma, Xiaoke Niu, Guojie Song
abstract: Value steering should change an LLM's normative priorities while preserving the scenario, facts, and task constraints underlying its answer. Conventional activation edits often change both. We introduce an editable semantic-value interface on frozen residual states, with a one-way semantic-to-value pathway that grounds value recognition in context. Stop-gradient blocks feedback through this pathway; swap consistency, topic de-confounding, and decorrelation encourage selective codes. At inference, editing the value code produces a residual delta while holding the semantic code fixed. On two instruction-tuned backbones, this interface improves semantic preservation and reduces benign refusals at comparable value alignment. A matched mixing-by-gating ablation separates representation learning from selective edit activation, and dimension-matched probes establish improved code selectivity. Against validation-selected prompting on LLaMA-3.1-8B, the method achieves comparable alignment (0.750 vs. 0.748), higher BERTScore (0.938 vs. 0.923), and fewer contradictions (5.1% vs. 7.6%). Human ratings and cross-taxonomy controls provide complementary evidence for low-damage value steering.
zh_title: 作为风格的价值观：通过单向混合解耦价值观与语义以实现低损害的LLM引导
translation: 价值观引导应该在改变大语言模型（LLM）规范优先级的同保持其回答背后的场景、事实和任务约束。传统的激活编辑通常会同时改变这两者。我们在冻结的残差状态上引入了一个可编辑的语义-价值观接口，其中包含一个将价值观识别扎根于上下文的单向语义到价值观通道。停止梯度模块阻止了通过该通道的反馈；交换一致性、主题解混杂和去相关性促进了选择性编码。在推理时，编辑价值观代码会产生残差增量，同时保持语义代码固定。在两个指令微调的主干网络上，该接口在可比的价值观对齐下提高了语义保持能力并减少了良性拒绝。匹配的门控混合消融实验将表示学习与选择性编辑激活区分开来，维度匹配的探测证实了改进的代码选择性。与LLaMA-3.1-8B上验证选择的提示相比，该方法实现了可比的对齐（0.750对0.748）、更高的BERTScore（0.938对0.923）和更少的矛盾（5.1%对7.6%）。人工评分和跨分类法对照为低损害价值观引导提供了补充证据。
tldr: 提出了一种在大语言模型中解耦价值观与语义的方法，实现低损害的价值观引导，在保持语义和减少矛盾的同时达到优秀的对齐效果。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的方法，通过引入单向混合机制和停止梯度等技术，在冻结的残差状态上解耦大语言模型的价值观与语义，从而在实现价值观引导的同时最小化对语义和事实的破坏。这一创新对于提高大语言模型对齐的安全性和鲁棒性具有重要意义。
motivation: 传统的激活编辑方法在改变大语言模型规范优先级的（价值观引导）同时，往往会无意中改变其背后的场景、事实和任务约束，因此需要开发一种能够在改变价值观的同时保持语义不变的低损害引导方法。
method: 引入一个可编辑的语义-价值观接口，包含从语义到价值观的单向通道，并在该通道上应用停止梯度块；通过交换一致性、主题解混杂和去相关性来鼓励选择性编码；在推理时，固定语义代码同时编辑价值观代码以产生残差增量。
results: 在两个指令微调的主干网络上，该接口提高了语义保持能力，减少了良性拒绝。相比LLaMA-3.1-8B上的提示词方法，该方法达到了可比的对齐度（0.750对0.748），更高的BERTScore（0.938对0.923），以及更少的矛盾（5.1%对7.6%）。
conclusion: 该方法成功在冻结的残差状态上实现了价值观与语义的解耦，在保持同等价值观对齐水平的同时，显著提升了语义保持能力，减少了良性拒绝和逻辑矛盾。

title: STELLA: A 16nm Spatio-Temporal Elastic Low-Latency CGRA for Multi-Stage Pipelined Applications
authors: Jun Yin, Chao Fang, Ryan Antonio, Xiaoling Yi, Yunhao Deng, Fanchen Kong, Marian Verhelst
abstract: Emerging non-matrix ML kernels, such as LayerNorm, GeLu, FFT or circular convolutions, demand low-latency, energy-efficient spatial accelerators beyond MatMul-centric arrays. STELLA presents a spatio-temporal elastic 16 nm coarse-grained reconfigurable array (CGRA) with a rapid configuration path, per-PE hardware loop control, and a low-latency, deeply pipelined elastic fabric with spatio-temporal data reuse. STELLA reaches up to 110 GOPS/mm2 at 850 MHz, and improves effective kernel throughput by 4.84-7.14x over baseline CGRAs.
zh_title: STELLA：面向多阶段流水线应用的一款16纳米时空弹性低延迟CGRA
translation: 新兴的非矩阵机器学习内核（如LayerNorm、GeLu、FFT或循环卷积）需要超越传统矩阵乘法阵列的低延迟、高能效空间加速器。STELLA提出了一种时空弹性的16纳米粗粒度可重构阵列（CGRA），具有快速配置路径、每个PE的硬件循环控制，以及支持时空数据复用的低延迟、深度流水线弹性架构。STELLA在850 MHz下可达到高达110 GOPS/mm2的性能，并将有效内核吞吐量较基准CGRA提升了4.84-7.14倍。
tldr: STELLA是一款16nm时空弹性低延迟CGRA加速器，专为非矩阵机器学习算子设计，吞吐量比基准提升最高达7.14倍。
ai_comments: STELLA在非矩阵机器学习核心算子（如LayerNorm、GeLu等）的处理上展现出了极高的能效和吞吐量，通过时空弹性和深度流水线设计有效打破了传统CGRA的瓶颈。
motivation: 新兴的非矩阵机器学习内核（如LayerNorm、GeLu、FFT或循环卷积）对超越传统矩阵乘法（MatMul）阵列的低延迟、高能效空间加速器提出了迫切需求。
method: 采用16纳米工艺实现，引入了快速配置路径、每个处理单元（PE）的硬件循环控制、低延迟且深度流水线的弹性架构，并支持时空数据复用。
results: 在850 MHz频率下，STELLA的计算密度高达110 GOPS/mm2，相比基准CGRA，有效内核吞吐量提升了4.84至7.14倍。
conclusion: STELLA芯片成功实现了高算力密度和极佳的内核吞吐量，为非矩阵机器学习内核及多阶段流水线应用提供了一种高效的硬件加速方案。

title: Better Supervision Is Nearby: Neighborhood On-Policy Self-Distillation
authors: Xincheng Wei, Yifan Ding, Yoshua Li, Yuquan Lu, Ziheng Li, Yi Lu, Dongsheng Ma, Rongxiang Weng, Xunliang Cai
abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains mathematical reasoning models using a privileged teacher that sees a reference solution and supervises student-sampled prefixes. Standard OPSD uses one fixed parameter setting at every state, but nearby settings may offer additional supervision. We find that local parameter perturbations reveal complementary reference-aligned corrections under the same reference context. Different experts supply these corrections at different reference positions. Their pool covers more such positions than the unperturbed privileged teacher. We introduce Neighborhood OPSD (N-OPSD) to turn these corrections into supervision at student-visited states. Offline, greedy selection builds a compact pool of frozen experts by rewarding filtered reference-token gains beyond the pool's current best at each position. The highest-peak expert need not provide the best training target. Online routing therefore separates the anchor direction from its level of support. MaxPeak selects the anchor token, and quantile selection chooses among experts whose top token matches it. The student learns from the chosen expert's full next-token distribution through the clipped forward-KL objective inherited from OPSD. We evaluate on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT February 2025. Across three independent runs per method, Neighborhood OPSD improves the three-benchmark Average@12 over OPSD by 2.75, 1.67, and 1.94 points on Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B, respectively. Student-prefix continuations support using the pool beyond the reference trajectories used for selection. Matched ablations support filtered reference-token gains as a selection criterion. Accounting for overlap within the pool and routing by state further improve student accuracy. Inference uses only the distilled student.
zh_title: 更好的监督就在附近：邻域样本内自蒸馏
translation: 样本内自蒸馏（OPSD）使用一个能够看到参考解决方案并监督学生采样前缀的特权教师来训练数学推理模型。标准的OPSD在每个状态下使用一种固定的参数设置，但邻近的设置可能提供额外的监督。我们发现，局部参数扰动在相同的参考上下文下可以揭示互补的、与参考对齐的校正。不同的专家在不同的参考位置提供这些校正。它们的集合比未扰动的特权教师覆盖了更多的这类位置。我们引入邻域OPSD（N-OPSD）将这些校正转化为学生访问状态下的监督。离线时，通过奖励过滤后的参考令牌增益（超出当前池中最佳专家的增益）来构建一个紧凑的冻结专家池。最高峰专家不一定提供最佳的训练目标。因此，在线路由将锚点方向与其支持水平分开。MaxPeak选择锚点令牌，分位数选择在匹配其的专家中进行选择。学生通过继承自OPSD的裁剪前向KL目标，从所选专家提供的完整下一个令牌分布中学习。我们在AIME 2024、AIME 2025和HMMT February 2025上进行了评估。在三种独立运行的实验中，邻域OPSD在Qwen3-1.7B、4B和8B模型上，将三个基准的Average@12指标分别比OPSD提高了2.75、1.67和1.94个百分点。学生前缀续接支持在用于选择的参考轨迹之外使用该池。匹配的消融实验支持将过滤后的参考令牌增益作为选择标准。考虑池内的重叠以及按状态进行路由可以进一步提高学生准确性。推理仅使用蒸馏的学生。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为邻域样本内自蒸馏（N-OPSD）的新方法，通过利用局部参数扰动来增强数学推理模型的训练。与标准的样本内自蒸馏（OPSD）不同，N-OPSD引入了一个由多个“专家”组成的池，这些专家可以提供更全面的监督信号，尤其是在参考轨迹之外。通过离线选择和在线路由机制，N-OPSD能够有效地利用这些专家来提高学生模型的性能。实验结果表明，N-OPSD在多个数学推理基准测试中显著优于OPSD。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的N-OPSD方法在数学推理任务中取得了显著的性能提升，这表明利用邻近参数设置的监督信号是一种有前景的研究方向。然而，离线构建专家池和在线路由机制的计算开销可能是一个需要考虑的因素。此外，该方法在不同模型规模和不同类型推理任务上的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 标准的样本内自蒸馏（OPSD）在训练数学推理模型时，仅使用一个固定的教师模型来提供监督信号。然而，研究人员发现，通过对教师模型进行局部参数扰动，可以获得额外的、与参考答案一致的校正信息。这些校正信息在不同的参考位置由不同的“专家”提供，并且这些专家的集合比单一的教师模型能够覆盖更多的参考位置。因此，该研究的动机是利用这些邻近的、更丰富的监督信号来改进模型训练。
method: 该研究提出了一种名为邻域样本内自蒸馏（N-OPSD）的方法。该方法首先通过离线过程构建一个由多个“专家”组成的池，这些专家是通过对固定参数设置进行局部扰动产生的。在离线选择阶段，通过奖励在每个位置超过当前池中最佳专家所能提供的参考令牌增益来构建一个紧凑的专家池。然后，在在线训练阶段，学生模型使用一种分离了锚点方向和支持程度的路由机制。MaxPeak选择锚点令牌，而分位数选择则在匹配锚点令牌的专家中进行选择。学生模型通过继承自OPSD的裁剪前向KL目标，从所选专家提供的完整下一个令牌分布中学习。
results: 在AIME 2024、AIME 2025和HMMT February 2025三个基准测试上，使用Qwen3-1.7B、4B和8B模型进行评估。在三个独立运行的实验中，邻域样本内自蒸馏（N-OPSD）在三个基准测试上的平均准确率（Average@12）相比标准的样本内自蒸馏（OPSD），分别提高了2.75、1.67和1.94个百分点。此外，学生前缀的续接能力表明，专家池可以用于参考轨迹之外的数据。匹配的消融实验支持使用过滤后的参考令牌增益作为选择标准。考虑专家池内的重叠以及按状态进行路由可以进一步提高学生模型的准确性。
conclusion: 邻域样本内自蒸馏（N-OPSD）是一种有效的模型训练方法，它通过利用局部参数扰动产生的多个“专家”来提供更丰富的监督信号，从而显著提高了数学推理模型的性能。该方法在参考轨迹之外的场景中也表现良好，并且可以通过优化选择和路由策略进一步提升效果。最终的推理过程仅使用蒸馏后的学生模型。

title: A helps B while B hurts A: directed transfer in instruction-tuning mixture
authors: Nima H. Siboni, Vahid Rostami
abstract: Adapting a language model to a specialized corpus means choosing which instruction-tuning tasks to train on under a fixed budget, and testing one choice costs a fine-tuning run. Common heuristics add more source tasks or pick sources similar to the target. The first assumes transfer is never negative; the second, that it is symmetric. We show that both assumptions fail: task $A$ can help task $B$ while $B$ hurts $A$, so helpfulness is a signed property of ordered source--target pairs. We introduce the transfer map, a signed estimate of how much each source helps or hurts each held-out target. We fit the map in hundreds of fine-tuning runs on Qwen3 and Mistral models from 0.6B to 32B parameters, with all sources drawn from one corpus and no training examples from the target. The map predicts a held-out target's accuracy on unseen mixtures: recorded before those runs, its predictions have less than half the error of a mixture-agnostic baseline. The map is specific to its target and corpus but transfers across model scale: a mixture selected in advance at one size beats training on all source tasks at every other size we tested. Transfer is thus a property of the data. The map selects the tasks that help and drops the one that interferes: accuracy on the reasoning targets (causal explanation, multi-hop questions and methodological critique) rises by up to 14 percentage points over training on all source tasks.
zh_title: A帮助B而B损害A：指令微调混合中的定向迁移
translation: 将语言模型适应于专用语料库意味着在固定预算下选择要训练的指令微调任务，而测试一种选择则需要进行微调运行。常见的启发式方法会添加更多源任务，或者挑选与目标相似的源任务。前者假设迁移从不为负，后者假设迁移是对称的。我们证明这两种假设都失效了：任务 $A$ 可以帮助任务 $B$，而 $B$ 会损害 $A$，因此帮助性是有序源-目标对的一个带符号属性。我们引入了迁移映射，这是一个带符号的估计器，用于估计每个源对每个留出目标的帮助或损害程度。我们在 Qwen3 和 Mistral 模型（参数量从 0.6B 到 32B）上通过数百次微调运行拟合了该映射，所有源均取自同一个语料库，且目标中没有训练样本。该映射预测了留出目标在未见混合上的准确率：在这些运行之前记录的预测，其误差不到与混合无关的基线的一半。该映射具有目标和语料库的特异性，但可以跨模型规模迁移：在一个尺寸下预先选择的混合，在测试的所有其他尺寸下都优于对所有源任务进行训练。因此，迁移是数据的一个属性。该映射选择有帮助的任务并剔除干扰任务：推理目标（因果解释、多跳问题和方法论批判）的准确率比在所有源任务上训练提升了高达 14 个百分点。
tldr: 论文揭示了指令微调中任务迁移的非对称性和方向性，并提出了“迁移映射”方法，通过精准选择有益任务显著提升了大语言模型的推理能力。
ai_comments: 该论文指出了指令微调中任务迁移存在非对称性和方向性（A帮助B可能伴随B损害A），并创新性地提出了“迁移映射（transfer map）”来预测和优化任务组合，在跨模型规模时表现出极强的泛异性，对大语言模型的指令数据筛选具有重要指导意义。
motivation: 现有的指令微调启发式方法通常假设迁移永远是非负的，或是对称的（即源任务与目标任务相似则互相有益）。作者指出这两种假设均不成立，任务之间存在单向的帮助或损害，因此需要一种能够捕捉这种有符号、有方向性迁移特性的方法来优化任务混合。
method: 引入了“迁移映射”（transfer map），这是一个带符号的估计器，用于评估每个源任务对每个保留目标任务的帮助或损害程度。该映射通过在Qwen和Mistral模型上进行数百次微调运行来拟合。
results: 迁移映射能够准确预测保留目标在未知混合上的准确率，误差比与混合无关的基线低一半以上。该映射不受模型规模限制，能够跨尺度迁移。利用该映射选择任务可使推理目标（因果解释、多跳问答和方法论批判）的准确率比全量源任务训练提升高达14个百分点。
conclusion: 数据间的迁移是具有方向性的、不对称的属性。通过引入“迁移映射”可以有效预测和选择有助于目标任务的源任务，从而显著提升模型的推理能力，并超越全量数据训练的效果。

title: BTC3D: Blended Tile Conditioning for Detail-Enhancing Image-to-3D Generation
authors: Junyu Li, Qiuyu Chen, Pengcheng Wang, Shiqi Yang, Alexandra Gomez-Villa, Joost van de Weijer, Ruilin Li, Kai Wang
abstract: Recent diffusion-based pipelines have achieved promising progress in image-to-3D synthesis. However, generating high-fidelity details remains challenging, especially when the input image contains rich details. Existing approaches often rely on globally encoded conditioning features, which compress spatial information and limit the model to reproduce fine-grained details. This common design often leads to a phenomenon we term detail attenuation. Moreover, improving image-to-3D synthesis quality typically requires retraining or fine-tuning large diffusion models, which can be computationally expensive and impractical for complex 3D pipelines. In this work, we present Blended Tile Conditioning for image-to-3D generation (BTC3D), a training-free inference time framework that enhances fine-grained detail preservation in image-to-3D diffusion pipelines. To alleviate detail attenuation, we first examine the image feature additivity in image-to-3D models. Based on this property, we introduce a blended tile embedding that extracts local conditioning signals from split image regional patches, allowing the diffusion model to better preserve fine-grained visual details. To integrate the global and local conditioning guidance stably, we propose a dynamic conditioning schedule that gradually increases the influence of tile-level conditioning during later low-noise stages of diffusion. Our proposed method BTC3D operates entirely at inference time and can be seamlessly integrated into existing image-to-3D diffusion pipelines. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly improves texture quality and visual fidelity of the base model while maintaining global structural consistency in a training-free manner.
zh_title: BTC3D：用于细节增强的图像到三维生成的混合图块条件方法
translation: 最近基于扩散的流程在图像到三维合成方面取得了 promising 的进展。然而，生成高保真细节仍然具有挑战性，尤其是当输入图像包含丰富细节时。现有方法通常依赖全局编码的条件特征，这会压缩空间信息并限制模型复现细粒度细节。这种常见设计常常导致我们称之为细节衰减的现象。此外，提高图像到三维合成质量通常需要重新训练或微调大型扩散模型，这在计算上可能是昂贵的，对于复杂的三维流程来说也不切实际。在这项工作中，我们提出了用于图像到三维生成的混合图块条件方法（BTC3D），这是一个无需训练的推理时框架，可增强图像到三维扩散流程中细粒度细节的保留。为了减轻细节衰减，我们首先检查了图像到三维模型中的图像特征可加性。基于这一属性，我们引入了一种混合图块嵌入，它从分割的图像区域补丁中提取局部条件信号，使扩散模型能够更好地保留细粒度视觉细节。为了稳定地整合全局和局部条件引导，我们提出了一个动态条件调度，在扩散的后期低噪声阶段逐渐增加图块级条件的影响。我们提出的方法BTC3D完全在推理时运行，可以无缝集成到现有的图像到三维扩散流程中。实验结果表明，该方法在无需训练的方式下，显著提高了基础模型的纹理质量和视觉保真度，同时保持了全局结构的一致性。
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的BTC3D框架，通过混合图块条件和动态调度机制，解决了图像到三维生成中的细节衰减问题，显著提升了三维纹理和视觉保真度。
ai_comments: 该论文针对图像到三维生成中细节丢失的痛点，创新性地提出了一种无需训练的“混合图块条件”（BTC3D）推理时框架，通过局部图块嵌入与动态条件调度机制，在保留全局结构的同时显著提升了三维纹理和视觉保真度，极具实用价值。
motivation: 现有的基于扩散的图像到三维生成方法依赖于全局编码的条件特征，压缩了空间信息，导致模型难以复现细粒度细节（细节衰减现象），且提升质量通常需要对大型扩散模型进行计算成本高昂的重新训练或微调。
method: 提出BTC3D框架，利用图像特征可加性引入混合图块嵌入来提取局部条件信号，并提出动态条件调度机制在扩散过程的低噪声阶段逐渐增加图块级条件的影响。
results: 实验结果表明，BTC3D方法在无需训练的情况下，能够显著改善基础模型的纹理质量和视觉保真度，同时保持全局结构的一致性。
conclusion: BTC3D作为一个无需训练的推理时框架，能够有效解决图像到三维生成中的细节衰减问题，在保持全局结构一致性的同时显著提升生成模型的纹理质量和视觉保真度。

title: ArchitectureIQ: On the Measure of Training Intuition
authors: Zirui Ren, Shaoyang Guo, Chencheng Tang, Jinxin Wang, Chengyu Xiong, Shanbin Yu, Peihang Li, Yidi Wu, Bangzhe Huang, Qingyu Qu, Leqian Yang, Ziming Liu
abstract: Top researchers have good intuition, but do language models have as good intuition about model training as top AI researchers? To measure model intuition of LLMs and humans, we introduce the ArchitectureIQ benchmark. Each question presents a synthetic dataset and several training recipes, and the test-taker is asked to predict the recipe yielding the best test metric. Overall, we find that LLMs' model intuition is good but has four limitations: (1) The intuition is imperfect, or even sub-human in some cases. Frontier models achieve around 76% accuracy (random choice 33%) vs best human researcher (66.0%), yet remain far from perfect. For architecture-only questions, best human achieves 65% while GPT-6 Astra only has 38%. (2) The intuition is empirical, not structured, supported by the fact that more CoT compute does not lead to substantial improvement. Unlike math, we still lack a "Science of AI" language that enables structured reasoning on AI. (3) The intuition is not maximally condensed, and can be further compressed into a knoledge base. Our constructed knowledge base with only 20 items yields large gains for weak models: GPT-4o equipped with the accumulated knowledge almost matches the performance of Claude Opus 5. (4) The intuition is insensitive to dataset properties, but the best model should in general depend on data properties. This suggests that data is the real "dark matter" in AI -- LLMs (so do human researchers) understand too little about data, even less than model architectures.
comment: 29 pages, 10 figures. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/renrua52/ArchitectureIQ

title: When Masking Helps or Hurts Robustness in Compressed CLIP: A Pre-Deployment Diagnostic
authors: Muhammad Zawish, Steven Davy
abstract: This paper demonstrate that whether masking-based token pruning helps or hurts worst-group robustness can be predicted before deployment, without labels or fine-tuning. A systematic study of semantic masking across 8 spurious-correlation benchmarks shows its effect on worst-group accuracy is highly unstable: it improves accuracy by up to 82.5\% relative on some datasets and degrades it by up to 100\% on others. We trace this instability to spurious inversion: background patches receive higher CLIP text-similarity than the true object when the spurious attribute is background-separable, inverting the assumption every text- and attention-guided pruning method relies on. We introduce the Spurious Inversion Metric (SIM), a label-free, pre-deployment diagnostic whose sign predicts this effect with statistical significance (binomial $p=0.035$) across all 8 datasets, and remains dependable across 6 CLIP architectures with a clean foreground/background split. Naive masking is itself a major source of risk: it causes the largest average-accuracy loss of any method we evaluate, and its own per-image segmentation step is a significant runtime bottleneck. To address this, we design a batched, synchronization-free GPU segmentation routine that cuts this overhead from 3.5$\times$ to 1.75$\times$ baseline. Gating deployment by SIM's sign recovers masking's benefits while avoiding its worst failures, matching or exceeding a strong pruning baseline on 7 of 8 datasets.
zh_title: 当掩码在压缩CLIP中帮助或损害鲁棒性时：部署前诊断
translation: 本文证明了基于掩码的Token剪枝是有助于还是损害最差群鲁棒性，可以在部署前进行预测，且无需标签或微调。对8个虚假相关基准上的语义掩码进行的系统研究表明，它对最差群准确率的影响极其不稳定：在某些数据集上相对准确率提高了高达82.5%，而在其他数据集上则降低了高达100%。我们将这种不稳定性追溯到虚假反转：当虚假属性可与背景分离时，背景补丁比真实对象获得更高的CLIP文本相似度，这颠倒了每个文本和注意力引导的剪枝方法所依赖的假设。我们引入了虚假反转指标（SIM），这是一种无标签、部署前的诊断方法，其符号在所有8个数据集上以统计显著性（二项式 $p=0.035$）预测了这种影响，并且在具有清晰前景/背景分割的6个CLIP架构中保持可靠。幼稚的掩码本身就是风险的主要来源：它导致了我们评估的任何方法中最大的平均准确率损失，并且其自身的每图像分割步骤是一个显着的运行瓶颈。为了解决这个问题，我们设计了一个分批的、无同步的GPU分割例程，将这种开销从基线的3.5倍削减到1.75倍。通过SIM的符号来控制部署可以恢复掩码的好处，同时避免其最坏的失效，在8个数据集中的7个上匹配或超过了强剪枝基准。
tldr: 本文揭示了掩码剪枝对CLIP鲁棒性影响不稳定的根源（虚假反转），并提出了无需标签的SIM指标在部署前进行预测，有效避免了掩码带来的最差情况失效。
ai_comments: 该论文深入探讨了掩码式Token剪枝对压缩CLIP模型最差群鲁棒性的影响，揭示了“虚假反转”这一核心机制，并创新性地提出了无需标签的SIM指标，对模型部署前诊断具有重要实际价值。
motivation: 掩码式Token剪枝对最差群鲁棒性的影响不稳定，在某些数据集上提升显著而在另一些数据集上导致严重退化，且原始掩码存在较大的准确率损失和运行瓶颈，因此需要一种无需部署后标签的诊断方法来预测其效果。
method: 进行了系统性研究，揭示了语义掩码在8个虚假相关性基准上的影响；提出了虚假反转指标（SIM），并在部署前无需标签或微调进行预测；设计了批处理、无同步的GPU分割例程以降低运行开销。
results: SIM指标的符号能以统计显著性预测掩码效果（二项式p=0.035），且在6种CLIP架构上表现可靠；优化的GPU分割将开销从3.5倍降至1.75倍基准；基于SIM的门控部署在7个数据集上匹配或超过了强剪枝基准。
conclusion: 通过引入无需标签和微调的Spurious Inversion Metric（SIM），可以在部署前有效预测掩码对鲁棒性的影响，从而在规避风险的同时恢复剪枝优势。

title: Drift Inspector: Exploring and Measuring Scientific Drift with Atomic Contribution Claims
authors: Vsevolod Karimov, Stepan Ostarkov, Anastasia Poroshina, Anatoly Frolov, Alexander Panchenko
abstract: Scientific abstracts mix contributions with background, motivation, and meta-language, so tools that read them as-is cannot separate what a field produces from what it discusses. We present Drift Inspector, an open-source system for measuring and exploring how a research field changes over time at the level of Atomic Contribution Claims (ACCs): decontextualized, contribution-bearing propositions an LLM extracts from each abstract before analysis. The system clusters these claims across years into an interactive map where every trend traces back to the claims and papers behind it. Applied to six years of EMNLP, it shows the field shifting away from classic NLP tasks toward LLM-era capabilities such as reasoning and multimodality -- a movement that keyword or whole-abstract counts blur. The released data extend beyond EMNLP: the same pipeline has processed the full ACL Anthology (346k claims, 80k abstracts, 423 venues). Extraction is human-validated and clustering checked against an external manually constructed taxonomy.
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations. 11 pages. Live demo, code and data: https://hamyrappy.github.io/drift-inspector
zh_title: 漂移检查器：利用原子贡献声明探索和测量科学漂移
translation: 科学摘要将贡献与背景、动机和元语言混杂在一起，因此按原样阅读它们的工具无法将一个领域产生的内容与它讨论的内容区分开来。我们提出了 Drift Inspector，这是一个开源系统，用于在原子贡献声明（ACCs）的层面上测量和探索研究领域随时间的变化：ACCs是大语言模型在分析前从每篇摘要中提取的去上下文的、包含贡献的命题。该系统将这些声明按年份聚类成一个交互式地图，其中的每个趋势都可以追溯到其背后的声明和论文。将其应用到 EMNLP 的六年数据中，它显示出该领域正在从经典 NLP 任务转向 LLM 时代的各种能力（如推理和多模态）——这是关键词或整篇摘要统计所模糊掉的趋势。发布的数据超出了 EMNLP 的范围：同一管道已处理了整个 ACL 文集（34.6 万条声明，8 万篇摘要，423 个会场）。提取结果经过了人工验证，聚类结果也与外部手动构建的分类法进行了核对。
tldr: Drift Inspector利用LLM提取“原子贡献声明”，实现了对科研领域演变趋势的精细化、可追溯测量。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了“原子贡献声明”（ACCs）的概念，并利用LLM构建了Drift Inspector系统，有效解决了传统基于关键词或整篇摘要的方法无法准确追踪科研领域演变的问题。研究不仅方法扎实，而且提供了大规模的开源数据和验证，对科学计量学和趋势分析具有重要价值。
motivation: 科学摘要混杂了背景、动机、元语言和贡献，导致现有工具无法将研究领域产出的内容与讨论的内容区分开，因此需要一种更精细的方法来测量和探索科学领域随时间的变化。
method: 提出Drift Inspector开源系统，利用大语言模型（LLM）从摘要中提取去上下文的原子贡献声明（ACCs），跨年份对这些声明进行聚类，生成可追溯到具体论文和声明的交互式地图，并通过人工验证和外部专家分类法对提取和聚类结果进行检验。
results: 应用于EMNLP六年数据的分析显示，该领域正从经典NLP任务转向LLM时代的推理和多模态等能力；同时处理了包含34.6万条声明、8万篇摘要和423个会场的完整ACL文集数据。
conclusion: Drift Inspector能够有效且精细地追踪科研领域的演变趋势，超越了传统的关键词或全文统计方法，为科学计量学提供了强大的分析工具。

title: Parameterized Hardness of Mixed 2-Sided Orthant Depth
authors: Michelle Döring, Georg Tennigkeit
abstract: We consider the maximum-depth problem for mixed 2-sided orthants in R^d: each region imposes one lower bound and one upper bound on distinct coordinates, and the task is to find a point contained in as many regions as possible. We show that the corresponding decision problem is W[1]-hard when parameterized by the dimension. Our reduction from MultiColoredClique uses two coordinates per color class and only polynomially many orthants.
zh_title: 混合2侧象限深度的参数化硬度
translation: 我们考虑了R^d中混合2侧象限的最大深度问题：每个区域对不同的坐标施加一个下界和一个上界，任务是找到包含在尽可能多区域中的点。我们证明了当以维度为参数时，相应的判定问题是W[1]-hard的。我们从多色团问题（MultiColoredClique）的归约中，每个颜色类使用两个坐标且仅使用多项式数量的象限。
tldr: 混合2侧象限的最大深度问题以维度为参数时是W[1]-hard的。
ai_comments: 该论文从参数化复杂度的角度研究了混合2侧象限深度问题，通过将MultiColoredClique问题进行归约，首次证明了该问题在维度参数化下是W[1]-hard的，为计算几何和高维数据深度分析中的计算复杂性提供了重要的理论结果。
motivation: 探索混合2侧象限最大深度问题在以维度为参数时的计算复杂度（参数化硬度），以理解其在高维空间中的可解性。
method: 通过从多色团问题（MultiColoredClique）进行归约来证明其参数化硬度，该归约在每个颜色类中使用两个坐标，并且仅使用多项式数量的象限。
results: 证明了混合2侧象限的最大深度判定问题在以维度为参数化时是W[1]-hard的。
conclusion: 混合2侧象限的最大深度判定问题在以维度作为参数时是W[1]-hard的，这表明在一般维度下寻找精确解具有很高的计算难度。

title: Exploring Adaptive Byzantine Quorum Systems to Improve Latency in the WAN
authors: Linus Gnan, Rüdiger Kapitza, Christian Berger
abstract: Quorum systems enforce strict consistency in Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) state machine replication: Before a value is decided, a subset of replicas (called quorum) must exchange votes for the value. In wide-area networks, the size and composition of a quorum determines the speed at which replicas can make progress and thus impacts the latency perceived by clients. A variety of quorum constructions has been proposed, e.g., threshold, weighted, grid and others, but the literature offers little in the way of an apples-to-apples comparison. Each construction typically lives inside a different protocol implementation, so the influence of quorum design on client latency cannot be easily separated from other implementation effects, especially the use of optimization techniques. In this paper, we close that gap by extending BFT-SMaRt with a modular quorum-system abstraction that allows a variety of quorum constructions to live inside the same framework and interact with the same set of optimization techniques. Via our framework, we explore the impact of different quorum system constructions on client-observed latency in wide-area BFT replication using network simulation.

title: Synthetic Speech Attribution via Prototypical Networks
authors: Viola Negroni, Paolo Bestagini, Stefano Tubaro
abstract: Synthetic speech attribution aims to identify the generative system responsible for a speech signal, but current approaches typically rely on black-box neural networks that provide limited insight into their decisions. This work investigates prototype-based networks as an interpretable alternative, where predictions are grounded in comparisons with representative training examples. We adapt ProtoPNet to spectrogram-based speech representations and evaluate the proposed framework on the MLAAD dataset under closed-set, cross-lingual, and open-set conditions. Experiments show that prototype-based reasoning achieves competitive or improved attribution performance compared with the baseline while enabling example-based explanations. These results highlight that interpretability and performance can be jointly achieved in synthetic speech attribution through prototype-based modeling.
zh_title: 基于原型网络的合成语音归属
translation: 合成语音归属旨在识别生成语音信号的系统，但当前的方法通常依赖于黑盒神经网络，对决策过程的解释有限。本工作研究了基于原型的网络作为一种可解释的替代方案，其预测基于与具有代表性的训练示例的比较。我们将 ProtoPNet 适配到基于语谱图的语音表示中，并在封闭集、跨语言和开放集条件下对 MLAAD 数据集上的所提框架进行了评估。实验表明，与基线相比，基于原型的推理在实现竞争性或改进的归属性能的同时，还能提供基于示例的解释。这些结果突出了通过基于原型建模，可以在合成语音归属中同时实现可解释性和高性能。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于原型网络的合成语音归属方法，在保证识别性能的同时提供了直观的可解释性。
ai_comments: 该论文将原型网络（ProtoPNet）引入合成语音归属领域，在保持竞争力的分类性能的同时，增强了模型的可解释性，为检测和追踪虚假语音来源提供了直观的样本级解释，具有很高的实用价值和研究意义。
motivation: 当前合成语音归属方法通常依赖于黑盒神经网络，其决策缺乏直观的解释，因此需要探索一种可解释的替代方案，使预测能够基于与具有代表性的训练示例的比较。
method: 将 ProtoPNet 适配到基于语谱图的语音表示中，在封闭集、跨语言和开放集条件下对 MLAAD 数据集上的原型网络架构进行评估。
results: 实验表明，基于原型的推理在封闭集、跨语言和开放集条件下实现了与基线相当或更好的归属性能，同时能够提供基于示例的解释。
conclusion: 原型网络能够有效应用于合成语音归属任务，在实现具有竞争力的识别性能的同时，通过基于示例的解释机制提升了模型的可解释性。

title: Trust Is Not a Score: Runtime Assurance Contracts for High-Risk AI Agents
authors: Serhii Zabolotnii
abstract: Benchmarks, audits, and agent protocols describe performance, permissions, and repair, but not how observed evidence should change an agent's authority during a consequential task. We call this the assurance-transition gap. We propose a Runtime Assurance Contract (RAC), a policy-level formal schema binding autonomy boundaries, component eligibility, evidence state, transition policy, human-review capacity, and non-compensatory gates. Under RAC, soft metrics may inform routing, whereas a failed or unknown mandatory gate forces retry, switch, escalation, deferral, or stop; aggregate performance cannot authorize action. We define the contract, an evidence record, a permission rule, and five invariants, and illustrate them in clinical, industrial, and judicial failure probes. We then report a deterministic failure-injection study in agentic coding: 280 constructed cases evaluated by a gate conjunction, a score-only rule, and a restricted protocol baseline. At the published example weights and threshold, the score rule admits 80 of 100 block-required injections and all 40 review-required injections. Tuned in hindsight, it matches the conjunction on this corpus. For positive weights, a positive threshold, binary risk signals, zero-signal controls, and an injected case firing each signal alone, we show that exact agreement holds if and only if the threshold does not exceed the smallest weight. A separate set of 18 hand-authored traces checks version-pinned evidence and review transitions against simpler policy variants. In a further prospective synthetic holdout of 24 episodes, two blinded LLM judges assign identical labels to all 72 action attempts; RAC and a separately implemented full stateful baseline both match these labels. These studies test mechanisms on synthetic cases; they establish neither deployed safety nor cross-domain effectiveness.
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Ancillary files: decision log, executable transition model, LLM-labelled synthetic holdout. Synthetic mechanism study; no deployment claim
zh_title: 信任不是一个分数：高风险AI智能体的运行时保证契约
translation: 基准、审计和智能体协议描述了性能、权限和修复，但没有说明在关键任务中观察到的证据应该如何改变智能体的权限。我们将此称为保证-过渡鸿沟。我们提出了运行时保证契约（RAC），这是一种策略级的形式化模式，将自主边界、组件资格、证据状态、过渡策略、人工审查能力和不可妥协的门槛绑定在一起。在RAC下，软性指标可以指导路由，而失败或未知的强制性门槛则强制进行重试、切换、升级、推迟或停止；聚合性能不能授权行动。我们定义了契约、证据记录、权限规则和五个不变式，并在临床、工业和司法故障探查中说明了它们。然后，我们在智能体编码中报告了一项确定性故障注入研究：由门合取、纯分数规则和受限协议基线评估的280个构造案例。在公布的示例权重和阈值下，分数规则允许了100个必须阻止的注入中的80个以及全部40个需要审查的注入。经过事后调整，它与该语料库上的合取相匹配。对于正权重、正阈值、二元风险信号、零信号控制以及触发每个单独信号的注入案例，我们证明了精确的一致性成立当且仅当阈值不超过最小权重。另一组18个手写轨迹对照了更简单的策略变体检查了版本固定的证据和审查过渡。在进一步对24个情节的前瞻性合成保留集的测试中，两个盲测LLM评判员对所有72次行动尝试赋予了相同的标签；RAC和单独实现的完整有状态基线都与这些标签相匹配。这些研究在合成案例上测试了机制；它们既没有建立已部署的安全性，也没有建立跨领域的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了运行时保证契约（RAC），通过强制性的门槛和形式化策略来动态调整高风险AI智能体的权限，解决了仅凭综合评分带来的安全隐患。
ai_comments: 本文针对高风险AI智能体在执行任务时动态权限调整的空白（assurance-transition gap），提出了运行时保证契约（RAC）。通过将证据状态与权限硬性绑定而非简单的软性评分，避免了风险组件的蒙混过关，对高风险场景下的AI安全治理具有重要启发意义。
motivation: 现有的基准、审计和智能体协议未能说明观察到的证据应如何在关键任务中改变智能体的权限，存在“保证-过渡鸿沟”（assurance-transition gap），且基于分数的聚合评估无法有效防止高风险行为。
method: 提出了运行时保证契约（RAC），定义了合约、证据记录、权限规则和五个不变式；进行了代码智能体领域的确定性故障注入研究（280个构造案例）、18个手写轨迹检查以及24个 episodes 的前瞻性合成保留集评估。
results: 故障注入研究表明，传统的仅按分数规则会放行危险案例，而RAC的组合门机制能有效拦截；理论和实验证明了RAC在特定条件下的严格正确性，并在盲测中与状态机基线表现一致。
conclusion: 运行时保证契约（RAC）通过不可妥协的门槛和形式化策略，能够有效解决高风险AI智能体在执行任务时的权限动态调整问题，避免仅凭聚合得分授权带来的安全隐患。

title: Let the Carrier Carry the Attack: Preserving the Subject in Adversarial Image Generation
authors: Linfeng Jiang, Steven McDonagh, Yuhang Chen, Xingyu Zhao, Siddartha Khastgir, Andi Zhang
abstract: Strong unrestricted adversarial attacks can distort the primary object of an image, hereafter referred to as the subject. To preserve subject integrity without compromising attack magnitude, we introduce the carrier: a secondary visual element that provides an auxiliary region to facilitate the attack under global classifier guidance. We demonstrate three key findings: 1. A carrier mitigates subject distortion by absorbing a larger share of globally normalized attack updates. 2. A carrier improves cross-model transferability, governed by the strength of target-related features that balance semantic separation and transfer performance. 3. Successful targeted attacks retain the personalized subject as the primary content perceived by humans while successfully misleading the classifier. Our results demonstrate that a visually secondary carrier offers an auxiliary spatial pathway for adversarial changes, enabling strong and transferable attacks while improving subject preservation.
zh_title: 让载体承载攻击：在对抗图像生成中保持主体不变
translation: 强大的无限制对抗攻击可能会扭曲图像的主要对象（以下简称主体）。为了在不损害攻击强度的情况下保持主体的完整性，我们引入了“载体”：一个次要的视觉元素，它提供了一个辅助区域，以便在全局分类器指导下促进攻击。我们展示了三个主要发现：1.载体通过吸收更大比例的全局归一化攻击更新，减轻了主体的扭曲。2.载体提高了跨模型的迁移性，这受制于目标相关特征的强度，这些特征平衡了语义分离和迁移性能。3.成功的定向攻击保留了个性化主体作为人类感知的主要内容，同时成功地误导了分类器。我们的结果表明，视觉上的次要载体为对抗性变化提供了一条辅助空间路径，从而实现了强大且可迁移的攻击，同时改善了主体的保持。
tldr: 通过引入次要视觉“载体”来吸收对抗扰动，实现了在不降低攻击强度和迁移性的同时保护图像主体的完整性。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的“载体（carrier）”机制，通过在图像中引入辅助视觉元素来分担对抗扰动，从而在保持强对抗攻击能力和跨模型迁移性的同时，有效保护了主体对象的完整性，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 传统的无限制对抗攻击往往会扭曲图像的主要对象（主体），因此需要在不削弱攻击强度的前提下，寻找一种能够保持主体完整性的方法。
method: 引入一个被称为“载体（carrier）”的次要视觉元素，作为全局分类器指导下的辅助区域来分担对抗攻击，从而吸收更大比例的全局归一化攻击更新。
results: 研究表明，载体通过吸收更多攻击更新减轻了主体变形，提升了跨模型迁移性，并且在成功误导分类器的同时，使人类仍能将个性化主体感知为主要内容。
conclusion: 通过引入辅助视觉元素“载体”，该方法成功实现了在不牺牲对抗攻击强度和迁移性的前提下，保持图像主体的视觉完整性，为对抗样本生成提供了一种新颖的空间视角。

title: A library for differentiable signal processing and machine learning on the sphere
authors: Thorsten Kurth, Max Rietmann, Mauro Bisson, Andrea Paris, Alberto Carpentieri, Jean Kossaifi, Anima Anandkumar, Christian Hundt, Boris Bonev
abstract: The two-dimensional sphere embedded in three-dimensional Euclidean space S2, plays a central role in a variety of scientific and engineering domains, including geophysics, planetary science, geodesy, atmospheric physics, quantum chemistry, cosmology, and virtual reality, among many others. As machine learning increasingly permeates these fields, the demand grows for robust tools that process and model functions on the sphere, while respecting the inherent topological and symmetry properties of the domain. We present torch-harmonics, a comprehensive library that offers efficient, differentiable implementations of advanced signal processing and machine learning (ML) methods for spherical data. These include the spherical harmonic transform (SHT), the spherical analogue of the Fourier transform, vector spherical harmonics, discrete-continuous and spectral convolutions, as well as both global and neighborhood spherical attention mechanisms. Beyond traditional representations, torch-harmonics provides the building blocks for state-of-the-art spherical ML architectures such as spherical transformers in order to enable scalable, rotationally-aware learning and inference in modern scientific and engineering applications.

title: Transient Triggering Grid-Forming Synchronization Control Under Voltage and Frequency Dips
authors: Dewan Mahnaaz Mahmud, Vinu Thomas, Bogdan Marinescu, Mickaël Hilairet
abstract: Grid-forming (GFM) inverters are gaining attention as a promising alternative for conventional synchronous generators in the modern power systems. Unlike conventional synchronous generators, GFM inverters have limited overcurrent capability that makes them vulnerable during large disturbances. During disturbances i.e., voltage and frequency dips, GFM inverters are pushed into current-limited operation to protect the semiconductor switches. This causes the internal angle of the GFM inverters to accelerate and lose synchronism with the rest of the grid. To address this limitation, this article proposes a transient triggering grid-forming (TTGFM) synchronization control to enhance the synchronization stability performance under voltage and frequency dips. This method uses two feedback signals; terminal voltage and the difference between unsaturated and saturated power to adjust the internal angle which is generated by power synchronization loop (PSL) of the GFM inverters. These two signals manipulates the internal reference angle generation that act as a virtual braking mechanism. This mechanism limits the angle acceleration during voltage and frequency dips without requiring an extra supervisory signal or parameters to tune. The proposed method is benchmarked against two state-of-the-art synchronization enhancement schemes and validated through high-fidelity electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations with a grid dynamic equivalent (GDE) model in MATLAB/Simulink\textsuperscript{\textregistered}.
