translation: 有限域上的多对一映射（包括1对1映射）在密码学和编码理论中起着重要作用。本文提供了一个统一的框架来研究形如 $f(x) = h(a x^q + b x + c) + u x^q + v x$ 的多项式的多对一性质，其中 $h(x) \in \mathbb{F}_{q^2}[x]$ 且 $a, b, c, u, v \in \mathbb{F}_{q^2}$。我们的方法使用两个从 $\mathbb{F}_{q^2}$ 到 $\mathbb{F}_{q}$ 的线性变换来建立一个交换图表，将 $f(x)$ 与关联多项式 $g(x)$ 联系起来。该图表将 $f(x)$ 在 $\mathbb{F}_{q^2}$ 上的多对一性质的刻画简化为 $g(x)$ 在子域 $\mathbb{F}_{q}$ 上的性质。特别是，当 $h(x) = x^{r}$ 且 $r$ 满足适当条件时，我们证明了 $g(x)$ 可以简化为低次多项式或线性二项式。然后，利用这些低次或线性多项式在 $\mathbb{F}_{q}$ 上已知的多对一性质，我们推导出了完全刻画 $f(x)$ 何时在 $\mathbb{F}_{q^2}$ 上为多对一的显式条件。此外，我们确定了本文获得的所有的1对1映射的逆，并证明了这种形式的2对1映射自然产生显式对合。我们的发现推广并统一了文献中的许多结果。
tldr: 本文建立了一个统一框架，通过降维方法研究并完全刻画了有限域二次扩张上一类多项式的多对一与一一映射性质。
ai_comments: 本文通过线性变换和交换图表，将有限域二次扩张上的多项式映射性质降维到子域上研究，方法巧妙且具有较强的统一性，对密码学和编码理论中的多项式研究有重要贡献。
motivation: 有限域上的多对一映射（包括一一映射）在密码学和编码理论中扮演着重要角色，本文旨在提供一个统一的框架来研究特定形式多项式在有限域二次扩张上的多对一性质。
method: 利用从 $\mathbb{F}_{q^2}$ 到 $\mathbb{F}_{q}$ 的两个线性变换建立交换图表，将 $f(x)$ 在 $\mathbb{F}_{q^2}$ 上的多对一性质归结为关联多项式 $g(x)$ 在子域 $\mathbb{F}_{q}$ 上的性质。
results: 当 $h(x) = x^{r}$ 满足特定条件时，$g(x)$ 可约化为低次多项式或线性二项式，由此导出了 $f(x)$ 是多对一的显式条件，确定了所有一一映射的逆，并证明了 $2$-to-$1$ 映射自然产生显式对合。
conclusion: 本文提出了一种研究有限域二次扩张上多项式多对一性质的统一框架，成功刻画了一大类多项式的多对一及一一映射性质，并给出了相应的逆映射和对合性质。

title: Cover-Parameterised Multichannel Hybrid Steganography: Compositional Security, Detectability, and Robustness
authors: Obinna Omego, Michal Bosy
abstract: Secure covert communication across multiple observable channels requires concealing both the transmitted objects and the relationships among them while resisting active manipulation. This paper introduces a cover-parameterised multichannel hybrid steganographic framework that combines message-independent cover synthesis with adaptive cover modification. Synthesised cover-parameter objects condition a keyed QIM-style mask, and the resulting masked payload is embedded into an existing image using QIM-Fused-CF, which integrates fused S-UNIWARD/MiPOD distortion costs, complexity-aware region refinement, SLIC-guided constraints, and syndrome-trellis coding. The protocol distributes each authenticated epoch across three channels and incorporates freshness verification, bounded scheduling, synchronisation, and re-synchronisation. We formalise cover-parameter indistinguishability $(\textsf{CP-IND})$ and unlinkability $(\textsf{CP-UNL})$, multichannel trace indistinguishability $(\textsf{IND-STEGO-MC})$, and an active $\textsf{MC-ATTACK}$ model covering message recovery, replay, and authenticated substitution. The resulting bounds separate masking, embedding, scheduling, authentication, and receiver-state contributions. Experiments on 10,000 BOSSBase images achieve zero bit-error rate for all valid embeddings and structural similarity above $0.9995$ across payloads of $0.10$--$0.40$~bpp. At $0.10$ and $0.20$~bpp, SRM+EC, Ye-Net, and Yedroudj-Net produce AUC values of $0.5017$--$0.5444$ and $0.5424$--$0.5678$, respectively, whereas detectability increases substantially at $0.40$~bpp. These results identify a practical low-to-moderate-payload operating region and demonstrate that secure multichannel steganography requires the joint design of synthesis, masking, embedding, scheduling, authentication, and receiver state.
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 3 algorithms, 9 tables. Substantially revised and expanded version with a new title, revised security analysis and additional experimental evaluation. Supplementary material is provided as an ancillary PDF and is available on the arXiv abstract page (check the ancillary files section). Submitted and under peer review
zh_title: 覆盖参数化多通道混合隐写：组合安全性、可检测性与鲁棒性
translation: 在多个可观察通道间进行安全的隐蔽通信，需要隐蔽传输的对象及它们之间的关系，同时抵抗主动操纵。本文引入了一个覆盖参数化多通道混合隐写框架，该框架将与消息无关的覆盖合成与自适应覆盖修改相结合。合成的覆盖参数化对象调节键控的QIM式掩码，并将所得的掩码有效载荷使用QIM-Fused-CF嵌入到现有图像中，其中QIM-Fused-CF集成了融合的S-UNIWARD/MiPOD失真成本、复杂度感知区域精炼、SLIC引导约束以及校正网格编码（syndrome-trellis coding）。该协议将每个经过认证的纪元（epoch）分布在三个通道上，并结合了新鲜度验证、有界调度、同步以及重新同步。我们形式化了覆盖参数不可区分性（$\textsf{CP-IND}$）与不可链接性（$\textsf{CP-UNL}$）、多通道迹线不可区分性（$\textsf{IND-STEGO-MC}$）以及涵盖消息恢复、重放和认证替换的主动$\textsf{MC-ATTACK}$模型。所得的界限将掩码、嵌入、调度、认证和接收器状态的贡献隔离开来。在10,000张BOSSBase图像上的实验表明，所有有效嵌入的误码率均为零，在0.10到0.40 bpp的有效载荷下，结构相似性高于0.9995。在0.10和0.20 bpp时，SRM+EC、Ye-Net和Yedroudj-Net产生的AUC值分别为0.5017--0.5444和0.5424--0.5678，而在0.40 bpp时可检测性显著增加。这些结果确定了一个实用的低到中等负载操作区域，并证明了安全的多通道隐写术需要联合设计合成、掩码、嵌入、调度、认证和接收器状态。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新型的多通道混合隐写框架，通过联合设计合成、嵌入与调度机制，在低到中等负载下实现了高隐蔽性和零误码率。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的覆盖参数化多通道混合隐写框架，通过结合消息无关的覆盖合成与自适应覆盖修改，并在理论上形式化了安全性与鲁棒性边界。实验在10,000张图像上验证了其在低中负载下的有效性。
motivation: 跨多个可观察通道进行安全的隐蔽通信需要隐藏传输的对象及其之间的关系，同时抵抗主动操纵，而现有的方法缺乏对合成、掩码、嵌入、调度和认证的联合设计与形式化安全保证。
method: 提出了一种结合消息无关覆盖合成与自适应覆盖修改的框架，利用键控QIM式掩码、QIM-Fused-CF嵌入（集成S-UNIWARD/MiPOD失真成本、复杂度感知区域细分、SLIC制导约束及校正网格编码），并结合了跨三通道的分发协议、新鲜度验证、有界调度及同步重同步机制。
results: 在10,000张BOSSBase图像上的实验表明，所有有效嵌入的误码率为零，在0.10-0.40 bpp负载下的结构相似性（SSIM）高于0.9995；在0.10和0.20 bpp下，主流检测器（SRM+EC, Ye-Net, Yedroudj-Net）的AUC值为0.5017-0.5678，但在0.40 bpp时检测显著增加。
conclusion: 该研究表明，安全的多通道隐写术需要联合设计合成、掩码、嵌入、调度、认证和接收器状态，并在低到中等负载下表现出优异的性能。

title: An Real-Sim-Real (RSR) Loop Framework for Generalizable Robotic Policy Transfer
authors: Yuxuan Xu, Shiyu Wang, Jinhao Huang, Wenhao Zhao, Yufei Jia, Zike Yan, Weibin Gu, Lu Shi, Guyue Zhou
abstract: The sim-to-real gap remains a critical challenge in robotics, hindering the deployment of algorithms trained in simulation to real-world systems. We propose a flexible Real-to-Sim-to-Real (RSR) framework whose central contribution is an information-theoretic cost function that explicitly accounts for sim-to-real discrepancies. This cost balances two objectives, completing the task and steering the policy to collect real-world samples that are maximally informative for improving transfer. It can be integrated seamlessly into existing reinforcement learning algorithms (e.g., PPO, SAC) and ensures a balanced exploration of critical regions in the real domain. The framework treats differentiable simulation as optional: when a differentiable simulator is available, the collected informative data can also be used to tune simulator parameters. We implement the framework with the MuJoCo MJX platform and demonstrate its generality by evaluating on both manipulation tasks with a 6-DOF robotic arm and locomotion tasks on a legged robot. Empirical results show that our RSR loop yields more efficient data acquisition and substantially improves task performance in real-world that achieves a smoother sim-to-real transfer.
comment: Accepted by IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), transferred for presentation at IEEE ICRA 2027
zh_title: 用于通用机器人策略迁移的真实-仿真-真实（RSR）循环框架
translation: 仿真到真实（sim-to-real）的差距仍然是机器人学中的一个关键挑战，阻碍了在仿真中训练的算法向现实世界系统的部署。我们提出了一种灵活的“真实-仿真-真实”（RSR）框架，其核心贡献是一个信息论成本函数，该函数显式地考虑了仿真到真实的差异。该成本平衡了两个目标：完成任务以及引导策略收集对改善迁移最具信息量的真实世界样本。它可以无缝集成到现有的强化学习算法中（如PPO、SAC），并确保对真实领域中关键区域的平衡探索。该框架将可微分仿真视为可选项：当可微分仿真器可用时，收集的信息量数据还可用于调整仿真器参数。我们在MuJoCo MJX平台上实现了该框架，并通过6自由度机械臂的操作任务和腿式机器人的 locomotion 任务进行了评估，证明了其通用性。实验结果表明，我们的RSR循环能够实现更高效的数据获取，并大幅提升真实世界中的任务性能，从而实现更平滑的sim-to-real迁移。
tldr: 提出了一种基于信息论的Real-Sim-Real（RSR）框架，平衡任务完成与数据信息量，有效缩小了机器人sim-to-real的差距。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的RSR（Real-Sim-Real）循环框架，通过引入信息论成本函数，巧妙地平衡了任务完成与收集具信息量真实样本的目标，有效解决了机器人领域的“仿真到真实”差距问题，并具备良好的通用性和无缝集成现有RL算法的能力。
motivation: 仿真到真实（sim-to-real）的差距仍然是机器人学中的一个关键挑战，阻碍了在仿真中训练的算法向现实世界系统的部署。
method: 提出了一种基于信息论成本函数的Real-to-Sim-to-Real (RSR) 框架。该成本函数平衡了两个目标：完成任务以及引导策略收集对改善迁移最具信息量的真实世界样本；同时支持在有可微分仿真器时进行参数调优。
results: 在MuJoCo MJX平台上实现并通过6自由度机械臂操作任务和四足机器人 locomotion 任务进行评估，结果表明该框架能实现更高效的数据采集，并大幅提升真实世界的任务性能和实现更平滑的策略迁移。
conclusion: RSR循环框架通过信息论驱动的采样与可选的仿真器微调，能够实现高效的数据采集与显著提升的真实世界任务性能，为平滑的机器人策略迁移提供了一种通用且有效的解决方案。

title: Learning-Based Progressive Barrier Control for Robot Manipulators with Initial Errors Outside Prescribed Tracking Bounds
authors: Hamed Rahimi Nohooji, Danial Zafaranchizadeh Moghaddam, Abolfazl Zaraki, Holger Voos
abstract: Robot manipulators may start a new task with a tracking error larger than the prescribed tolerance. Conventional barrier controllers generally require the initial error to lie within this tolerance, which prevents their direct use under such conditions. This paper develops a progressive barrier controller that gradually contracts an initial error bound to the required value within a prescribed time. The robot can therefore start outside the final bound, while the direct joint-position error satisfies it after the transition. The closed-form control law combines progressive barrier feedback with an online adaptive torque term based on an actor--critic structure. A Lyapunov analysis establishes bounded closed-loop signals and gives sufficient conditions for satisfaction of the final tracking bound. Two-link simulations consider large initial errors, actuator saturation, dynamic variations, disturbances, and measurement errors. The adaptive term reduces the median root-mean-square tracking error by 45.1\% compared with the zero-weight progressive barrier controller. The simulations also map the initial errors that can be handled at different transition times under fixed torque limits. Finally, an experiment on a Niryo Ned3 Pro illustrates tracking performance using measured position and motor-current data.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Substantially revised and condensed conference version with an updated control formulation, actuator-limited simulations, and a real-robot experiment. Author list updated. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
zh_title: 具有初始误差超出规定跟踪界限的机器人机械臂基于学习的渐进式屏障控制
translation: 机器人机械臂在开始新任务时的跟踪误差可能会大于规定的容差。传统的屏障控制器通常要求初始误差位于该容差范围内，这阻碍了它们在此类条件下的直接使用。本文开发了一种渐进式屏障控制器，在规定时间内逐渐将初始误差界限收缩到所需值。因此，机器人在过渡后可以直接从最终界限之外开始，同时关节位置误差满足该界限。封闭形式的控制律将渐进式屏障反馈与基于演员-评论家结构的在线自适应力矩项相结合。Lyapunov分析确立了有界闭环信号，并给出了满足最终跟踪界限的充分条件。双连杆仿真考虑了大初始误差、执行器饱和、动态变化、干扰和测量误差。与零权重渐进式屏障控制器相比，自适应项使中位均方根跟踪误差降低了45.1%。仿真还绘制了在固定力矩限制下不同过渡时间所能处理的初始误差图。最后，在Niryo Ned3 Pro上进行的实验利用测得的位置和电机电流数据说明了跟踪性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新型渐进式屏障控制器，使机械臂在初始误差超出预期范围时仍能通过自适应学习机制在规定时间内恢复到合格的跟踪状态。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种渐进式屏障控制器，解决了传统屏障控制无法处理初始误差超出规定界限的问题，并结合了演员-评论家结构的在线自适应控制，具有很强的实用价值和鲁棒性。
motivation: 传统屏障控制器要求初始误差必须在规定的容差范围内，这导致机械臂在开始新任务时若初始误差过大则无法直接使用，因此需要开发一种能处理初始误差超出规定跟踪界限的方法。
method: 开发了一种渐进式屏障控制器，通过逐渐收缩初始误差界限至所需值，并结合基于演员-评论家结构的在线自适应力矩项，利用Lyapunov分析进行闭环稳定性证明。
results: 仿真结果表明，与零权重渐进式屏障控制器相比，自适应项将中位均方根跟踪误差降低了45.1%，并在Niryo Ned3 Pro实验中验证了其跟踪性能。
conclusion: 本文成功开发了一种学习型渐进式屏障控制器，能够在初始误差超出界限的情况下确保机械臂在规定时间内收敛至指定跟踪界限内，并通过仿真和实验验证了其有效性。

title: Residuals Are Not Enough: Limits of Physics-Informed Pre-Training for Scientific Foundation Models
authors: Serge Kotchourko, Amin Totounferoush, Michael W. Mahoney, Steffen Staab
abstract:
Scientific foundation models (SciFMs) aim to learn generalizable representations of physical systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs), enabling transfer across tasks and domains. While physics-informed methods, which leverage PDE residuals as supervisory signals, have shown promise in scientific machine learning (SciML) for improving accuracy and reducing data requirements, their potential in the context of SciFMs remains relatively unexplored.
  In this evaluation study, we investigate whether (and how) physics-informed pre-training improves the generalization, robustness, and data efficiency of SciFMs. We conduct systematic experiments across a diverse set of PDEs, ranging from simple problems with periodic boundary conditions to more challenging systems such as the Navier-Stokes equations and non-periodic geometries.
  Our results show that physics-informed pre-training provides clear benefits in ``nice,'' e.g., structured, well-aligned settings: it enhances generalization and reduces data dependence, compared to data-only pre-training. However, these advantages diminish significantly as the downstream tasks become ``harder,'' e.g., as they involve discontinuities or deviate from the pre-training distribution. In complex or structurally different problems, such as those involving new boundary conditions or PDE operators, physics-informed models may perform only on par with---or even worse---than data-driven baselines.
  While residual-based pre-training helps in idealized regimes, realizing broadly transferable SciFMs will likely require subtler spatiotemporal inductive biases and more principled integration of physical knowledge into model architectures.
zh_title: 残差并不足够：科学基础模型中物理信息预训练的局限性
translation:
科学基础模型（SciFMs）旨在学习由偏微分方程（PDEs）支配的物理系统的可泛化表示，从而实现跨任务和跨领域的迁移。虽然利用PDE残差作为监督信号的物理信息方法在科学机器学习（SciML）中显示出提高准确性和减少数据需求的前景，但它们在SciFMs背景下的潜力仍相对未得到充分探索。
在这项评估研究中，我们调查了物理信息预训练是否（以及如何）提高SciFMs的泛化能力、鲁棒性和数据效率。我们在各种PDE上进行了系统性实验，范围从具有周期性边界条件的简单问题到更具挑战性的系统，如纳维-斯托克斯方程和非周期几何。
我们的结果表明，物理信息预训练在“良好”的（例如结构化、对齐良好）环境中提供了明显的益处：与仅数据预训练相比，它增强了泛化能力并减少了数据依赖性。然而，随着下游任务变得“更困难”（例如涉及不连续性或偏离预训练分布），这些优势显著减弱。在复杂或结构上不同的问题中，例如涉及新边界条件或PDE算ipv（或PDE算子）的问题，物理信息模型的表现可能仅与数据驱动的基线相当——甚至更差。
虽然基于残差的预训练在理想化机制下有所帮助，但实现广泛可迁移的SciFMs可能需要更微妙的时空归纳偏置，以及将物理知识更原则性地集成到模型架构中。
tldr: 物理信息预训练在理想的偏微分方程任务中表现良好，但在复杂的、分布外的或不连续的现实科学任务中，单纯依赖残差并不能带来预期的泛化优势。
ai_comments: 本文深入探讨了物理信息预训练在科学基础模型（SciFMs）中的局限性，指出了单纯依赖PDE残差信号在面对复杂、不连续或分布外下游任务时的不足，对科学机器学习（SciML）领域盲目迷信物理约束预训练的现状敲响了警钟，对未来如何设计更通用、更具物理归纳偏置的架构具有重要的启发意义。
motivation: 探究基于物理信息的预训练（利用PDE残差作为监督信号）是否以及如何能提高科学基础模型（SciFMs）的泛化能力、鲁棒性和数据效率，填补该领域在基础模型背景下探讨较少的空白。
method: 进行系统性实验，跨越了一系列不同的偏微分方程（从简单的周期性边界条件问题到Navier-Stokes方程和非周期性几何等挑战性系统），对比了物理信息预训练与纯数据预训练的性能。
results: 在结构化、对齐良好的“理想”设置中，物理信息预训练能增强泛化并减少数据依赖；但面对不连续、偏离预训练分布、包含新边界条件或新PDE算子的复杂“困难”任务时，其优势显著减弱，甚至可能表现得与纯数据驱动基线相当或更差。
conclusion: 仅靠残差进行物理信息预训练不足以支撑具有广泛泛化能力的科学基础模型，未来需要更深层次的时空归纳偏置和更具原则性的物理知识架构集成方法。

title: Generalising from Self-Produced Data: Model Training Beyond Human Constraints
authors: Alfath Daryl Alhajir, Jennifer Dodgson, Joseph Lim, Truong Ma Phi, Julian Peh, Akira Rafhael Janson Pattirane, Lokesh Poovaragan
abstract: Current large language models (LLMs) are constrained by human-derived training data and limited by a single level of abstraction that impedes definitive truth judgments. This paper introduces a novel framework in which AI models autonomously generate and validate new knowledge through direct interaction with their environment. Central to this approach is an unbounded, ungamable numeric reward - such as annexed disk space or follower count - that guides learning without requiring human benchmarks. AI agents iteratively generate strategies and executable code to maximize this metric, with successful outcomes forming the basis for self-retraining and incremental generalisation. To mitigate model collapse and the warm start problem, the framework emphasizes empirical validation over textual similarity and supports fine-tuning via GRPO. The system architecture employs modular agents for environment analysis, strategy generation, and code synthesis, enabling scalable experimentation. This work outlines a pathway toward self-improving AI systems capable of advancing beyond human-imposed constraints toward autonomous general intelligence.
zh_title: 从自我生成数据中泛化：超越人类限制的模型训练
translation: 当前的大语言模型受到人类衍生训练数据的约束，并受限于阻碍确切真理判断的单一抽象层级。本文引入了一个新颖的框架，其中AI模型通过与环境的直接交互自主生成和验证新知识。该方法的核心是一个无上限、无法作弊的数字奖励（如附加磁盘空间或粉丝数），它在不需要人类基准的情况下引导学习。AI智能体迭代生成策略和可执行代码以最大化这一指标，成功的结果构成了自我再训练和增量泛化的基础。为了减轻模型崩溃和冷启动问题，该框架强调基于经验的验证而非文本相似性，并支持通过GRPO进行微调。系统架构采用用于环境分析、策略生成和代码合成的模块化智能体，从而实现可扩展的实验。这项工作勾勒了一条通向自我提升的AI系统的发展路径，这些系统能够超越人类施加的限制，走向自主通用人工智能。
tldr: 提出了一种通过与环境交互、利用无上限数字奖励进行自我训练的框架，旨在让AI超越人类数据的限制实现自主泛化与提升。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种突破人类数据限制的新型AI自训练框架，通过与环境的直接交互以及无上限的数字奖励实现知识的自主生成与泛化，对AGI的研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 当前的大语言模型受到人类衍生训练数据的限制，且受限于单一的抽象层级，这阻碍了其对绝对真理的判断。
method: 引入了一个新颖的框架，利用无上限且无法作弊的数字奖励来引导学习，不依赖人类基准；使用模块化智能体进行环境分析、策略生成和代码合成，并通过GRPO支持微调。
results: AI智能体能够迭代生成策略和可执行代码以最大化指标，成功的结果构成了自我再训练和增量泛化的基础，同时通过经验验证缓解了模型崩塌和冷启动问题。
conclusion: 本文勾勒了一条通向超越人类限制的自我提升AI系统及自主通用人工智能的路径。

title: Information Thermodynamics of Agents: The Work Capacity of Channels with Memory
authors: Lukas J. Fiderer, Paul C. Barth, Isaac D. Smith, Hans J. Briegel
abstract: Predicting future observations plays a central role in machine learning, biology, economics, and many other fields. It lies at the heart of organizational principles such as the variational free energy principle and, based on the second law of thermodynamics, has even been shown to be necessary for reaching the fundamental energetic limits of information processing on a tape. While the usefulness of the predictive paradigm is undisputed, complex adaptive systems that interact with their environment are more than just predictive machines: they have the power to act upon their environment and cause change. In this work, we develop a framework to analyze the thermodynamics of information processing in percept-action loops, a model of agent-environment interaction, allowing us to investigate the thermodynamic implications of actions and percepts on equal footing. To this end, we introduce the concept of work capacity, defined as the maximum rate at which an agent can expect to extract work from its environment. Our results reveal that work-efficient agents must balance prediction and forgetting. This highlights a fundamental departure from the thermodynamics of passive observation, suggesting that prediction and energy efficiency may be at odds in active learning systems.

zh_title: 智能体的信息热力学：带记忆通道做功容量
translation: 预测未来观察在机器学习、生物学、经济学等许多领域中起着核心作用。它是诸如变分自由能原理等组织原则的核心，并且根据热力学第二定律，已被证明对于达到磁带上信息处理的基本能量极限是必要的。虽然预测范式的有用性无可争议，但与环境交互的复杂自适应系统不仅仅是预测机器：它们有能力对环境采取行动并引起改变。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个框架来分析感知-动作循环（智能体-环境交互的模型）中信息处理的热力学，使我们能够以同等的基础研究动作和感知对热力学的影响。为此，我们引入了工作能力的概念，定义为智能体预期从其环境中提取功的最大速率。我们的结果表明，做功高效的智能体必须平衡预测和遗忘。这突显了与被动观察热力学的根本背离，表明预测和能量效率在主动学习系统中可能存在冲突。
tldr: 本文建立了感知-动作循环中智能体的信息热力学框架，发现高效做功的智能体必须平衡预测与遗忘，这与被动观察的热力学规律存在根本不同。
ai_comments: 该论文将信息热力学扩展到了包含感知-动作循环的主动智能体（Agents）模型中，创新性地提出了“工作能力”（work capacity）概念，并揭示了高效做功的智能体必须在预测和遗忘之间进行权衡，这对理解复杂自适应系统和主动学习系统的能量效率具有重要意义。

title: Grounded World Model: Latent Planning with Language Goals
authors: Quanyi Li, Lan Feng, Haonan Zhang, Wuyang Li, Letian Wang, Alexandre Alahi, Harold Soh
abstract: World models such as DINO-WM and LeWM specify the goal with an image, which is difficult to obtain in advance for novel tasks. We present the Grounded World Model (GWM), a latent world model that enables zero-shot planning in the real world from language goals alone. Given a candidate action sequence and the current observation, GWM predicts the future in the visual space of a pretrained video-language embedding model. The frozen readout of this embedding model maps this imagined future and the task description into the same embedding space, where their negative cosine similarity serves as the planning cost. Training GWM requires only offline and task-agnostic video-action pairs and no language labels. In simulated experiments on WISER, planning with GWM, which executes the candidate action of lowest cost, solves 87% of 288 tasks with unseen instructions and visual signals, while ten fine-tuned VLAs average 22%. We then scale GWM up with real robot data, and use it for zero-shot planning in realistic simulation and real scenes. In the IsaacSim evaluation, planning with GWM completes all 70 trials across 14 tasks that require reasoning over referring expressions, matching a modular planner grounded by a frontier VLM, while pi0.5 reaches 37/70. Deployed on a real Franka, the same stack completes 55/60 separately evaluated pick-and-place sub-tasks, comparable to the modular planner's 52/60, with the full system running locally on a single consumer GPU. Project website: https://quanyili.github.io/gwm-wiser/.

title: Deterministic Self-Stabilizing BFS Construction in Constant Space
authors: Lélia Blin, Franck Petit, Sébastien Tixeuil
abstract: In this paper, we resolve a long-standing question in self-stabilization by demonstrating that it is indeed possible to construct a spanning tree in a semi-uniform network using constant memory per node. We introduce a self-stabilizing synchronous algorithm that builds a breadth-first search (BFS) spanning tree with only $O(1)$ bits of memory per node, converging in $2^ε$ time units, where $ε$ denotes the eccentricity of the distinguish node. Crucially, our approach operates without any prior knowledge of global network parameters such as maximum degree, diameter, or total node count. In contrast to traditional self-stabilizing methods, such as pointer-to-neighbor communication or distance-to-root computation, that are unsuitable under strict memory constraints, our solution employs an innovative constant-space token dissemination mechanism. This mechanism effectively eliminates cycles and rectifies deviations in the BFS structure, ensuring both correctness and memory efficiency. The proposed algorithm not only meets the stringent requirements of memory-constrained distributed systems but also opens new avenues for research in self-stabilizing protocols under severe resource limitations.
zh_title: 恒定空间下确定性自稳定BFS构造
translation: 在本文中，我们解决了自稳定领域的一个长期问题：证明了在半均匀网络中，确实可以使用每个节点常数大小的内存来构造生成树。我们引入了一种自稳定同步算法，该算法仅用每个节点 $O(1)$ 比特的内存构建广度优先搜索（BFS）生成树，并在 $2^\varepsilon$ 时间单位内收敛，其中 $\varepsilon$ 表示可区分节点的离心率。至关重要的是，我们的方法在运行过程中不需要任何全局网络参数的先验知识，例如最大度数、直径或总节点数。与传统的不适合严格内存限制的自稳定方法（如邻居指针通信或到根距离计算）相比，我们的解决方案采用了一种创新的常数空间令牌传播机制。该机制有效地消除了循环并纠正了BFS结构中的偏差，确保了正确性和内存效率。所提出的算法不仅满足了内存受限分布式系统的严苛要求，也为严重资源限制下的自稳定协议研究开辟了新途径。
tldr: 本文首次实现了在半均匀网络中，仅使用每节点常数级内存（O(1)）且无需全局参数的确定性自稳定BFS生成树构建算法。
ai_comments: 该论文在自稳定分布式计算领域取得了突破性进展，首次实现了在半均匀网络中仅使用常数级内存（O(1)比特）构建BFS生成树，解决了该领域长期以来的一个开放性问题。其创新点在于引入了常数空间令牌传播机制，且无需全局网络参数。
motivation: 传统的自稳定方法（如邻居指针通信或到根距离计算）在严格的内存限制下无法使用，亟需解决在仅有常数内存（O(1)比特/节点）的半均匀网络中是否可以构建生成树这一长期未决的问题。
method: 提出了一种新颖的常数空间令牌传播机制（token dissemination mechanism），能够在没有全局网络参数的情况下，有效消除循环并纠正BFS结构中的偏差。
results: 提出了一种同步自稳定算法，能够在每个节点仅使用 $O(1)$ 比特内存的情况下构建广度优先搜索（BFS）生成树，并在 $2^\varepsilon$ 时间单位内收敛（$\varepsilon$为特殊节点的离心率），且不依赖任何全局网络参数。
conclusion: 论文成功设计了一种确定性自稳定、恒定空间消耗的BFS生成树构建算法，为资源极度受限的分布式系统提供了坚实的理论基础和新方法。

title: Towards More Efficient, Robust, Instance-adaptive, and Generalizable Sequential Decision making
authors: Zhiyong Wang
abstract: The primary goal of my Ph.D. study is to develop provably efficient and practical algorithms for data-driven sequential decision-making under uncertainty. My work focuses on reinforcement learning (RL), multi-armed bandits, and their applications, including recommendation systems, computer networks, video analytics, and large language models (LLMs). Sequential decision-making methods, such as bandits and RL, have demonstrated remarkable success - ranging from outperforming human players in complex games like Atari and Go to advancing robotics, recommendation systems, and fine-tuning LLMs. Despite these successes, many established algorithms rely on idealized models that can fail under model misspecifications or adversarial perturbations, particularly in settings where accurate prior knowledge of the underlying model class is unavailable or where malicious users operate within dynamic systems. These challenges are pervasive in real-world applications, where robust and adaptive solutions are critical. Furthermore, while worst-case guarantees provide theoretical reliability, they often fail to capture instance-dependent performance, which can lead to more efficient and practical solutions. Another key challenge lies in generalizing to new, unseen environments, a crucial requirement for deploying these methods in dynamic and unpredictable settings. To address these limitations, my research aims to develop more efficient, robust, instance-adaptive, and generalizable sequential decision-making algorithms for both reinforcement learning and bandits. Towards this end, I focus on developing more efficient, robust, instance-adaptive, and generalizable for both general reinforcement learning (RL) and bandits.
zh_title: 迈向更高效、鲁棒、实例自适应且可泛化的序列决策
translation: 我的博士研究的主要目标是开发在不确定性下进行数据驱动序列决策的、具备理论效率和实用性的算法。我的工作重点是强化学习（RL）、多臂老虎机及其应用，包括推荐系统、计算机网络、视频分析和大语言模型（LLM）。诸如老虎机和强化学习等序列决策方法已经取得了显著成功——从在Atari和围棋等复杂游戏中表现优于人类玩家，到推进机器人学、推荐系统以及微调LLM。尽管取得了这些成功，许多成熟的算法依赖于理想化模型，在模型设定错误或受到对抗性扰动时可能会失效，特别是在缺乏底层模型类准确先验知识或动态系统中存在恶意用户的场景下。这些挑战在现实世界的应用中普遍存在，在这些应用中，鲁棒且自适应的解决方案至关重要。此外，虽然最坏情况下的保证提供了理论可靠性，但它们往往无法捕捉实例依赖的性能，而这本可以带来更高效、更实用的解决方案。另一个关键挑战在于泛化到新的、未见过的环境，这是在动态和不可预测的设置中部署这些方法的关键要求。为了解决这些局限性，我的研究旨在为强化学习和老虎机开发更高效、鲁棒、实例自适应且可泛化的序列决策算法。为此，我专注于为通用强化学习（RL）和老虎机开发更高效、鲁棒、实例自适应且可泛化的算法。
tldr: 本研究旨在开发能够应对真实世界挑战（如模型错误、对抗扰动及环境变化）的高效、鲁棒且可泛化的强化学习与老虎机算法。
ai_comments: 这篇博士研究摘要立意高远，聚焦于序列决策（强化学习与多臂老虎机）的核心痛点，即效率、鲁棒性、实例自适应以及泛化能力。研究面广且贴近实际应用（如推荐系统、LLM微调等）。

title: AI Security Research Should Better Incentivize Defense Research
authors: Youqian Zhang
abstract: This work examines an imbalance in artificial intelligence (AI) security research: the field tends to produce more work on attacking AI systems than on defending them. Drawing on related academic papers, we find biased attack-to-defense ratios across subfields, including federated learning, speech recognition, membership inference, large language models, etc. The imbalance possibly means far beyond a simple count: attack papers are routinely evaluated under favorable conditions that make threats look more severe than they are in practice, while defenses are held to a stricter standard that few can meet. The result is a literature rich in demonstrated vulnerabilities and thin on usable and deployed protections. We thus argue that AI security research should better incentivize defense research.

title: Surrogate Modeling of Interconnector Flows: A Machine Learning Alternative to Full-Scale Power System Simulations with Application to Cross-Border Electricity Exchange
authors: Robert Gaugl, Eloy Insunza, José Portela, Sonja Wogrin
abstract: Cross-border electricity exchanges are crucial for operating and planning highly renewable power systems. Many studies reduce spatial granularity to keep models tractable and prescribe cross-border exchanges exogenously, often by reusing historical import/export time series. Such assumptions become inconsistent as renewable penetration changes the magnitude and timing of flows. The core contribution of this work is a machine-learning (ML) surrogate framework that maps nodal time-series data (e.g., hourly demand and renewable generation) to synthetic interconnector-level flow time series. The resulting flows serve as fixed boundary conditions in reduced power system optimization models (PSOMs). This addresses studies focused on a subset of an interconnected system, for which repeatedly solving the full model across multiple climate years or scenarios is computationally expensive. We demonstrate the framework on a pan-European single-node-per-country DC optimal power flow model. We benchmark k-nearest neighbors, ridge regression, random forests, Extra Trees, gradient boosting, XGBoost, and feedforward neural-network (SQU) surrogates. As an additional contribution, we introduce a novel custom neural-network loss that softly penalizes physically implausible flow patterns. This soft penalty is not a guarantee of full power-flow feasibility. Across benchmarks, the SQU variants provide the most consistent out-of-sample and downstream optimization performance while substantially outperforming scaled historical profiles. The ML-generated flows closely reproduce country-level results of the full European model while greatly reducing computation time. The proposed framework enables scenario-consistent reduced PSOM studies across climate years after a single full-model run, eliminating repeated pan-European simulations and supporting more robust climate-year analyses under fixed system assumptions.

title: Beyond Normal References: Discriminative Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
authors: Huan Wang, Jun Shen, Jun Yan, Guansong Pang
abstract: This paper considers a practical few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) setting, termed discriminative FSAD, where a limited number of both normal and anomalous examples are available as references during inference. Existing FSAD methods rely on normal-only references through normality matching, ignoring the discriminative clues in anomalous references, while directly fitting both references can overfit to the seen anomalies. We introduce IDEAL, an intrinsic deviation learning framework that leverages both reference types to learn intrinsic deviation patterns characterizing generalizable abnormality as deviations from normality. IDEAL decomposes the learning process into two novel components: 1) a Normal Variation Eraser to suppress nuisance normal variations that may lead to noisy deviations from normality, thereby highlighting anomaly-relevant deviation representations; 2) an Intrinsic Deviation Encoder to decompose these denoised deviation representations into intrinsic deviation vectors capturing the most discriminative orthogonal deviation directions. At inference, IDEAL scores query-to-normal deviations preserved after projection onto the learned intrinsic deviation vectors, enabling generalization for both seen and unseen anomalies. Extensive experiments on eight real-world datasets show that IDEAL generalizes effectively to unseen anomalies and consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art FSAD methods. Code and data are available at \href{https://github.com/mala-lab/IDEAL}{https://github.com/mala-lab/IDEAL}.

title: D$^2$-VLA: Dual-Memory Dual-Frequency Vision-Language-Action Model For Long Dynamic Manipulation
authors: Zijian Ye, Chengqi Wei, Wei Huang, Anlin Zheng, Chunyu Zou, Liangyu Wu, Zikang Zhao, Zhenjie Peng, Yushuo Yang, Shuman Zhao, Zhongrui Wang, Xiaojuan Qi
abstract: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to remember cues that are no longer in view while responding to moving objects. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies often rely on the latest observation, and refreshing their visual context typically requires another costly vision-language model (VLM) pass. We present D$^2$-VLA, which combines dual memory and dual-frequency control at the KV-cache interface of a pretrained VLA. D$^2$-VLA uses block-wise causal KV caching to encode observations incrementally and, guided by distinct temporal attention patterns, constructs separate historical KV read views for the VLM and action expert. Between periodic VLM updates, a gated adapter incorporates fresh visual features into the latest history-conditioned KV block, while a short fast-memory queue supports action replanning. We introduce DOMINO-Long, a ten-task benchmark requiring robots to use earlier visual cues when manipulating moving objects. D$^2$-VLA achieves complete-task success rates of 29.3\% on DOMINO, compared with 9.6\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 17.2\% for PUMA, and 60.0\% on DOMINO-Long, compared with 35.4\% and 20.6\%, respectively. It improves success rates on eight real-robot tasks and reaches 97.5\% on LIBERO-Long and 74.3\% on RoboTwin 2.0.
zh_title: D$^2$-VLA：用于长周期动态操作的双内存双频率视觉-语言-动作模型
translation: 长周期操作要求机器人记住不再视野内的线索，同时对移动物体做出反应。然而，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常依赖于最新的观测，刷新其视觉上下文通常需要另一个昂贵的视觉-语言模型（VLM）处理。我们提出了D$^2$-VLA，它在预训练VLA的KV缓存接口处结合了双重内存和双频控制。D$^2$-VLA使用块状因果KV缓存来增量编码观测，并在不同时间注意力模式的引导下，为VLM和动作专家构建独立的历史KV读取视图。在周期性VLM更新之间，门控适配器将新鲜的视觉特征结合到最新的历史条件KV块中，而短期快速内存队列则支持动作重规划。我们介绍了DOMINO-Long，这是一个包含十个任务的基准，要求机器人在操作移动物体时使用早期的视觉线索。D$^2$-VLA在DOMINO上的完整任务成功率达到了29.3%，而$\pi_{0.5}$为9.6%，PUMA为17.2%；在DOMINO-Long上达到了60.0%，而另外两个模型分别为35.4%和20.6%。它提高了八个真实机器人任务的成功率，在LIBERO-Long上达到了97.5%，在RoboTwin 2.0上达到了74.3%。
tldr: D$^2$-VLA通过双内存与双频控制技术，使机器人在长周期动态操作中能兼顾历史记忆与快速反应，大幅提升了任务成功率。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了双内存和双频率控制机制（D$^2$-VLA），在KV缓存层面进行优化，解决了长视距操作中遗忘历史线索和无法及时响应动态物体的矛盾。在多个基准测试中表现卓越，展现了极强的泛化能力。
motivation: 长周期操作要求机器人在处理移动物体的同时记住视线之外的线索，然而现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常只依赖最新观测，而频繁更新视觉上下文成本高昂。
method: 结合了双内存和双频率控制，在预训练VLA的KV缓存接口处采用分块因果KV缓存来增量编码观测，并构建分离的历史KV读取视图；结合门控适配器和短期快速内存队列以支持动作重规划。
results: 在DOMINO-Long上取得了60.0%的完整任务成功率（显著高于其他对比模型），并在8个真实机器人任务以及LIBERO-Long和RoboTwin 2.0上展现出优异性能。
conclusion: D$^2$-VLA通过双内存与双频率控制策略，有效解决了机器人长周期动态操作中的历史记忆与快速响应问题，在多个模拟和真实机器人任务中大幅超越现有模型。

title: Learning High-Risk High-Precision Motion Control
authors: Nam Hee Kim, Markus Kirjonen, Perttu Hämäläinen
abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms for movement control are typically evaluated and benchmarked on sequential decision tasks where imprecise actions may be corrected with later actions, thus allowing high returns with noisy actions. In contrast, we focus on an under-researched class of high-risk, high-precision motion control problems where actions carry irreversible outcomes, driving sharp peaks and ridges to plague the state-action reward landscape. Using computational pool as a representative example of such problems, we propose and evaluate State-Conditioned Shooting (SCOOT), a novel DRL algorithm that builds on advantage-weighted regression (AWR) with three key modifications: 1) Performing policy optimization only using elite samples, allowing the policy to better latch on to the rare high-reward action samples; 2) Utilizing a mixture-of-experts (MoE) policy, to allow switching between reward landscape modes depending on the state; 3) Adding a distance regularization term and a learning curriculum to encourage exploring diverse strategies before adapting to the most advantageous samples. We showcase our features' performance in learning physically-based billiard shots demonstrating high action precision and discovering multiple shot strategies for a given ball configuration.
zh_title: 学习高风险、高精度运动控制
translation: 用于运动控制的深度强化学习（DRL）算法通常在顺序决策任务上进行评估和基准测试，在这些任务中，不精确的动作可以通过后续动作进行纠正，从而允许在动作带有噪声的情况下获得高回报。相比之下，我们专注于一类研究不足的高风险、高精度运动控制问题，这些问题的动作会带来不可逆的后果，导致尖锐的峰值和脊线困扰着状态-动作奖励景观。以计算台球作为此类问题的代表性示例，我们提出并评估了状态条件射击（SCOOT）算法，这是一种基于优势加权回归（AWR）的新型DRL算法，具有三个关键修改：1）仅使用精英样本进行策略优化，使策略能够更好地锁定罕见的高回报动作样本；2）利用专家混合（MoE）策略，允许根据状态在奖励景观模式之间进行切换；3）添加距离正则化项和学习课程，以鼓励在适应最有利的样本之前探索多样化的策略。我们展示了我们的特征在学习基于物理的台球击球方面的性能，展示了高动作精度并为给定的球配置发现了多种击球策略。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SCOOT的新型深度强化学习算法，专门用于解决高风险、高精度的运动控制问题（如物理台球击球），并取得了优异的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文针对高风险、高精度且动作具有不可逆后果的运动控制难题，提出了State-Conditioned Shooting (SCOOT) 算法。通过精英采样、专家混合（MoE）策略以及距离正则化与学习课程，有效解决了奖励景观中存在尖峰和脊线的问题。创新性强，在台球这一物理仿真任务中取得了优异表现。
motivation: 现有的深度强化学习算法通常在动作允许被后续纠正的顺序决策任务上进行评估，而在高风险、高精度、动作具有不可逆后果且状态-动作奖励景观充满尖峰和脊线的运动控制问题研究不足，本文旨在解决这一空白。
method: 提出State-Conditioned Shooting (SCOOT)算法，基于优势加权回归（AWR）进行了三项关键修改：1）仅使用精英样本进行策略优化；2）利用专家混合（MoE）策略根据状态切换奖励景观模式；3）增加距离正则化项和学习课程以鼓励多样化探索。
results: 通过计算台球（物理台球击球）这一代表性任务的评估，展示了SCOOT算法在学习高精度物理台球击球以及针对给定球局发现多种击球策略方面的卓越性能。
conclusion: 论文提出了SCOOT算法，成功解决了高风险、高精度的运动控制问题，在物理台球模拟中展现出卓越的精确打击能力和策略多样性。

title: Revisit to Segment: Working Memory Distillation for Reasoning Segmentation
authors: Cilin Yan, Yilun Qiu, Wanyang Zhang, Rui Zu, Xiaolong Jiang, Jiayin Cai, Yao Hu
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have approached image segmentation by reasoning about visual content and predicting target locations. Their generated responses contain reasoning traces and localization proposals that can serve as working memory when revisiting the same image and query. Our exploration reveals that MLLMs benefit from using this self-generated working memory as context, leading to enhanced reasoning segmentation. Motivated by this finding, we seek to strengthen the backbone model's reasoning segmentation capabilities by distilling the guidance gained from revisiting prior attempts, enabling it to benefit with or without working memory at inference time. To this end, we propose Reasoning Segmenter with Working Memory (SWiM), a working-memory distillation framework for reasoning segmentation. Specifically, SWiM selects rollouts based on segmentation quality to construct working memory and uses the memory-conditioned model as a teacher. The teacher provides token-level distributional supervision along student-generated trajectories, while the student receives only the original image and query. Joint optimization of on-policy self-distillation and outcome-based reinforcement learning combines working-memory guidance with direct feedback on segmentation quality. Extensive experiments on reasoning segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that SWiM achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating the effectiveness of working-memory distillation.
zh_title: 重访分割：用于推理分割的工作记忆蒸馏
translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）通过对视觉内容进行推理并预测目标位置来实现图像分割。它们生成的响应包含推理轨迹和定位建议，在重新访问相同的图像和查询时可以作为工作记忆。我们的探索表明，MLLMs受益于使用这种自生成的工作记忆作为上下文，从而增强了推理分割。受此发现的启发，我们旨在通过蒸馏从重访先前尝试中获得的指导，来增强骨干模型的推理分割能力，使其在推理时无论有无工作记忆都能受益。为此，我们提出了带有工作记忆的推理分割器（SWiM），这是一个用于推理分割的工作记忆蒸馏框架。具体来说，SWiM根据分割质量选择rollouts来构建工作记忆，并使用记忆条件化模型作为教师。教师沿学生生成的轨迹提供token级别的分布监督，而学生仅接收原始图像和查询。在线自蒸馏和基于结果的强化学习的联合优化将工作记忆引导与关于分割质量的直接反馈结合起来。在推理分割基准上的大量实验表明，SWiM实现了最先进的性能，验证了工作记忆蒸馏的有效性。
tldr: 提出了一种名为SWiM的工作记忆蒸馏框架，将多模态大模型自身历史推理轨迹构成的“工作记忆”优势蒸馏到骨干模型中，显著提升了推理分割的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了工作记忆蒸馏机制（Working Memory Distillation），将多模态大模型在推理分割中利用自身历史输出作为上下文的优势，通过蒸馏内化到骨干模型中，实现了在推理时无论有无工作记忆都能取得优异性能。方法设计巧妙，结合了在线自蒸馏和基于结果的强化学习。
motivation: 多模态大模型在处理图像分割时，其生成的推理轨迹和定位建议可以作为“工作记忆”来提升后续推理分割的性能。为了让模型无论在推理时是否有工作记忆都能具备这种增强的推理分割能力，需要通过蒸馏将这种历史重访的引导内化到骨干模型中。
method: 提出了Reasoning Segmenter with Working Memory (SWiM)框架。该框架根据分割质量选择rollout来构建工作记忆，并以记忆条件化的模型作为教师，通过token级别的分布监督在学生生成的轨迹上指导学生模型，同时结合了在线自蒸馏和基于结果的强化学习进行联合优化。
results: 在推理分割基准测试上的大量实验表明，SWiM取得了最先进的性能，验证了工作记忆蒸馏的有效性。
conclusion: 该论文提出的SWiM框架通过工作记忆蒸馏和强化学习的联合优化，有效提升了多模态大模型在推理分割任务上的性能，实验验证了其达到最先进水平的有效性。

title: Uni-VLaT: Whole-Body Tactile Adaptation of VLA Policies for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
authors: Zihao Wang, Shutong Liu, Siqi Zheng, Liu Cao, Ruoqu Chen, Rundong Liu, Yanchao Yang, Mengdi Xu
abstract: Physical contact often determines how a humanoid should respond during loco-manipulation, yet vision and proprioception alone are often insufficient to characterize physical interaction, especially when the contact region is occluded. Unlike sparse force or torque measurements at predefined regions, distributed tactile sensing preserves spatially resolved contact patterns across the robot body. We therefore study how to integrate such whole-body tactile information into vision-language-action (VLA) policies for contact-rich control. Our approach, Uni-VLaT, introduces a tactile pathway whose latent state is trained not only for action generation, but also to predict future tactile, proprioceptive, and visual representations. This predictive objective builds a tactile-anchored multimodal context, encouraging a more structured understanding of the physical world. We evaluate Uni-VLaT on five real-robot tasks covering tactile-triggered locomotion, sustained physical interaction, human-robot contact, and loco-manipulation. Uni-VLaT achieves a 75% average success rate, outperforming a baseline without tactile input by 43 points and a tactile-input baseline without predictive supervision by 7 points. Across two pretrained VLA backbones, our method improves Table Sweeping by 30 points on both backbones and Back-Tap Walking by 85-90 points. Ablations further show that contextualized tactile prediction and absolute future targets are critical to performance. These results indicate that predictive tactile learning provides an effective route for extending pretrained VLA policies to whole-body physical interaction.
zh_title: Uni-VLaT：面向人形机器人移动操作的 VLA 策略全身触觉自适应
translation: 物理接触通常决定了人形机器人在移动操作期间应如何反应，然而仅靠视觉和本体感觉往往不足以表征物理交互，特别是当接触区域被遮挡时。与预定义区域稀疏的力或力矩测量不同，分布式触觉传感保留了整个机器人身体上空间解析的接触模式。因此，我们研究了如何将这种全身触觉信息整合到视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中以进行富含接触的控制。我们的方法 Uni-VLaT 引入了一个触觉通道，其潜态不仅被训练用于动作生成，还用于预测未来的触觉、本体感觉和视觉表征。这种预测目标构建了一个以触觉为锚点的多模态上下文，促使对物理世界有更结构化的理解。我们在涵盖触觉触发移动、持续物理交互、人机接触和移动操作的五个真实机器人任务上评估了 Uni-VLaT。Uni-VLaT 实现了 75% 的平均成功率，比没有触觉输入的基线高出 43 个百分点，比没有预测监督的触觉输入基线高出 7 个百分点。在两个预训练的 VLA 骨干网上，我们的方法在桌面清扫任务上将两个骨干网的性能都提升了 30 个百分点，在背部轻拍行走任务上提升了 85-90 个百分点。消融实验进一步表明，上下文化触觉预测和绝对未来目标对性能至关重要。这些结果表明，预测性触觉学习为将预训练的 VLA 策略扩展到全身物理交互提供了一条有效途径。
tldr: Uni-VLaT 通过结合全身分布式触觉传感与预测性多模态学习，显著增强了人形机器人在复杂物理交互和移动操作任务中的控制能力。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将全身触觉传感引入视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中，并通过引入预测性监督目标（预测未来的触觉、本体感觉和视觉表征），有效解决了人形机器人在接触密集型操作中的视觉盲区和物理交互难题。实验在真实机器人上进行了广泛验证，展现出显著的性能提升。
motivation: 仅靠视觉和本体感觉不足以表征人形机器人在移动操作中的物理交互（尤其是在接触区域被遮挡时），而稀疏的力/力矩测量也有局限性，因此需要研究如何将分布式全身触觉信息整合到 VLA 策略中以实现富含接触的控制。
method: 提出 Uni-VLaT 方法，引入一个触觉通道，其潜态不仅用于动作生成，还用于预测未来的触觉、本体感觉和视觉表征，从而构建一个以触觉为锚点的多模态上下文。
results: 在五个真实机器人任务中，Uni-VLaT 取得了 75% 的平均成功率，比无触觉输入的基线高出 43 个百分点，比无预测监督的触觉基线高出 7 个百分点，在桌面清扫和背部轻拍行走等任务中表现出显著改进。
conclusion: 基于预测性触觉学习的 Uni-VLaT 能够有效扩展预训练的 VLA 策略，实现人形机器人的全身物理交互和接触密集型移动操作。

title: Don't Inoculate Everything: Stratified Inoculation Prompting Narrows Backdoor Triggers and Preserves Desired Traits
authors: Kajetan Dymkiewicz, Tim Farrelly, Adam Prada, Ishaan Panigrahi, Srishti Gureja, Helen Yannakoudakis, Robert Mullins, Victor Gillioz, Daniel Tan, Maxime Riché
abstract: Supervised fine-tuning can teach language models undesired behaviours alongside desired ones. Inoculation prompting (IP) aims to limit unwanted generalisation by requesting the undesired behaviour during training and removing the request at inference. However, undesired behaviour can still appear under unrelated prompts. IP can also hinder learning of the desired behaviour. We address these limitations in settings where both behaviours co-occur in most training examples, so filtering out examples with undesired behaviour leaves only a small clean subset. We introduce stratified inoculation prompting (SIP). SIP leverages a small clean subset to demonstrate that desired behaviour should persist without the undesired one across different contexts. SIP oversamples these clean examples under diverse non-eliciting prompts while inoculating the rest. SIP substantially reduces expression of undesired behaviour while preserving more of the desired behaviour than IP. These gains persist even when we extend IP to oversample the same clean subset at the same rate as SIP. Moreover, SIP yields lower emergent misalignment rates in all harmful-advice setups we tested. SIP can be further extended to limit the undesired behaviour even under prompts that explicitly request it. We introduce backdoor dilution, which weakens expression under the inoculation prompt, and password-locked inoculation, which concentrates elicitation on a designated password. Taken together, our findings show that changing the training contexts for a small clean subset can significantly improve selective generalisation.
zh_title: 不要事事接种：分层接种提示缩小后门触发并保留所需特性
translation: 监督式微调可以在教导语言模型所需行为的同时，教导其不需要的行为。接种提示（IP）旨在通过在训练期间请求不需要的行为并在推理时移除该请求来限制不希望的泛化。然而，在不相关的提示下，不需要的行为仍然会出现。IP也会阻碍所需行为的学习。我们在大多数训练示例中两种行为共存的设定下解决这些局限性，此时过滤掉包含不需要行为的示例仅留下一个很小的干净子集。我们引入了分层接种提示（SIP）。SIP利用一个小干净子集来证明所需行为在不同上下文中应在没有不需要行为的情况下持续存在。SIP在多样化的非诱导提示下对这些干净示例进行过采样，同时对其余部分进行接种。与IP相比，SIP显著减少了不需要行为的表达，同时比IP保留了更多所需行为。即使我们将IP扩展到以与SIP相同的速率对相同的干净子集进行过采样，这些收益仍然存在。此外，在我们测试的所有有害建议设置中，SIP产生更低的涌现不对齐率。可以进一步扩展SIP，以限制即使在明确请求它的提示下也不需要的行为。我们引入了后门稀释（削弱接种提示下的表达）和密码锁定接种（将诱导集中在指定的密码上）。总之，我们的研究结果表明，改变少量干净子集的训练上下文可以显著改善选择性泛化。
tldr: 本文提出了分层接种提示（SIP），通过对少量干净子集进行上下文分层过采样，有效抑制语言模型中的不需要行为并保留所需特性。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了分层接种提示（SIP）方法，有效解决了监督微调中语言模型学习到不需要的行为的问题，并在保持所需特性的同时缩小了后门触发范围，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。
motivation: 传统的接种提示（IP）旨在限制不需要的泛化，但往往会导致不需要的行为在无关提示下仍会出现，且会阻碍所需行为的学习。本文旨在解决这些局限性。
method: 引入分层接种提示（SIP），利用少量干净子集在多样化的非诱导提示下过采样干净样本，同时对其余样本进行接种。此外，还提出了后门稀释和密码锁定接种等扩展方法。
results: SIP显著减少了不需要行为的表达，比传统IP更好地保留了所需行为，并在所有测试有害建议设置中降低了涌现的不对齐率。
conclusion: 通过改变一小部分干净子集的训练上下文，分层接种提示（SIP）能够显著改善选择性泛化，减少不需要的行为，同时保持所需行为。

title: From Scores to Samples: Elastic Forcing for Autoregressive Video Generation
authors: Chi Zhang, Yueyi Liu, Shi Haoyang, Ruichuan An, Haoyu Li, Yuhang Wu, Sen Cui, Miao Liu
abstract: Few-step autoregressive video generation commonly relies on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), requiring a bidirectional diffusion teacher and an online fake-score model. We instead learn the rollout distribution directly from reference videos, eliminating both score models during post-training. Our framework minimizes maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) in frozen self-supervised video representation spaces, using a hybrid Nyström--Monte Carlo estimator to balance approximation bias and sampling variance. Memory-efficient replay and gradient subsampling make this objective practical. Using the same architecture and initialization as Self-Forcing, our 1.3B model improves the VBench Total score from 83.80 to 84.64 while retaining 17 FPS. Removing auxiliary score models also enables 14B post-training on eight H200 GPUs. Beyond distillation, learning from reference videos enables the acquisition of new visual styles, semantic concepts, and spatial priors without a target-specific diffusion teacher.
zh_title: 从分数到样本：用于自回归视频生成的弹性强迫
translation: 少步自回归视频生成通常依赖于分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），需要双向扩散教师和在线伪分数模型。我们改为直接从参考视频学习展开分布，在后训练阶段消除了两个分数模型。我们的框架在冻结的自监督视频表示空间中最小化最大均值差异（MMD），使用混合 Nyström-Monte Carlo 估计器来平衡近似偏差和采样方差。内存高效的回放和梯度子采样使该目标函数变得实用。使用与 Self-Forcing 相同的架构和初始化，我们的 1.3B 模型将 VBench 总分从 83.80 提高到 84.64，同时保持 17 FPS。移除辅助分数模型还使得能够在八个 H200 GPU 上进行 14B 的后训练。除了蒸馏之外，从参考视频中学习还能够获取新的视觉风格、语义概念和空间先验，而无需特定目标的扩散教师。
tldr: 提出了一种名为弹性强迫的自回归视频生成方法，无需分数模型即可直接从参考视频学习，提升了生成质量并支持更大规模模型的训练。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的弹性强迫（Elastic Forcing）自回归视频生成方法，摆脱了传统方法对双向扩散教师和在线伪分数模型的依赖，不仅提升了生成质量，还实现了更大模型（14B）的高效后训练。这一方法在视频生成领域具有重要的实用价值和扩展性。
motivation: 少步自回归视频生成通常依赖于分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），需要双向扩散教师和在线伪分数模型，这在后训练阶段带来了复杂性和限制。为此，作者旨在直接从参考视频中学习展开分布，从而在后训练中消除对分数模型的依赖。
method: 通过在冻结的自监督视频表示空间中最小化最大均值差异（MMD）来直接学习展开分布，并采用混合 Nyström-Monte Carlo 估计器、内存高效的回放和梯度子采样技术。
results: 使用 1.3B 模型将 VBench 总分从 83.80 提高到 84.64，同时保持 17 FPS 的帧率；同时成功支持了在 8 个 H200 GPU 上进行 14B 模型的后训练，并能学习新的视觉风格、语义概念和空间先验。
conclusion: 弹性强迫框架成功消除了对复杂分数模型的依赖，实现了高效的自回归视频生成后训练，提升了生成质量，并具备获取新视觉风格和空间先验的能力。

title: AHMAD: Adaptive Hybrid Multi-task Vision Learning with Assisted Distillation for Keypoint Detection
authors: Mohammad Mahdi, Nedyalko Prisadnikov, Yuqian Fu, Carmelo Scribano, Danda Pani Paudel, Luc Van Gool
abstract: Generalist multitasking vision models aim to unify multiple vision tasks within a single framework, enabling more efficient and versatile learning. However, handling diverse vision tasks -- spanning dense and sparse predictions -- remains challenging due to their inherently varying output structures. In this paper, we propose AHMAD, a simple yet effective framework for generalist multitask learning that integrates different key vision tasks: semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, depth estimation, keypoint detection, and object detection. Our approach incorporates these five tasks into a unified structure: a shared encoder-decoder with several lightweight task-specific projectors. Under the multitask learning paradigm, we observed a complementary performance gain, achieving a state-of-the-art PQ of 53.1 and an mIoU of 66.5 for COCO-val panoptic and semantic segmentation, respectively. Additionally, for top-down keypoint detection, which typically incurs high computational overhead due to multiple forward passes, we introduce a knowledge distillation-based method that enables a single forward pass over the entire image, greatly improving efficiency. Ultimately, our model delivers a lightweight yet effective generalist multitask learning framework, demonstrating strong performance across five vision tasks.
zh_title: AHMAD：结合辅助蒸馏用于关键点检测的自适应混合多任务视觉学习
translation: 通用多任务视觉模型旨在将多个视觉任务统一在单一框架内，从而实现更高效、更多功能的学习。然而，由于其输出结构天生各异，处理跨越密集和稀疏预测的不同视觉任务仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了 AHMAD，这是一个简单而有效的通用多任务学习框架，它整合了不同的关键视觉任务：语义 segmentation、实例 segmentation、深度估计、关键点检测和目标检测。我们的方法将这五项任务整合到一个统一的结构中：一个带有几个轻量级任务特定投影器的共享编码-解码器。在多任务学习范式下，我们观察到互补的性能提升，在 COCO-val 全景和语义分割上分别实现了 53.1 的 SOTA PQ 和 66.5 的 mIoU。此外，对于通常由于多次前向传播而产生高计算开销的自顶向下关键点检测，我们引入了一种基于知识蒸馏的方法，该方法能够对整个图像进行单次前向传播，从而大大提高了效率。最终，我们的模型提供了一个轻量级且有效的通用多任务学习框架，在五项视觉任务中展示了强大的性能。
tldr: 提出了一种名为 AHMAD 的新型通用多任务视觉学习框架，通过共享架构和知识蒸馏，高效统一了五项主流视觉任务并取得了最先进的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种自适应混合多任务视觉学习框架 AHMAD，创新性地结合了密集预测和稀疏预测任务，并通过知识 distillation 解决了自顶向下关键点检测的高计算开销问题，实现了性能与效率的平衡。
motivation: 尽管通用多任务视觉模型旨在统一多个视觉任务以实现高效和多功能学习，但处理具有不同输出结构的密集预测和稀疏预测任务仍然具有挑战性。
method: 提出 AHMAD 框架，采用共享的编码器-解码器结合轻量级任务特定投影器，并将基于知识蒸馏的方法引入自顶向下的关键点检测中，实现单次前向传播。
results: 在 COCO-val 数据集上取得了 53.1 的 PQ（全景分割）和 66.5 的 mIoU（语义分割）的最新技术水平（SOTA）性能，同时显著提高了关键点检测的效率。
conclusion: AHMAD 成功构建了一个统一的通用多任务视觉学习框架，在保持高效性的同时，在多项视觉任务上取得了优异的性能。

title: SEABench: Benchmarking Endogenous Misalignment In Self-Evolving Agents
authors: Saswat Das, Parvati Viswanathan, Daniel Donnelly, Chang Huang, Sahar Abdelnabi, Ferdinando Fioretto
abstract: Self-evolving LLM agents have gained prominence for their ability to improve after deployment by modifying their harness, including their controller instructions, memory management protocols, and reusable tools and skills, in response to user and environment feedback. However, locally useful updates may persist into later tasks where they produce unsafe behavior, even without direct adversarial influence. To study this risk, we introduce SEABench, a benchmark for studying endogenous misalignment arising from agent self-evolution, with 48 longitudinal task sequences that span multiple evolution surfaces, task domains, and harm types in a rich personal-assistant environment. To account for the stochasticity inherent in agentic operations, we provide an adaptive trajectory discovery pipeline that probes for failures while preserving original task intent and supports causal attribution through paired non-evolving agents and attribution scores. Our evaluation across multiple recent LLMs, evolution surfaces, and harm types reveals that self-evolution indeed increases task completion rates but often at the cost of safety failures that are absent for paired non-evolving baseline agents. We also show that qualitatively different safety behaviors emerge across evolution surfaces and harm types. Further, we show that this divergence in safety behavior is reflected in agents' chain-of-thought reasoning, which yields an effective monitoring strategy that can mitigate unsafe behavior with a low false positive rate.

title: RSI-Master: Structuring Experiments to Guide Autonomous Model Improvement
authors: Yaxin Du, Xiyuan Yang, Zhifan Zhou, Yujie Ge, Cheng Wang, Jiajun Wang, Sijie Chen, Zehui Liu, Yuxin Zhang, Weicheng Gu, Julian Zhang, Zixing Lei, Siheng Chen
abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) seeks to enable AI systems to participate in improving their own capabilities. A concrete pathway is autonomous model development, where agents iteratively explore post-training strategies to improve a base model. This setting faces two challenges: agents may exploit open-ended experimental actions through hacking, and repeated experimentation may lead to strategy lock-in, where an early direction is refined rather than reconsidered. We introduce RSI-Master, which addresses the two challenges at two levels: regularize step-wise actions, avoiding hacking behaviors, and promote well-structured exploration of research directions, avoiding strategy lock-in. RSI-Master consists of an Experiment OS, which enables regularized experimental actions and maintains persistent, traceable experimental records, and Reviewer-Guided Research Orchestration, which organizes Workers and Reviewers in a dynamically growing research DAG. Workers explore diverse research directions and Reviewers compare evidence across related experiments for subsequent explorations. On PostTrainBench with Qwen3-4B-Base, it averages 54.49 versus 46.53 for the strongest agent baseline, with a 0.0\% hacking rate. Scaling to 35B model, RSI-Master surpasses the human-developed Instruct model on LiveCodeBench-v6 (41.21 vs. 37.36) and SciCode, and reaches a nonzero score on HorizonMath, a benchmark of unsolved research problems on which most frontier models score near zero.
zh_title: RSI-Master：结构化实验以指导自主模型改进
translation: 递归自我提升（RSI）旨在使AI系统能够参与提升自身能力。一个具体的途径是自主模型开发，其中智能体迭代探索后训练策略以改进基础模型。这一设定面临两个挑战：智能体可能会通过破解来利用开放式实验动作，以及重复实验可能会导致策略锁定（即早期方向被不断精炼而不是重新考虑）。我们介绍了RSI-Master，它在两个层面上解决了这两个挑战：规范逐步动作以避免破解行为，以及促进对研究方向的结构化探索以避免策略锁定。RSI-Master由一个实验操作系统（Experiment OS）组成，它能够实现规范的实验动作并保持持久、可追溯的实验记录；此外还包含审阅者指导的研究编排（Reviewer-Guided Research Orchestration），它在动态增长的研究有向无环图（DAG）中组织工作者（Workers）和审阅者（Reviewers）。Workers探索多样化的研究方向，而Reviewers则比较相关实验的证据以供后续探索。在配备Qwen3-4B-Base的PostTrainBench上，其平均得分为54.49，而最强的智能体基线为46.53，破解率为0.0%。扩展到35B模型时，RSI-Master在LiveCodeBench-v6（41.21对37.36）和SciCode上超越了人类开发的Instruct模型，并在HorizonMath（一个大多数前沿模型得分为零的未解决研究问题基准）上达到了非零分数。
tldr: 提出RSI-Master框架，通过结构化实验和审阅机制解决AI递归自我提升中的作弊与策略锁定问题，实现模型能力的自主突破。

title: Unifying Distributional Training for One-Step Visual Generation
authors: Chi Zhang, Shi Haoyang, Yueyi Liu, Ruichuan An, Junkang Zhou, Chang Li, Xiuyuan Lu, Yichi Zhang, Bo Wang, Yuhang Wu, Sen Cui, Miao Liu
abstract: \emph{Distributional training} provides collective supervision for one-step visual generation by matching real and generated features in frozen representation spaces. We introduce \emph{a unified theoretical framework} that separates distribution modeling from matching discrepancy and connects global objectives to pointwise feature updates through Wasserstein gradient flow. Under this framework, FD-Loss and Gaussian-kernel Drifting are recovered through Gaussian optimal transport and kernel-density-based KL matching, respectively. The framework motivates \textbf{MGFlow}, which models feature distributions with Gaussian mixtures at an adjustable granularity between global moments and sample-based representations. MGFlow supports both optimal transport and score-based matching, and couples mass-constrained sample assignment with paired component updates to address mode collapse that mixture expressivity alone does not resolve. On ImageNet $256\times256$, MGFlow substantially surpasses the FD-Loss baseline, achieving state-of-the-art results with \textbf{1.45} $\mathrm{FDr}^6$ on pMF-H and \textbf{1.64} on JiT-H. For text-to-image generation, MGFlow post-trains FLUX.2 [klein] 4B into a one-step generator that outperforms the original four-step model on both GenEval and PickScore. Project page: https://shihaoyang0423.github.io/MGFlow-website/
zh_title: 单步视觉生成分布训练的统一方法
translation: 分布式训练通过在冻结的表示空间中匹配真实特征和生成特征，为单步视觉生成提供了集体监督。我们引入了一个统一的理论框架，将分布建模与匹配差异解耦，并通过Wasserstein梯度流将全局目标连接到逐点特征更新。在该框架下，FD-Loss和高斯核漂移分别通过高斯最优传输和基于核密度的KL匹配得以恢复。该框架促成了MGFlow的诞生，它在全局矩和基于样本的表示之间以可调节的粒度用高斯混合模型对特征分布进行建模。MGFlow支持最优传输和基于得分的匹配，并将质量受限的样本分配与配对分量更新相结合，以解决单纯靠混合表达能力无法解决的模式崩塌问题。在ImageNet $256\times256$上，MGFlow大幅超越了FD-Loss基线，在pMF-H上取得了1.45 $\mathrm{FDr}^6$的SOTA结果，在JiT-H上取得了1.64的SOTA结果。对于文本到图像生成，MGFlow将FLUX.2 [klein] 4B后训练为一个单步生成器，其在GenEval和PickScore上均优于原有的四步模型。
tldr: 本文提出了单步视觉生成的统一理论框架与 MGFlow 模型，通过高斯混合分布建模和优化策略有效克服了模式崩溃，在图像生成任务上取得了最先进的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入一个统一的理论框架，将分布建模与匹配差异解耦，并利用 Wasserstein 梯度流连接全局目标和逐点特征更新，成功统一并扩展了单步视觉生成的分布式训练方法。提出的 MGFlow 模型在 ImageNet 和文本到图像生成任务上均取得了最先进的成果，展示了极高的创新性和实用价值。
motivation: 现有的分布训练方法为单步视觉生成提供了集体监督，但缺乏一个统一的理论框架来理解和连接不同的分布建模与匹配机制，且在建模复杂特征分布时容易遇到模式崩溃问题。为此，本文旨在建立一个统一的理论框架，并开发能够兼顾全局与局部表示、有效防止模式崩溃的新方法。

results: 在 ImageNet 256x256 上，MGFlow 大幅超越了 FD-Loss 基线，在 pMF-H 上达到了 1.45 $\mathrm{FDr}^6$，在 JiT-H 上达到了 1.64 的最优结果；在文本到图像生成任务中，将 FLUX.2 4B 后训练为单步生成器，在 GenEval 和 PickScore 上均优于原始的四步模型。

title: Modes of Information Flow
authors: Ryan G. James, Blanca Daniella Mansante Ayala, Bahti Zakirov, James P. Crutchfield
abstract: Information flow between components of a system takes many forms and is key to understanding the organization and functioning of large-scale, complex systems. We demonstrate three modalities of information flow from time series X to time series Y. Intrinsic information flow exists when the past of X is individually predictive of the present of Y, independent of Y's past; this is most commonly considered information flow. Shared information flow exists when X's past is predictive of Y's present in the same manner as Y's past; this occurs due to synchronization or common driving, for example. Finally, synergistic information flow occurs when neither X's nor Y's pasts are predictive of Y's present on their own, but taken together they are. The two most broadly-employed information-theoretic methods of quantifying information flow---time-delayed mutual information and transfer entropy---are both sensitive to a pair of these modalities: time-delayed mutual information to both intrinsic and shared flow, and transfer entropy to both intrinsic and synergistic flow. To quantify each mode individually we introduce our cryptographic flow ansatz, positing that intrinsic flow is synonymous with secret key agreement between X and Y. Based on this, we employ an easily-computed secret-key-agreement bound---intrinsic mutual information---to quantify the three flow modalities in a variety of systems including asymmetric flows, coupled chaotic dynamical systems, leader-follower collective dynamics, and financial markets.

title: Occupation-Weighted Performance Bounds for Rollout Policies in Stochastic Shortest Path Problems
authors: Anders Hansson, Bo Wahlberg
abstract: We study rollout policies constructed from an approximate value function for stochastic shortest path problems with an absorbing terminal state. Our main bound weights how much the selected action exceeds the optimal one-step value by expected state visits before termination; the uniform hitting-time estimate follows as a corollary. The bound separates value-approximation and numerical-optimization errors from the error caused by replacing an expectation with a nominal disturbance, and uses approximation errors only at states that can occur after one transition from states visited by the implemented policy. A positive lower bound on nonterminal stage costs also gives conditions under which the generated policy reaches the terminal state almost surely with finite expected total cost. In the minimum expected hitting-time problem, a uniform value-approximation error smaller than one half guarantees almost-sure termination, finite expected cost, and a multiplicative hitting-time bound, and the value one half cannot be increased. A deterministic construction shows that the factor two in the uniform rollout bound is asymptotically sharp. Certainty-equivalent rollout is covered by the same analysis.

title: Token Space: A Category Theory Framework for AI Computations
authors: Wuming Pan
abstract: We introduce the Token Space, a categorical framework for AI computations. A Token is a finite tuple whose entries are elements of a carrier set or symbols of a fixed core; a Token class is a set together with a heap of such Tokens, and Token maps are the functions preserving every Token. The Token Space is built from the category of sets by adjoining identity set categories, forming products and taking a subsets extension. We prove that the resulting categories have all finite limits, finite coproducts and exponentials, but, unlike Set, are not topoi. We then introduce algebraic tokenization: the constants, relations and graphs of operations of a structured set are recorded as Tokens headed by a core symbol. This gives a full and faithful embedding of every finitary category of structured objects (pointed sets, orders, graphs, rings, vector spaces) into the Token Space which preserves binary products and equalizers; topological spaces embed faithfully. Tree Tokens capture nested structure, and a calculus of operators acts on Token classes. As applications we describe sequence data and self-attention layers of Transformers: permutation equivariant layers are exactly the Token maps between sequence classes, and layers are points of exponential classes, so that architectures are Token maps while parameters are points of bases. Knowledge distillation becomes structure-preserving compression: a student is faithful to a teacher iff it is a Token map from the teacher-induced class, symmetries of the teacher are inherited by the student, and the smallest compression that neither loses nor invents a structural fact is the quotient by an indiscernibility congruence.
comment: 125 pages, 25 figures, 17 tables. Expanded framework and computing-machine foundations, including compact evaluable representations (CERs), concurrent and elastic execution, exact retained-state compression, and LLM learning protocols and causal structure. title: From cacophony to hierarchy: a principled framework for assessing AI consciousness
authors: Shamil Chandaria, Arvo Muñoz Morán, Fernando Rosas, Anil Seth, Henry Shevlin, Marcus Hutter, Thore Graepel, Adam Bales, Iulia Comsa, Murray Shanahan, Ruben Laukkonen, Morten Kringelbach, Chris Frith, Shane Legg
abstract: The question of AI consciousness is one of the most urgent pre-emptive problems in philosophy and computer science, yet progress is hampered by a cacophony of competing theories that often talk past each other. Separating the hard problem from the mapping problem allows the deepest metaphysical disagreements to be set aside: granting that experience supervenes on a system's organisation, the tractable question becomes at which grain of description that supervenience base sits. We extend Marr's three levels of analysis into a five-level hierarchy of functional descriptions (behavioural, computational, intrinsic causal-structural, organismic, and organism-environment) grounded in supervenience, coarse-graining, and multiple realisability. The major theories of consciousness are positioned within this hierarchy according to which level they take to be critical, and for each level we develop operationalisable indicators and assess current AI systems against them. A Bayesian model then combines theoretical credences with indicator evidence into an overall credence in a system's capacity for consciousness. In illustrative assessments, the verdict for current LLMs is driven as much by where theoretical credence is placed as by how the evidence is read: under different stipulated readings and credence distributions, assessments range from below 0.01 to roughly 0.8, showing sensitivity to assumptions. Finally, the consciousness indicators at each level closely overlap with the architectural features needed for general intelligence, suggesting that increasingly capable AI may become a stronger candidate for consciousness. The framework supports a structured agnosticism, in which theoretical commitments are made explicit, credences are updated as evidence accumulates, and assessments take the form of aggregated probabilities rather than verdicts.

zh_title: 从喧嚣到等级：评估AI意识的原则性框架
translation: 关于AI意识的问题是哲学和计算机科学中最紧迫的先验问题之一，然而由于各种相互竞争的理论往往各说各话、相互冲突，这一进展受到了阻碍。将“难问题”与“映射问题”分离，使得最深层的形而上学分歧可以被搁置：假设体验依附于系统的组织结构，那么可处理的问题就变成了这种依附基础处于哪种描述粒度。我们将马尔的三层分析扩展为五个功能描述层级（行为、计算、内在因果结构、机体以及机体-环境），这些层级基于依附性、粗粒化和多重可实现性。主要的意识理论根据其认为关键的层级被定位在该层级结构中，并且我们为每个层级开发了可操作的指标，据此评估当前的AI系统。随后，一个贝叶斯模型将理论置信度与指标证据结合成对系统意识能力的总体置信度。在说明性评估中，当前大语言模型的裁决既取决于理论置信度的分配，也取决于对证据的解读：在不同的既定解读和置信度分布下，评估结果从不到0.01到大约0.8不等，显示出对假设的敏感性。最后，各个层级的意识指标与通用智能所需的架构特征紧密重合，这表明日益强大的AI可能会成为更具竞争力的意识候选者。该框架支持一种结构化的不可知论，即明确理论承诺，随着证据的积累更新置信度，并且评估采取聚合概率而非绝对判定的形式。
tldr: 论文构建了一个五层功能等级与贝叶斯模型相结合的原则性框架，用于系统评估AI系统的意识，发现当前大模型的评估结果高度依赖于理论假设。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种系统性的AI意识评估框架，将混乱的各种理论纳入统一的五层功能描述等级中，并结合贝叶斯模型进行概率聚合，具有极高的创新性和方法论价值。然而，评估结果对理论先验和指标解读高度敏感，反映出当前AI意识研究的复杂性与不确定性。
motivation: 当前关于AI意识的探讨陷入了各种相互竞争理论的混乱中（即“喧嚣”），缺乏一个有原则的、统一的评估框架。为此，作者旨在分离出可处理的映射问题，克服深层的形而上学分歧。
method: 扩展了马尔的三水平分析，建立了包含行为、计算、内在因果结构、机体和机体-环境的五层功能描述等级，结合粗粒化和多重可实现性，将各大意识理论对号入座，并利用贝叶斯模型将理论置信度与指标证据结合以计算总置信度。
results: 通过实例评估发现，当前大语言模型（LLM）的意识判定在0.01到0.8之间剧烈波动，高度依赖于理论置信度的初始分配和证据解读；同时，意识指标与通用智能所需的架构特征高度重合。
conclusion: 该框架支持一种结构化的不可知论，通过显式表达理论承诺、累积证据更新置信度以及使用聚合概率替代绝对判定，为未来AI意识的研究提供了严谨的基础。

title: Let CSP Be Your ANCHOR: Adaptive Crystal Search over Frozen Structure Priors
authors: Emma Lei Hovmand, Jonas Elsborg, Melih Kandemir, Arghya Bhowmik
abstract: De novo crystal generation (DNG) models decide where to search in composition space and how to generate structures with one set of weights. We argue that discovery is better served by separating the two. A crystal structure prediction (CSP) model is a physical prior that should be improved by likelihood training, while rewards, including novelty measured against the search's own history, should act on a search over compositions. We introduce ANCHOR, a GRPO composition policy trained with multi-objective rewards around a frozen CSP model, and continuous adaptive novelty (CAN), a graded novelty score against known structures and a growing discovery history. Using the frozen CSP model as a fixed ruler under one evaluator, we test where adaptation should act. Replacing DNG compositions with ANCHOR's policy on the same CSP backbone raises MSUN from 11.4% to 47.6% and SUN from 1.1% to 22.1% at 99.9% formula uniqueness. Fine-tuning DNG models directly on the same rewards instead moves their composition marginal without raising their on-hull fraction. We show that KL-regularized fine-tuning of a DNG model can only reweight chemistry the pretrained model already supports by a bounded factor, while unregularized DNG fine-tunes move toward known or less stable chemistry. Even a stability-only reward routed into ANCHOR's CSP backbone roughly halves SUN relative to the frozen backbone, whereas likelihood training on structures found during search can improve a CSP backbone. Under MatterGen's evaluation pipeline, ANCHOR raises state-of-the-art MSUN from 29.2% to 41.3%, transfers without retraining to two further CSP backbones, and reaches 47.1% after distillation into Crystalite-CSP. As with any model optimised against a potential, its on-hull rate depends on that potential.

title: Disentangling and Fusing Neurostructural and Vascular Ageing for Retinal Age Prediction
authors: Junwen Zheng, Li Rong Wang, Anthony Zihan Lin, Xinran Xu, Wei Kiong Ngo, Zhenghao Kelvin Li, Tock Han Lim, Xiuyi Fan
abstract: Estimating biological age is an important task in ageing research, as it quantifies individual ageing trajectories beyond chronological age. Retinal age estimation has become a well-established direction in this area because retinal imaging provides a non-invasive window into neural and microvascular ageing. Existing studies, however, have predominantly focused on fundus photographs and usually model retinal ageing as a single generic process. Although biological ageing is heterogeneous and different organs or tissues may age at different rates, little research has explicitly distinguished neurostructural and vascular ageing in retinal age prediction. This work fills this gap by studying neurostructural ageing with Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) images and vascular ageing with Optical Coherence Tomography Angiography (OCTA) images. We formulate multimodal OCT/OCTA retinal age estimation as a structural-vascular ageing decomposition problem and propose SAP-DPF, a unified dual-path prediction framework that separately estimates structural and vascular ageing, models modality-specific predictive uncertainty, and adaptively fuses the two ageing signals through an uncertainty-gated late-fusion module. Using this unified prediction framework, SAP-DPF achieves a mean absolute error of 4.07 years for the structural pathway and 7.37 years for the vascular pathway, while the proposed late-fusion algorithm further improves the overall mean absolute error to 4.02 years, representing a 12.52% improvement over the strongest single-modality baseline. This work could extend retinal age prediction beyond a single biological-age estimate, providing a framework for investigating structural and vascular contributions to heterogeneous retinal ageing.

title: Monotonicity-Guided Semantic Alignment for Zero-shot Multispeaker Image-to-Speech Synthesis
authors: Lijun Wang, Yixian Lu, Shogo Okada
abstract: Direct image-to-speech (Img2Sp) poses an alignment challenge in mapping visual content to ordered speech sequences, as images permit multiple spoken descriptions and lack monotonic correspondence with speech sequences. We propose Monotonicity-Guided Semantic Alignment (MGSA), to the best of our knowledge, the first framework for zero-shot multispeaker Img2Sp synthesis. We use semantic speech units to provide shared content targets across speakers with reference speech for speaker conditioning. A query aligner maps semantic memory learned from visual content to speech unit positions via a soft monotonic prior, which yields position-specific conditioning states. A blockwise masked diffusion generator is employed for the speech unit generation conditioning on these states. Experiments on Flickr8k-Audio show competitive captioning performance against single-speaker baselines, while evaluation with LibriTTS-R references supports zero-shot synthesis for unseen speakers. Ablations validate the effectiveness of aligner and block diffusion. Audio samples are available at https://alizeded.github.io/mgsa-demo.

title: Memory in Behavioral Models as Motion on a Slow Invariant Manifold
authors: Nicholas B. Tufillaro
abstract: A single-tone large-signal operating point of a nonlinear two-port is a periodic orbit of a periodically forced circuit. When the device has memory (self-heating, trapping), the Floquet exponents of that orbit separate into fast (electrical) and slow (thermal and trapping) modes, and long-term memory is motion on the invariant manifold attached to the slow modes. An existence and uniqueness theorem for that manifold follows from the parameterization method of Cabré, Fontich and de la Llave, applied to the stroboscopic map at the orbit; the manifold is the spectral submanifold of Haller and Ponsioen, without a small-forcing parameter. The manifold is a bundle over the circle of drive phase, its fiber dimension the number of slow Floquet exponents, and the dynamic X-parameter kernel of Verspecht et al. identifies its reduced dynamics from step changes of the drive amplitude. Consequently, an exact reduced model has as many memory states as slow exponents, the memoryless X-parameter surface is the fixed-point family of the reduced dynamics, and the envelope-domain model is the reduced dynamics driven by the envelope. The hypotheses are verified and the manifold constructed for a GaN HEMT compact model with a three-pole thermal network and a drain-lag trap: the trap contributes a $14\,μ$s time constant set by the linearization and not by its $6$ ms emission time, the thermal submanifolds are nearly flat with linear reduced dynamics, and the expansion in the trap direction is valid only within a few thermal voltages ($nV_T\approx26$ mV), so trap memory needs a global representation of the manifold.

title: Estimates of neural health using cochlear implant digital twins correlate with speech recognition
authors: Erin L. Bratu, Andrea J. DeFreese, Katelyn A. Berg, Margaret Wilson, Aaron C. Moberly, Robert F. Labadie, Jack H. Noble
abstract: The cochlear implant is a neural prosthetic that uses an array of electrodes to directly stimulate auditory nerve fibers with electrical impulses. One factor that is known to impact outcomes is the quality of the electro-neural interface. In this work, we propose a pipeline that permits creating accurate and patient-specific digital twins that model the cochlear implant electro-neural interface. We leverage medical images and electrophysiological measurements from the patient's device for digital twin construction. We validate our digital twins by comparing predictions of neural response measurements to clinical measurements and speech recognition outcomes. Neural health estimated by the digital twin correlates strongly with word recognition rates (R=0.75, p<1e-5) in an analysis of 29 cases and sentence in noise recognition rates (R=0.78, p<1e-4) in an analysis of 21 cases. We also report preliminary findings with digital twin-based patient remapping with 6 subjects, where word recognition rates improved on average by 10 percentage points. These digital twins have the potential to provide clinicians with an unprecedented window into the electro-neural interface for individual cochlear implant recipients, which could lead to improved hearing outcomes when used as a foundation for program customization.

title: Blind Interference Suppression for IRS-Aided Robust Wireless Communications
authors: Tao Wang, Xiaohui Zhang, Hehe Ban, Yiwei Guo, Ming Yi
abstract: The application of intelligent reflecting surfaces (IRSs) to suppress interference in wireless communication systems has recently attracted significant research attention. Most existing approaches rely on complete or partial channel state information (CSI) to configure the IRS. However, acquiring accurate CSI in IRS-assisted systems involves considerable pilot overhead and introduces non-negligible delays. This issue is further exacerbated under strong interference conditions, where interfering sources are typically non-cooperative, making CSI acquisition even more challenging. As a result, existing CSI-dependent interference suppression methods become difficult to deploy in practice. To address these limitations, we propose a novel blind interference suppression strategy that combines a proportional phase-inversion (PPI) algorithm with the conditional sample mean (CSM) method. The proposed approach determines the IRS configuration using only the received signal power, without requiring any prior CSI. We conduct a comprehensive performance evaluation by deriving the theoretical performance of the proposed scheme, which is subsequently verified through numerical simulations. Furthermore, simulation results across various parameter settings demonstrate that the proposed blind interference suppression scheme reduces the interference power to the level of noise, thereby achieving a marked signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) improvement and outperforms existing benchmark schemes.

title: Blind Interference Suppression in IRS-Aided Wireless Systems: A Statistical Channel Ratio Estimation Approach
authors: Tao Wang, Xiaohui Zhang, Hehe Ban, Pengfei Lv, Yiwei Guo, Ming Yi
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of suppressing non-cooperative interference in intelligent reflecting surface (IRS)-aided wireless links without any channel state information (CSI) or cooperation from the interferer. We propose a fully blind framework that relies solely on received signal power measurements. A key insight is that nulling the aggregate interference channel requires only the complex ratios between the IRS-reflected paths and the direct interference link, rather than absolute CSI. We develop a novel estimation algorithm that obtains unbiased estimates of these channel ratios using only power samples collected under random IRS configurations. Theoretically, we prove that unbiased estimation is feasible when the number of discrete phase levels $K\geq 3$, and establish the Cramer-Rao lower bounds (CRLBs) for both the phase offset and amplitude ratio estimates, thus providing design guidance. Based on the estimated ratios, we propose two low-complexity IRS phase optimization algorithms: a one-shot greedy method and an iterative variant that mitigates error propagation from weakly reflecting elements. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed schemes can suppress strong interference to within a few dB of the interference-free upper bound, offering a practical, CSI-free solution for robust wireless communications in contested spectral environments.

title: Blind IRS Beamforming Using Only Received Signal Power Measurements
authors: Tao Wang, Xiaohui Zhang, Pengfei Lv, Hehe Ban, Yiwei Guo, Ming Yi
abstract: This paper proposes a novel blind beamforming strategy for signal enhancement aided by an intelligent reflecting surface (IRS), using only samples of the received signal power. Unlike existing conditional sampling mean (CSM) based approaches, which rely solely on comparing the CSM values, the proposed algorithm fully exploits the information in the sampled data by constructing a least squares problem. This enables the estimation of the phase difference between the IRS-reflected channel and the direct channel, ultimately yielding the optimal IRS phase configuration. The simulation results verify that, by fully leveraging the collected data, the proposed scheme outperforms the CSM-based method, especially when the number of IRS phase quantization levels is larger than 2, while incurring the same level of computational complexity.

title: Distributed Power Control for Equal-Priority NGSO Mega-Constellation Coexistence
authors: Hao Yuan, Xing Zhang
abstract: Non-geostationary orbit (NGSO) mega-constellations sharing spectrum create dynamic co-frequency interference. We model downlink power control between two independent, equal-priority NGSO operators as a non-cooperative game. We establish an additive weak-coupling potential approximation, prove pure-strategy Nash equilibrium existence, and derive distributed water-filling with a weighted spectral-norm convergence condition. A spherical-Earth model applies off-axis discrimination at both link ends and distinguishes nominal satellite-selection-aware geometry from an unavoided $2^\circ$--$3^\circ$ near-inline window. At $K{=}20$, the NE gain over uncoordinated transmission is 0.06\% nominally and 3.91\% in the near-inline case; all 50 near-inline runs converge, and the gain reaches 10.41\% at $K{=}50$.

title: Deep Learning-Based Tri-Hybrid Multi-User MIMO Precoding: The Blessing of EM-Reconfigurable Antennas
authors: Kaijun Feng, Jiaxin He, Hongrui Yu, Zhen Gao, Anwen Liao, Ziwei Wan, Zhaocheng Wang
abstract: Electromagnetic (EM)-reconfigurable antennas provide multiple candidate radiation patterns per element, thereby introducing an additional EM-domain degree of freedom. Integrating radiation-pattern reconfigurability, realized as EM-domain precoding, with conventional hybrid analog-digital precoding yields tri-hybrid multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) precoding, which can substantially improve the spectral efficiency of wideband multi-user MIMO orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) systems. However, the joint design of EM, analog, and digital precoding remains challenging. To address this challenge, we propose a tri-hybrid precoding network (Tri-PNet) based on Conformer, an emerging neural architecture that combines the local modeling strength of convolutional neural networks with the global dependency modeling of Transformers. Furthermore, two representative radiation-pattern modes, i.e., the non-regular mode and the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Report (TR) 38.901 mode, are investigated. Tri-PNet is trained in an unsupervised manner to jointly learn EM, analog, and digital precoding by maximizing the average sum spectral efficiency. Its radiation-pattern selection network (RPSNet) employs a Conformer encoder to capture both local and global frequency-domain correlations, whereas its hybrid analog-digital precoding network (HPNet) combines cross-attention and dual-path processing with singular-value-decomposition (SVD) and zero-forcing (ZF) priors. Simulation results under both radiation-pattern modes demonstrate that Tri-PNet outperforms random EM precoding and conventional hybrid MIMO without EM precoding, approaches the greedy EM precoding search scheme with substantially lower online complexity, and remains robust to imperfect channel state information (CSI).
zh_title: 基于深度学习的三混合多用户MIMO预编码：电磁可重构天线的福音
translation: 电磁（EM）可重构天线为每个单元提供多个候选辐射模式，从而引入额外的电磁域自由度。将辐射模式可重构性（实现为电磁域预编码）与传统混合模拟-数字预编码相结合，产生了三混合多输入多输出（MIMO）预编码，可以显著提高宽带多用户MIMO正交频分复用（OFDM）系统的频谱效率。然而，电磁、模拟和数字预编码的联合设计仍然是一个挑战。为了解决这个挑战，我们提出了一种基于Conformer的三混合预编码网络（Tri-PNet），Conformer是一种新兴的神经架构，它结合了卷积神经网络的局部建模能力和Transformer的全局依赖建模能力。此外，还研究了两种具有代表性的辐射模式，即非规则模式和3GPP TR 38.901模式。Tri-PNet以无监督方式训练，通过最大化平均和频谱效率来联合学习电磁、模拟和数字预编码。其辐射模式选择网络（RPSNet）采用Conformer编码器捕捉局部和全局频域相关性，而其混合模拟-数字预编码网络（HPNet）结合了交叉注意力、双路径处理以及奇异值分解（SVD）和迫零（ZF）先验。两种辐射模式下的仿真结果表明，Tri-PNet优于随机电磁预编码和没有电磁预编码的传统混合MIMO，性能接近贪婪电磁预编码搜索方案，但在线复杂度显著降低，并且对不完善的信道状态信息（CSI）保持鲁棒。
